options.label: Episode Three: The Secret Life of Owen Harris

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Wait... Did you... Did you just ask me out on a date?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What did you think I did?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't know! I've got a book club, you've got opera tickets, how could I not be dazzled and confused?!
$ALLISON smiles at Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You asked me out!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why don't you announce it to everyone while you're at it?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Really? Is that a courting custom?
$ALLISON clears her throat, preparing to announce Spencer's ask out.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?! No! Shut up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hee! Geez! I'm not `that` naive.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hee! Geez! I'm not [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] naive.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, right. So... Since you know it's a date now. Are you still...?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Busy?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Interested!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh! Of course that's what you're curious about!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes! Indeed I am.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Busy?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Interested!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But why don't we `rendezvous` for coffee this Friday instead?
nodes.text_bbcode: But why don't we [color=#3b78e2][i]rendezvous[/i][/color] for coffee this Friday instead?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, I can wait.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now that Nate's out of the picture...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'd love to, uh, `reindeer-fu` with you.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'd love to, uh, [color=#e23b3b][i]reindeer-fu[/i][/color] with you.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Rendezvous means 'meet'. It comes from the French word--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heh. Geez, Red. I'm not `that` dumb.
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. Geez, Red. I'm not [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] dumb.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hee! Looks like we're both guilty of underestimating each other. We'll iron out the details later?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yep! Awesome! Talk to you later.
Spencer can't help but grin from ear to ear as he returns to his seat on the couch.
A few moments later, Erik sits down next to him.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I heard through the internet that you've got a spare ticket to the opera!
Spencer glances over at $ALLISON, who tries to hide her smile.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I guess I do. Do you want to go with your farmer girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh no! I wouldn't want to deprive you of the experience!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But if you're looking for someone to give you the ins and outs of the arias and crescendos, I'm your soprano!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine! We'll go together! But don't put it on the internet, and don't make me regret this!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It'll be our offline secret! I promise! And you know you can trust me... My word's as strong as a robot's butt!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If I wasn't so happy right now, I'd punch you for saying that...
...Spencer has failed.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And miss out on the opera?! I couldn't let you do that...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Besides, there are going to be so many literature aficionados at the meeting... I don't think it'll be fun for you.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I guess you're right. It wouldn't be much of a date, would it?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Do you think that's possible?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sure, I've seen it in movies all the time!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You just hop back and forth between each place...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It'll be really funny. Especially when you show up to the book club in your fancy opera clothes!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: For who?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The... Audience?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't think doing both is feasible, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, I just really wanted our first date to be tonight, you know?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes...
The laptop flies across the detention room, slamming into the wall, and spraying shrapnel everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: If you thought you were in trouble before, young man, you're in for a world of surprises!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You were the one--

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: --Trying to `give you` a laptop?!
nodes.text_bbcode: --Trying to [color=#e23b3b][i]give you[/i][/color] a laptop?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I told you I didn't want it!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: So you destroyed it?!
The other Troublemakers weigh in...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What happened, Spencer?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Who refuses a `free laptop?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Who refuses a [color=#3b78e2][i]free laptop?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Who `destroys` a free laptop?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Who [color=#3b78e2][i]destroys[/i][/color] a free laptop?!

nodes.text: Erik pats Spencer on the shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sometimes when I get a granola bar I don't like I throw it in the garbage can with excessive force...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So, I can relate, buddy.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's not even remotely the same thing.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What were you thinking?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I... I wasn't thinking, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: No, you weren't! But you're going to have plenty of opportunities when I'm through with you!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Please, Mr. Hart. There must be some way I can make it up to you. We just got off on the wrong foot!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Understatement! It's too late for kindnesses! You're suspended, `and` you're going to juvenile hall!
nodes.text_bbcode: Understatement! It's too late for kindnesses! You're suspended, [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] you're going to juvenile hall!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: And a word to the rest of you, if you'll permit me the opportunity to repeat myself...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: This is just the beginning!
Suspended? Juvenile hall? It's pretty clear that...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That was intense.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You really pushed one of his buttons, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: More importantly, who passes up a laptop?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You are aware that you were offered something expensive `for free?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You are aware that you were offered something expensive [color=#3b78e2][i]for free?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, I got it. I don't know... At first, I was just refusing because of Ms. Lee and my dad's advice, but `now...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I got it. I don't know... At first, I was just refusing because of Ms. Lee and my dad's advice, but [color=#e23b3b][i]now...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I think something's up with Mr. Hart!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well butter my muffin, I'm proud of you, Spencer! You followed your instincts!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: They may be crazy, paranoid instincts, but you still followed them, and that's what matters.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh huh. Thanks, I guess.
A few moments later, things have calmed down. Mr. Hart has returned, and all the Troublemakers except Spencer are enjoying their new laptops.
Spencer notices that $ALLISON is fixated on her screen, clicking away obliviously and `alone.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Spencer notices that $ALLISON is fixated on her screen, clicking away obliviously and [b]alone.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This is my chance... Time to fulfill `my resolution` and ask her out!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is my chance... Time to fulfill [color=#e23b3b][i]my resolution[/i][/color] and ask her out!

nodes.text: He approaches her, trying not to seem too nervous...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: $ALLISON?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes?
He sits next to her, scooting his chair close.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I, uh... So I've got two tickets to this opera thing tonight.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's peculiar. You and opera go together like bulls and ballet.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, I knew you'd say something like that.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Look, I got the tickets so that we could go see them, er, it. The opera.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, I'd `love` to go!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I'd [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] to go!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Unfortunately...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What is it? Is it me? I can get better shoes!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What?! No!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I `just` created this book club on the school site, and it's already full! Can you believe it?!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] created this book club on the school site, and it's already full! Can you believe it?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No! That's... Ludicrous!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Nice usage! Who knew this school was a veritable nest of bookworms?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Anyway, tonight's our first meeting! If I went to the opera with you, I'd be abandoning all these new members!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why don't...

options.label: I come to the book club instead?

nodes.text: Spencer smacks the laptop out of Mr. Hart's hands!
Spencer forcefully shoves his hands into his pockets!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You can't `make` me use that.
nodes.text_bbcode: You can't [color=#e23b3b][i]make[/i][/color] me use that.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not going to ignore Ms. Lee, and I'm not going to ignore my dad.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Just `take` it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Just [color=#e23b3b][i]take[/i][/color] it!

nodes.text: Mr. Hart's yelling attracts the attention of the other Troublemakers.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's... What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Is everything okay?
Mr. Hart's expression returns to normal...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Uh... We're fine! Spencer's just not interested in getting a laptop!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I'll be back in a minute!
Mr. Hart hustles out of the detention room!
Spencer hesitates, but just for a second...
Then he smacks the laptop out of Mr. Hart's hands!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't think so.
Mr. Hart laughs.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: You're really refusing this?
He steps toward Spencer, offering him the laptop for the third time.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: It really is just a laptop!

options.label: Knock it out of his hand!
Put your hands in your pockets!

nodes.text: Spencer smacks the laptop out of Mr. Hart's hands!
Spencer hesitates, but just for a second...
Then he smacks the laptop out of Mr. Hart's hands!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm serious. I don't want it.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I don't understand. Why not?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: One... Ms. Lee told us that you were no good. I trust her, but I don't trust you.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Fair enough. And is there more?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Two... My dad always taught me to be wary around free technology. He was in the military.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Well, this isn't a weapon or anything. I promise it won't bite.
Mr. Hart tries to hand Spencer the laptop again.

options.label: Knock it out of his hand!

nodes.text: Spencer smacks the laptop out of Mr. Hart's hands!
Spencer hesitates, but just for a second...
Then he smacks the laptop out of Mr. Hart's hands!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What about you, Paige?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, I've made a resolution...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You have?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...But I'm not sharing it with any of you... Some things are better kept private.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: My resolution totally relates to that. I want to actually keep all my secrets! No more Kimi the Gossip Queen!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...Except of course for this one thing I `have` to tell you or I'll, like, die!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Except of course for this one thing I [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to tell you or I'll, like, die!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That didn't last long.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What is it?
Kimi pulls out an envelope with a handwritten letter inside...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I've got a secret admirer!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?! Let me see!
The Troublemakers crowd around Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: He addressed it, 'To the most beautiful girl', then he wrote a bunch of deep stuff, like...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: 'You're the sunrise of my mornings, the sunset of my days.'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ooh, my heart's all a-flutter!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This guy's into you!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, it's pathetic. No offense, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: None taken! And look! He signed it, 'Your Admirer. Secret... For now'!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha! What kind of guy doesn't just tell a girl he likes her?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, really? So you've confessed your feelings to the girl `you` like?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, really? So you've confessed your feelings to the girl [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] like?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You like someone, Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, my resolution is to tell her. So, I guess I'm going to act on it right--
--The door swings open, and a young, fresh-out-of-college guy enters, a bright smile on his face!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I'm so so `so` sorry I'm late! Everyone just stay where you are! Stay comfortable!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm so so [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] sorry I'm late! Everyone just stay where you are! Stay comfortable!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: My name is Mr. Hart, and I'm your new supervisor! I've heard all about your little program here. It sounds just wonderful!
He lugs in a stack of large boxes, setting them on the table.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I'm not a fan of the name I've heard others give this program...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The Troublemakers?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: That's the one! You're all trying to make up for bad behavior, why reinforce that?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: As my first decree, I'd like to rename this program, from the 'Troublemakers' to the 'Do-Gooders'! How's that sound?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not nearly as cool as--

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sounds great to me!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: That's the kind of enthusiasm I like to see! Just because you've all violated the rules, that doesn't mean you can't be trained to never misbehave again! Right? Right? Right?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, yes?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Great! And that brings me to my second decree... New laptops for everyone!
Mr. Hart opens up one of the boxes and pulls out a brand-new laptop!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Seriously? For us?!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Yep! For everyone in the whole school actually! Time to bring Twin Branches kicking and screaming into this century!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: To be honest, a lot of your older teachers are still stuck in the Jurassic when it comes to new technology!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: For sure. Ms. Lee once pointed at my phone and asked if I could 'use that remote to turn the TV on'.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There wasn't even a TV in the room!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Well, things are definitely going to change around here. This is just the beginning...
Each of the Troublemakers boots up their new, personal laptops.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I'd like to direct all of you `Do-Gooders` to the new school website. You can send messages to the administrators, establish new clubs, and set up meetings with other students!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'd like to direct all of you [color=#e23b3b][i]Do-Gooders[/i][/color] to the new school website. You can send messages to the administrators, establish new clubs, and set up meetings with other students!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What a pristine opportunity for me to launch a book club! We could talk about my new favorite, 'Frankenstein'!
As they all log on to the school site, Mr. Hart notices that Spencer hasn't touched his laptop.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Something the matter?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nope. I'm just not interested.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Heh. Sure you don't want a `free` laptop. Here.
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. Sure you don't want a [color=#e23b3b][i]free[/i][/color] laptop. Here.

nodes.text: Mr. Hart picks up the laptop and tries to hand it to Spencer.

options.label: Knock it out of his hand!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I fail to see what is so comical about pursuing my intellectual goals.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, yeah. Sorry. That was kind of a knee-jerk reaction.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I hope it's safe to assume you don't feel the same contempt for our tutoring sessions...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't feel that way at all! Promise!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Very well. Apology accepted...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I know, right? I kind of impressed myself!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't think I could even read `one` book that fast!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't think I could even read [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] book that fast!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Awww! Don't be so modest. You're a fine reader!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Fine?` I had no idea you felt that way about me!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Fine?[/i][/color] I had no idea you felt that way about me!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You know what I mean!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Do I? It's hard to learn when you're this `fine`.
nodes.text_bbcode: Do I? It's hard to learn when you're this [color=#e23b3b][i]fine[/i][/color].

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hee. I'm moving on now.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's funny 'cause it's nerdy!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No... Not yet!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...Did anyone make resolutions for the new year?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I did! I resolved to be more honest.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Did you say `more` honest? Erik, you're like the most honest person ever!
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you say [color=#3b78e2][i]more[/i][/color] honest? Erik, you're like the most honest person ever!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not so... Over the break, I told Delilah that I loved ice cream `more` than raisins!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not so... Over the break, I told Delilah that I loved ice cream [color=#e23b3b][i]more[/i][/color] than raisins!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I just wanted to impress her, but she saw right through my flimsy fib!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Of course, I was eating a box of raisins at the time...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The more you talk, the more it seems like a miracle that you have a girlfriend now.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know! And she might be transferring to Twin Branches soon too!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's awesome, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What about you, Owen? Any resolutions?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I made one, yeah. Basically, I'm going to do whatever it takes to get a scholarship for college.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude, you're already studying all the time. Now you're gonna hit the books `harder?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Dude, you're already studying all the time. Now you're gonna hit the books [color=#e23b3b][i]harder?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Something like that...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You make any resolutions, Red?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Absolutely. I resolved to return to my intellectual roots with a foray into the hardbound classics!
The Troublemakers all stare blankly at $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I mean, `I'm reading more.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm reading more.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: They nod in understanding.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I've already read three books this week!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's like you said... A model.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Or... A sunset?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't know. You're the one using big words!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sorry, I just meant that it's `unbelievable.` I mean, `Erik's` in our group too. No one behaves better than him.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, I just meant that it's [color=#3b78e2][i]unbelievable.[/i][/color] I mean, [color=#3b78e2][i]Erik's[/i][/color] in our group too. No one behaves better than him.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, that makes sense.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hee!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I was just imagining a 'ludicrous sunset'.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Laugh it up, Red.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Should I do it now? Is this my chance?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Anyway...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You `have` been studying your vocab.
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] been studying your vocab.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've had a good tutor.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, you're a stupendous student.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Should I do it now? Is this my chance?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: OMG, I'm going to barf if I have to hear any more of this.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Anyway...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: 'Still'? Have you been spying on me?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No, Kimi told me about your cheat sheet collection with the nerds.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I guess it helps to be friends with the biggest gossip in the school.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You only got those to get close to $ALLISON... Pretty scummy, man!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And you still haven't answered me! If you're done with $ALLISON, why do you still have those books?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Actually... I kinda like reading.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha! Dork!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Real mature.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I call 'em like I see 'em.
Spencer shoves past Nate, heading toward the detention door.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: 'When the enemy is relaxed, make them toil.'

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And when the enemy is about to ask out a girl you don't want him to, make him second-guess it...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Wait... You're going to ask $ALLISON out right now, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How'd you know?
Nate nods at the flower in Spencer's hand.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Don't ask her out in front of everyone.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Did I ask for your advice?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Trust me. From one 'cool' guy to another, girls like $ALLISON want to be asked out in private.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And doing it with a bunch of people snooping around isn't private.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What do you know?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yeah, what do I know about girls? I'm only the starting quarterback of the football team...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And have you seen my hair?
Spencer reluctantly looks at Nate's hair.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I guess it's nice.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Of course it is. Look, all I'm saying is... Timing is everything.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Fine. Thanks.
Spencer jams the flower back into his jacket pocket and heads into detention.
Jacob walks by...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hey, aren't you and Spencer like enemies or something?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yep.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Then why were you just acting all friendly toward him?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Because... 'Let your plans be dark and impenetrable as night, and when you move, fall like a thunderbolt.'

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Never mind, Jacob. Never mind.
You are now playing as Spencer.
Spencer steps inside detention, and is relieved to see that the `new supervisor` isn't there yet.
nodes.text_bbcode: Spencer steps inside detention, and is relieved to see that the [b]new supervisor[/b] isn't there yet.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No sign of the new guy?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Not presently.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Phew.
He nods at the rest of the Troublemakers, trying to keep his eyes from lingering on $ALLISON for too long.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This is it... My chance to ask her out!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But Nate's probably right... I need to get her alone first.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's up, guys?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just trying not to freak out about this new Mr. Hart...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me too! What if he's against learning?! How will I ever earn my Ph.D.?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you seriously worried about what Ms. Lee said about him? This is the same woman who thought `Spencer` was the best behaved of all of us.
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you seriously worried about what Ms. Lee said about him? This is the same woman who thought [color=#3b78e2][i]Spencer[/i][/color] was the best behaved of all of us.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey! I don't like the way you said that! I'm behaved!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She's got a point.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're just agreeing with her because you two are dating now.
Spencer imitates Owen.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: 'Whatever you say, sweetie kissums. Mwah mwah mwah mwah mwah!'

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I really hope I don't sound like that.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hee hee! You must admit, Spencer, the idea of `you` being the model citizen among us is somewhat ludicrous.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hee hee! You must admit, Spencer, the idea of [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] being the model citizen among us is somewhat ludicrous.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, I guess it is...
Nate steps in front of Spencer again!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I told you...
In a flash, Spencer grabs Nate and pushes him back into the wall!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I wasn't asking twice!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hnnng...
Nate drops a couple of books he'd been carrying, 'Madame Bovary' and 'The Art of War'.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait... What are you `still` doing with those?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... What are you [color=#e23b3b][i]still[/i][/color] doing with those?

nodes.text: Spencer releases Nate from the wall, and Nate takes a second to recompose himself.
Nate graciously moves out of the way...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: 'The supreme art of war is to subdue the enemy without fighting...'

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Just a little tidbit I picked up from 'The Art of War'.
Nate flashes his copy of the book to Spencer along with a copy of 'Madame Bovary'.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait... What are you still doing with those?
Without thinking, Nate decides to step in front of Spencer again!

nodes.title: Spencer releases Nate from the wall, and Nate takes a second to recompose himself.

nodes.text: You are now playing as Nate.
It's the first day back from the winter break...
As classes let out, Nate looks around, hoping to catch Spencer before he goes into detention.
As if on cue, Spencer rounds the corner, a flower clenched in his hand!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Out of my way, people! Man on a mission here!
Nate watches, a small smirk on his face.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Predictable. Looks like he's finally going to ask $ALLISON out. Time to put a stop to this.
Nate steps out from the crowd, blocking Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't have time for your crap, Nate! `Move!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't have time for your crap, Nate! [color=#e23b3b][i]Move![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer tries to get by, but Nate stays in front of him!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: It's obvious you're in a rush, man. But there's something I have to say...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Then spill it! Quick!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: ...I'm sorry for threatening to date $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? You mean... You're not going to go after her anymore?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Nope. I made a New Year's resolution to let things go. You made it into the Steelman Program fair and square.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I was wrong to frame you for cheating, and my plan to pursue $ALLISON to get back at you... Well, it was really petty of me.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Can you forgive me?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you for real?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm for real.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's... Surprising.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I know. But, I've changed. Honest.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I can't forgive you. Not for what you did.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But if you've really changed then... Then cool, man.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I can accept 'cool'.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm done chatting now. Get outta my way. I'm not asking twice.
Spencer moves to get around Nate...
$ALLISON dabs at Nate's shirt, gradually cleaning up the orange soda from it.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Magic touch!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You live with Amanda, you learn to clean up a few spills.
Their eyes meet.
$ALLISON furiously presses into the stain, feeling Nate's chest underneath his shirt.
She rubs at the stain...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I think you're making it worse!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No, just let me do this!
The stain starts smearing.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Stop!
Nate grabs her hand away, glaring at her... But the look melts away as their eyes meet.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Heh. No biggie. I've got plenty of shirts.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Against my better judgment, I call the first meeting of $ALLISON's Book Club to order. Today, we will be discussing 'Frankenstein'.
$ALLISON and Nate begin to discuss 'Frankenstein' in earnest...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I was surprised by how smart the monster is...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You'd think a creature formed from corpses wouldn't be able to think so sharply.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Maybe Dr. Frankenstein valued intelligence enough to try and make the creature, you know, like him.
Time passes without them even noticing...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I did have one thought... But it's kinda dumb.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No, go ahead!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Well, all the monster wants is a female companion. It's vegetarian. It's only evil when others are evil toward it.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: So, it's not really a monster at all.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Who am I talking to right now? What did you do with Nate the football player?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey, I can still hit a wide receiver on an out route.
Until, finally...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: From Dr. Frankenstein's perspective, he can't make this bride. To do so would mean bringing in a new race of horrifying creatures.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Plus--
$ALLISON stops as Nate sets his book down.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm enjoying our discussion, but I'm actually kind of... Hungry.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, I suppose we could continue at the subsequent club meeting next week.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Or...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Or?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Or we could grab a bite at the pizza place on the corner. I'm sure Mary Shelley would approve.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hee!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I mean... Uh... Yes, let's do that. I'm actually quite peckish myself.
In the pizza parlor, $ALLISON and Nate order some slices of pizza.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Oh, don't worry about paying, just get us a seat. I got this.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Okay, thanks. That will make procuring a table more efficient...
A moment later, the two of them are eating pizza and continuing their discussion.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Did you find the setting significant?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Meh. A bunch of icy mountains. Who cares?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Are you kidding?! The setting is everything! The `isolation` the monster feels! The `cold`-heartedness of the doctor!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you kidding?! The setting is everything! The [color=#3b78e2][i]isolation[/i][/color] the monster feels! The [color=#3b78e2][i]cold[/i][/color]-heartedness of the doctor!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It all comes back to the Alps. Nothing is more cold and isolating.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You really know your literature.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I've read a great many books.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Can I ask you something a little more personal?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You can ask, but if it's too personal, I will refrain from answering.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: How did you end up like this?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I mean... You've read all these books, you talk like a college graduate, but your sister's the complete opposite of you.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: How did you end up how you are?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Too shy to tell me?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No! I'll tell you! Just give me a second...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Sure. Sure. Take all the time you need to summon the nerve.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I've `got` the nerve, okay? Amanda's always been really popular... Everyone loves her, including me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I've [color=#3b78e2][i]got[/i][/color] the nerve, okay? Amanda's always been really popular... Everyone loves her, including me.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think kids tend to fill certain roles for their parents. Amanda had a lock on beloved, airy, girly girl.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: So you went a different way?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Something like that, yes.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And even though Amanda and I are this different in personality...
$ALLISON holds her hands far apart.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: We're `this` close!
nodes.text_bbcode: We're [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] close!

nodes.text: She brings her hands close together and knocks over her glass!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Whoops!
A wave of orange soda splashes all over Nate's shirt!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm so sorry! I can be such a klutz.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: It's okay.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No, it'll stain! Let me just dab at it for a second.
$ALLISON grabs a napkin...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You want a quiz? Fine. What's Dr. Frankenstein's sister's name?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Easy. Elizabeth.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What does the monster want?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Child's play. It wants a companion.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And how is the monster able to befriend the family in the cottage?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Where's the challenge? The old man there is blind and can't see how hideous the creature is.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: All right. I'm convinced.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: By asking me softball questions? I could have looked all of that up, you know.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, sorry for not challenging your superior intellect, but I'll discover whether you're lying soon enough anyway...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Since you're so confident... How many people did Frankenstein kill?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: If you're referring to Dr. Frankenstein, none.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: How many brains does Igor fetch for Dr. Frankenstein?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Nice try. There is no Igor in the book.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Although there probably should be...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Last question...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What's the subtitle of the book?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Uh... That's pretty obscure. I read it, I swear. It's got a Greek name in it.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Give up?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yeah, you got me. But I did read it.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I believe you... For now. And the subtitle is 'The Modern Prometheus'.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: So important that I know that.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It is!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Uh huh...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Anyway...
You are now playing as $ALLISON.
That night...
$ALLISON sets up chairs in a secluded corner of the public library.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm so excited for book club! Finally! A chance to be among my own!
She waits...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I hope I was clear about the meeting time.
...And waits...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Maybe there was some bad traffic. That I didn't see. That the internet doesn't know about.
...And waits...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Guess no one's coming...
She starts sadly packing up her things... when someone raps their knuckles on a nearby bookshelf. $ALLISON spins around.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Am I too late?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Nate? What are you doing here?!
He holds up a copy of 'Frankenstein'.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I heard that you paid some of Kimi's friends for cheat sheets on 'Madame Bovary'. That's really low.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: `That` was a mistake. To be honest, I just wanted to impress you. I didn't actually think I'd like reading because, well, I thought it was dumb.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]That[/i][/color] was a mistake. To be honest, I just wanted to impress you. I didn't actually think I'd like reading because, well, I thought it was dumb.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Quite the opposite, in fact.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I know that `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, I know that [color=#e23b3b][i]now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Anyway, what happened? Where is everyone?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't know. I guess people are less dependable than I foresaw. I was just about to leave actually...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yeah, I don't blame you. If this were my club and only one person showed up, I'd give up too.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm not 'giving up'! I'm merely facing facts!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Isn't a person who 'faces facts' pretty much a quitter? I mean, it's all semantics.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm surprised you know that word.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm learning new ones everyday.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well... What would you have me do?!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You've got two people here. That's enough for the first meeting. Let's start discussing 'Frankenstein'.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You're serious? You've actually `read` the book? Not some cheat sheet?
nodes.text_bbcode: You're serious? You've actually [color=#3b78e2][i]read[/i][/color] the book? Not some cheat sheet?

nodes.text: Nate folds his arms over his chest.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You don't believe me? Go ahead. Quiz me. There's nothing I don't know about this book.
Paige runs across the blue mat awkwardly...
She does a handspring, barely keeping her momentum...
...Before finally launching into an ugly flip and landing right on her butt!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I mean... Oof!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: That was horrible!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just wait until you see some of my other moves!
During the rest of the practice, Paige is just as bad, tripping over herself, falling over, and flubbing every landing!
After yet another blunder...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I can't handle this! You're not fit to be President! I quit!
Jill starts to head out of the gym!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Jill, wait!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come back here!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Do you really think you're better than me at this?!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Are you kidding me?!
Jill defiantly turns, runs across the mat, and does a perfect front flip, sticking the landing with complete ease.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, big time.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I'm `way` better than you at this!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] better than you at this!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, why don't you run the club then?!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I've excused myself from my fair share of awkward moments.
...She has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on!
Paige races around to $ALLISON and Spencer's table, Kimi following behind her.
Paige whips out her phone, and sends $ALLISON a quick text!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What'd you say?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I told her I was bailing her out. That she just had to pretend that--

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: --I have to leave, Spencer! It's my sister! She's locked out of my parents' house, and I have to let her in!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You want some company?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh no! That's extremely kind of you, but I need to do this alone.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sure... Can we do this again?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes! I'd enjoy that! Bye!
$ALLISON hustles out of the booth, she mouths a 'thank you' as she passes Paige and Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Quick thinking!
Paige freezes up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't know what to do!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Urg! Just follow me!
Kimi races around to $ALLISON and Spencer's table, Paige following behind her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This was after me, so of course Lee was expecting perfection.
Kimi elbows Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Anyway, he vowed to never ever ever `ever` date another cheerleader again no matter how beautiful or red-headed she was.
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, he vowed to never ever ever [color=#3b78e2][i]ever[/i][/color] date another cheerleader again no matter how beautiful or red-headed she was.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Really?! He said `that.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Really?! He said [color=#3b78e2][i]that.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That sounds like a guy who could be Lee.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I guess it'll never happen then...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ooh, but I really want to date him!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, there is `one` thing you could do...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, there is [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] thing you could do...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And what's that?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, what's that, Paige?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You could change yourself to look like the kind of girls Lee is `really` into... Hipsters!
nodes.text_bbcode: You could change yourself to look like the kind of girls Lee is [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] into... Hipsters!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ugh. Really? Those girls with flannel dresses and thick-framed glasses?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Kind of the opposite of cheerleaders, right?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: OMG. That totally makes sense!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So? Could you stop cheerleading for a guy?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I guess it's really about what's more important to you...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, is it spending time on a cheerleading team `without` Jill?
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, is it spending time on a cheerleading team [color=#3b78e2][i]without[/i][/color] Jill?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Or dating the dimpliest guy in the whole school?!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Guys, you're never going to believe this, but I think I know already!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm quitting the team!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Wow! I'm so shocked!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I know! I'm so excited! I think I'm going to go pick out my hipster outfit at the mall right now!
Nicole skips off, ignoring the cheerleaders.
As Paige and Kimi are leaving the diner, Kimi notices Spencer and $ALLISON at one of the tables. She nudges Paige.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Psst! Look! I think they're on a date.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Let's go spy on them!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That seems like an invasion of their--
Before Kimi can finish her sentence, Paige drags her toward them!
$ALLISON and Spencer are sitting across from each other at their table, two cups of hot cocoa between them.
Paige and Kimi sit nearby, camouflaged by a cardboard cutout of a classic car.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Cocoa's better than coffee. Good call, Red.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I assumed that someone in peak physical condition didn't need a heavy dosage of caffeine.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You assumed right. Plus, if I have coffee I can't get my ten hours.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ten? Are you referring to the number of hours of sleep you get?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, you gotta have ten. That's what all the experts say!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: The experts say eight.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No way! Eight's not enough.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: If you ask me, eight is too many.
$ALLISON quickly looks it up on her phone and hands it to Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: See? Eight?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Awww, man.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hee! This whole time, you've been sleeping for too long!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Even worse, sometimes I force myself to sleep even when I'm not tired!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Maybe we `should` have coffee then!
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe we [color=#3b78e2][i]should[/i][/color] have coffee then!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha ha! Oh, you know what? I just remembered, I forgot to ask you how that book club thing went!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How'd it go?
$ALLISON's smile fades.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh... It was just an average social event...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Good turnout?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I would say suboptimal.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I am unsure of your conversational expectations...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So I've gotta twist it out of you? Tell me about it! What happened?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I would prefer to talk about any other subject.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Really? Why can't you talk about it?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well...
Meanwhile...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We've gotta do something!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do you mean?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I can't tell you what's going on, but I know something! We have to help $ALLISON out! We have to end their date, now!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What?! Lee finds me attractive and unattractive `at the same time?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! Lee finds me attractive and unattractive [color=#3b78e2][i]at the same time?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, it's a condition... Hotandnotitis?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I've never heard of that.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's because Paige is just kidding around!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh! That wasn't very nice!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I've never been good at nice.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Lee said he won't go out with you because you're a cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Why does that matter?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Because his last girlfriend was a cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: She was?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Good one! I mean...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...She was!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What's wrong with being a cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Everything. To Lee at least...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Because of what happened!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, what happened, Kimi?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh, I'd totally tell it, but you tell it so much better!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Guys, come on, tell me!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine. Um, Lee won't go out with you because... Uh...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because his last girlfriend was a cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: She was?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: She was?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Er... She was!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because... Um...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're unattractive?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah. For sure. Everyone.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh no, that means Lee probably knows!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He does. He totally knows.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Is it okay if I talk about him? I mean... I know you used to date him, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatevs. Talk away.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: He's super cute, huh?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I know, right! Whenever I see those dimples, I just want to squeeze his face!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I mean, uh... Yes.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, totally. His face is sooooo squeezable.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Wait... If he knows I like him, then that must mean he's not interested in me!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, that's what we wanted to talk to you about.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yup. Yup. Yup.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He `is` attracted to you.
nodes.text_bbcode: He [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] attracted to you.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But he told me that he'll `never` go out with you because...
nodes.text_bbcode: But he told me that he'll [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] go out with you because...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Really?! That's your big news?! Of course I'm interested in a boy!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: When am I `not` interested in a boy?!
nodes.text_bbcode: When am I [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] interested in a boy?!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! Do I have a problem?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whoa! This got deep fast.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We're not here to conduct a Nicole psych evaluation...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So? Why did I walk over here then?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... We wanted to talk about the guy that you like.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah! We just want to confirm who it is.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: If you must know, it's Lee. He's super hot!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Lee? My ex, Lee?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I mean, uh, that's what we thought.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So, you know?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Everyone knows!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh no, who told you about my crush on Lee?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Lee? My ex, Lee?!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Wait... What did you hear?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What you just told us!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We heard you like Lee!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Duh! But who told you?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, everyone. Everyone knows.
Paige runs forward, does an effortless handspring, and begins flipping end over end across the blue mat...
At the end, she tosses herself into the air and lands cleanly.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes!
She triumphantly pumps her fist into the air...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Still got it!
...Then she sees Kimi's face...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh whoops! I was supposed to flub my performance!
Jill follows after her, mimicking her moves exactly!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: It's on, Paige!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I guess it's time for Plan B... Challenging Jill's competitive spirit so much that she can't resist taking over!
Over the rest of the day, Paige tries to go head-to-head with Jill. At tumbling...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So...
At balance beam...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Tired...
On the rings...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So...
On the springboard...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Exhausted...
Finally, when Paige can barely stand anymore...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: This is the best thing I've ever done!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Please! Take my place! Run the club!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay, let's say I hypothetically helped you... And that's a huge emphasis on 'hypothetically'...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What about all the other cheerleaders?! Are they just collateral damage in your scheme?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's where you come in! We just need to get the most important cheerleaders to quit the team.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But they should all quit for `nice` reasons. Reasons you help me with because I'm... Well...
nodes.text_bbcode: But they should all quit for [color=#3b78e2][i]nice[/i][/color] reasons. Reasons you help me with because I'm... Well...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Not always 'nice'?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So I'm the moral compass here?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Pretty much.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And, hypothetically, who are our targets?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The most important cheerleaders are Keith, Jill, and Nicole. Take them out, and the whole pyramid comes crumbling down... Along with Maria's chances of winning Winter Queen!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If you help me, you'll get to take out a mean cheerleader `and` do some actual good in the process! Are you in?
nodes.text_bbcode: If you help me, you'll get to take out a mean cheerleader [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] do some actual good in the process! Are you in?

nodes.text: Kimi takes a deep breath and nods.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm in.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not hypothetically?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm `in.` For real in. Who do we go after first?
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]in.[/i][/color] For real in. Who do we go after first?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Jill. Meet me in front of the school after detention...
After detention...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So, how do we get Jill to quit?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Easy, we just have to take what we know about her and use it.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And what do we know about Jill? Besides the fact that she has pretty, `awesome` blue hair!
nodes.text_bbcode: And what do we know about Jill? Besides the fact that she has pretty, [color=#3b78e2][i]awesome[/i][/color] blue hair!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, she's the most athletic cheerleader by far.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: How do you know that?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You didn't think I'd go into this blind, did you?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Crazy of me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Anyway, is there some way we could appeal to her sense of athleticism?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We could lure her away with another sport, like lap-running or heavy thing-lifting.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh... Or we could try actual sports... That are actually fun.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Like what?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Like... A gymnastics tumbling club!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ooh! I love tumbling!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `You` tumble?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You[/i][/color] tumble?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I used to. And why is that so hard to believe?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: To tumble you have to, you know, sweat. And exert energy. Two things I've never seen you do.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That might be the case, but tumbling's different than other sports. There's something about flipping through the air a bunch of times that makes me feel better than everyone else.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's not a sports quote I expect to hear very often.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I like this tumbling club idea. Let's run with it.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hold on. Having Jill tumble a few times isn't going to be enough, is it? She won't just quit cheerleading.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're right. She won't just quit... Unless we give her incentive...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: How are we going to do that?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll figure that out later. For now, we can create the club on the school website! And we can do it right here on my laptop!
Paige and Kimi sit down on a bench, and Paige pulls out her laptop.
Later...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I can't believe how easy it was to create the Tumbling Club!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Our first meeting's in an hour, and Jill just signed up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Let's go then!
Inside the gym, gymnasts tumble across large blue mats, walk along narrow balance beams, and flip through the air in tight arcs.
Paige and Kimi are there, limbering up with some of the new club members. Kimi whispers to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Do you think Jill will show?! What if she doesn't show?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Relax, will you? She'll be here.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Have you figured out a plan?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes and no.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The only way Jill's going to quit cheerleading is if she becomes `the leader` of the Tumbling Club.
nodes.text_bbcode: The only way Jill's going to quit cheerleading is if she becomes [color=#3b78e2][i]the leader[/i][/color] of the Tumbling Club.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ooh, you're totally right.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But wait... Aren't you the leader?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Exactly. I just have to intentionally mess up while we're tumbling so that she'll step up and take my spot.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You think that'll work?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: An athletic girl operating under a klutzy President? I think Jill would rather... Do whatever Jill hates doing before she had to endure that.
Just then, Jill strolls into the gym.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Hope I'm not too late! I just wanted to run a few laps beforehand to get warm.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... Totally normal. We were just about to start tumbling!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Awesome! I'm really excited!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll go first to set an example. Everyone line up behind me!
The Tumbling Club members all get in a line behind Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, Paige, make sure you mess this up hard!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: For Owen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Neither of us can afford anything nice... So this Winter Dance night would be so special for both of us.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Does that mean anything to you?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmygosh, are you kidding?! Eeep! That was the nicest thing you've ever said!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I've said nice things before. I'm sure I have. Once maybe.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It doesn't matter! The fact that you're doing this only for Owen is `so` romantic!
nodes.text_bbcode: It doesn't matter! The fact that you're doing this only for Owen is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] romantic!

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, only for Owen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And as a bonus, I get to take Maria down a peg...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Maria deserves to eat a little crow.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Gross.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's an expression.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, it's a gross one, and this is exactly why I `don't` want to be a part of this!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it's a gross one, and this is exactly why I [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] want to be a part of this!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Revenge might feel sweet, but it's never worth it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That hasn't been my experience...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whatever. Now if you were doing this for love, I might actually care...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, I mean, I'm doing this for Owen too. We can't really afford the kind of special night we'd get if I became Winter Royalty.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Then why didn't you just say that in the first place?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A complete miscalculation of what actually matters to you?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just shut up and listen! In order to tell you my secret, I have to tell you about what happened last year...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh no... That means it's a big secret!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just listen!
Paige lowers her voice to a whisper...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It all started at the Homecoming Dance...
`The past...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]The past...[/b]

nodes.text: Paige pulls Lee out of the dance and into the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Where are you dragging me?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Somewhere more fancy and more fun!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: More fancy and fun than a fancy, fun dance?! Are you still trying to one-up Owen?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes! Now let's go!
Just then, Owen and Maria burst out of the dance, Maria clutching a crown and struggling to slow Owen down.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Where are you taking me?! The Homecoming Queen isn't supposed to `leave` the dance! My subjects are waiting to worship me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Where are you taking me?! The Homecoming Queen isn't supposed to [color=#3b78e2][i]leave[/i][/color] the dance! My subjects are waiting to worship me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on! We have to make sure we do something more fun than--
Owen stops talking when he sees that Paige is within earshot.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Oh, I get it. You're trying to make little Miss Used-To-Be-Somebody jealous.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did you just say what I think you said?!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You heard me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you doing out here with this `garbage sack,` Owen?! It isn't trash night, is it?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you doing out here with this [color=#3b78e2][i]garbage sack,[/i][/color] Owen?! It isn't trash night, is it?!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Grr!
Both girls march out across the parking lot, stopping just a few inches away from each other.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's your problem, cheerleader?!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I don't know, you tell me! I just won Homecoming Queen!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So?!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So?! You're not jealous?! That used to mean something to you!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not anymore.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And what if I told you I'm going to be the Winter Queen too?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hashtag who cares?!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So you're telling me even though all Winter Royalty get a limo, a special dinner, and a private ice skating session, you don't care?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I am `so` confused! What are you getting at?!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] confused! What are you getting at?!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What do you think?! You used to be a threat. I'm wondering if you still are!
Meanwhile, Owen nods at Lee from across the parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Just hanging out.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Cool.
Back with the girls...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't care about popularity contests anymore, Maria. I've moved on.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Well, that explains your look... And why you no longer get invited to parties. But I'm not buying this whole 'I don't care' act.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Watch your back, because if you try to win Winter Queen, I'll be stepping all over you!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: See you never.
`The present...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]The present...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ouch.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's not even the worst part. I just found out that Maria's starting a campaign to make me the Winter Jester at the dance this year!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Is that the guy who has to wear that ugly costume and hold that creepy scepter?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes! One, the jester's always a guy! And two, he's always someone goofy who doesn't mind being laughed at by the whole school!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You're neither of those!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know! So now you understand why I need your help.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Of course! You want me to start a separate campaign to sway the Jester vote away from you... I'm in!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Kimi, Kimi, Kimi... You're not thinking big enough...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...My New Year's resolution isn't to avoid becoming the Jester...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...It's to `become the Winter Queen!`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...It's to [color=#3b78e2][i]become the Winter Queen![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh... No offense, but that's impossible. Maria's going to be Queen... She's super trending right now.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're forgetting who you're talking to. I used to run this school.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Keywords, 'used to'. I mean, it'd be hard enough to get your popularity back, let alone bring down Maria.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: She's the Head Cheerleader, and as long as she holds that position, you'll...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You'll... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh no, I don't like that look...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're right. As long as Maria's the Head Cheerleader, she rules...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...That's why we're going to `end cheerleading.`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...That's why we're going to [color=#3b78e2][i]end cheerleading.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Shhh!
Kimi grabs Paige and yanks her into the girls' restroom!
Inside, Kimi quickly checks under all the stalls to make sure the restroom's empty.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Are you crazy?! You can't `end` cheerleading!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you crazy?! You can't [color=#3b78e2][i]end[/i][/color] cheerleading!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why not?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh, it's kind of important to school spirit and morale! Plus, every school has cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Relax, we're not ending it permanently, just long enough for me to become Winter Royalty.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `We?` Oh no, I'm out. Way out!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]We?[/i][/color] Oh no, I'm out. Way out!

nodes.text: Kimi covers her ears!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't even want to know what I already know!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But I need your help! Come on, Kimi! It's for a good cause!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What cause?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm doing it...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: --Frankly one secret is enough and, like, if I had known that announcing my resolution meant that `everyone` was going to tell me their secrets, I never never `never` would have announced it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: --I mean why am `I` the one who suddenly knows everyone's secrets! I didn't sign up for that!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Not that I mind! I totally don't mind! I've always heard that phrase 'secrets, secrets, are no fun!' but, like, whoever said that probably never had a secret ever because they are `way` fun!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you done?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, although I am suddenly feeling light-headed...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: --Frankly one secret is enough and, like, if I had known that announcing my resolution meant that `everyone` was going to tell me their secrets, I never never `never` would have announced it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But--

nodes.speaker: Kimi

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Not that I mind! I totally don't mind! I've always heard that phrase 'secrets, secrets, are no fun!' but, like, whoever said that probably never had a secret ever because they are `way` fun!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, although I am suddenly feeling light-headed...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But--

nodes.text: --I mean why am `I` the one who suddenly knows everyone's secrets! I didn't sign up for that!

nodes.text: But--

nodes.speaker: Paige

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, although I am suddenly feeling light-headed...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: --That everyone has to tell me their secrets 'cause $ALLISON already told me one and--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: --You know that `my` resolution is to keep all my secrets but that doesn't mean--
You are now playing as Paige.
On the way to detention, Paige grabs Kimi, pulling her aside.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We have to talk! Now!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: What is it?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's about my New Year's resolution!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You said you wanted to keep it private... Are you about to tell me a secret? Because--

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Tell him what you told us!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you quit, I've got a spot for you as an officer in the student government!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Wait... Really?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I'll actually have a say?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yep! And a pretty big one too!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Okay, I'll do it! I'll quit the team!
The next day, Paige and Kimi are sitting in detention with the rest of the Troublemakers...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Listen up, everyone! I know you're `all` really enjoying your studies, but I've got another surprise for you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen up, everyone! I know you're [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] really enjoying your studies, but I've got another surprise for you!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I love surprises! They're like the jelly beans of life!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What is it, Mr. Hart?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: We've created a brand-new app for Twin Branches!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh cool!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: You can 'shout out' about places you go and chat with your friends!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: `And` you can get achievements the more you use it! The achievements can actually be used toward extra credit.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]And[/i][/color] you can get achievements the more you use it! The achievements can actually be used toward extra credit.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Really? Interesting...
$ALLISON takes out her phone and searches for the app.
Mr. Hart turns to Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I'm guessing you're not interested.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Good guess.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Your loss.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If you say so.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Anyway, check it out, and don't worry about being quiet. You can talk about this with each other.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I'll be back in a little bit.
Mr. Hart steps out of the room.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So, did you guys hear that the cheerleading team disbanded?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That made me sad at first, but then I heard Jill's running a Tumbling Club and Keith's in student government!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Plus, it's generally hard to be sad when your girlfriend's transferring to your school!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's really happening?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yep! I'm 'shouting out' about it right now on the app!
Erik gives Owen a playful punch on the arm.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hnnnnng. Ow.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, sorry... Guess I don't know my own strength!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude, did Erik just hurt you... With a nerd-punch?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm fine. Just a little sore.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: From what? You're not playing basketball.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just, uh, lifting. Anyway... I'm happy for you, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, glad to hear that, Erik! And since I already told all of you about my secret admirer...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't feel like I'm violating my New Year's Resolution when I tell you that I got `another` letter!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't feel like I'm violating my New Year's Resolution when I tell you that I got [color=#3b78e2][i]another[/i][/color] letter!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? When did that happen?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: On the way to detention...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What did Romeo say this time?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: He said the number of hours before he confesses his feeling are like the years of a lifetime.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wow... This guy is in `deep.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow... This guy is in [color=#e23b3b][i]deep.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you going to date him when you find out who he is?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't know! No one's ever been this into me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Speaking of dates...
Owen turns to Spencer and $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How'd yours go?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh... It went...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It was... A date.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Playing it close to the vest, I get it.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We've got another one!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay... No need to get angry about it. I'm not prying.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! Paige!
Kimi hands her phone to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Did you see this? There's a section in the app for polls! There's already a question up about who should be Winter Royalty!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?! Really?! How's it looking?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Maria's not even in the top ten! And you're in the top five!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It looks like you're in.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I have so many people to thank.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So many? Who else?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just kidding. Just you, Kimi. I only have you to thank.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Awww! Well, think of me when you're enjoying your Winter Royalty date with Owen.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Er... You know what I mean.
