nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If you don't want to do something anymore, you shouldn't keep doing it.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: They're right.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course we're right!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's the only way that she gets what she deserves!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's not what I'm saying at all!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's not?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What I'm saying is that if Keith doesn't want to be on the cheerleading team anymore, he should do what I did... Quit!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, right... That's a good idea, too.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So?! What do you say, Keith?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...Something?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Grr! Do I have to do everything in this conversation?!
In the diner parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay, that's two down... That just leaves Keith. How are we supposed to get him to quit?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not sure actually.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What do we know about him?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He `really` cares about his hair, he's got a girlfriend in Canada, I think...
nodes.text_bbcode: He [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] cares about his hair, he's got a girlfriend in Canada, I think...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And ever since Hector graduated, he's the `only` male cheerleader.
nodes.text_bbcode: And ever since Hector graduated, he's the [color=#3b78e2][i]only[/i][/color] male cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, actually... Maybe there's something to that. Let's check out a practice tomorrow...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: See you there!
At cheerleading practice...
Paige and Kimi find seats in the bleachers.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, keep it quiet, Chen. We don't want them to know we're spying.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'll see what I can do.
Meanwhile, on the field...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Okay, everyone, listen up! When we do this dance here, really shake your hips, okay?! It'll look `so` cute!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, everyone, listen up! When we do this dance here, really shake your hips, okay?! It'll look [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] cute!

nodes.text: In the back, Keith raises his hand.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Maria? Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What, Keith?!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I'm not going to do that... So what should I do instead?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Ohmygosh, Keith! We go over this at, like, every practice! Whenever we do something cute or hot, just get out of our way!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And if you absolutely `have` to do something, just, I don't know, lift something, okay?
nodes.text_bbcode: And if you absolutely [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to do something, just, I don't know, lift something, okay?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Lift something?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Urg! Never mind! Let's just take a five minute break!
Back in the bleachers...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did you see that?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, Keith just got cheer served.
On the court, the cheerleaders stand in a circle, drinking from water bottles. Keith's blocked out of the circle...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So then I told her to tell him to tell me that `I` wanted a different kind of mascara!
nodes.text_bbcode: So then I told her to tell him to tell me that [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] wanted a different kind of mascara!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Harsh. It's like they're trying to exclude him...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I think I'm starting to see a pattern...
A few minutes later, practice ends...
All the girls head toward the girls' locker room, laughing and chatting, while Keith heads off alone toward the boys' locker room.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All right, I've seen enough. Come on!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Are we going to go into the guys locker room?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ew! No! We still have our dignity!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We are going to meet him outside... And not by ourselves.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Who are we bringing?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Someone who can light a fire under Keith better than anyone!
Keith steps out of the boys' locker room and finds Paige, Kimi, and `Taylor` waiting for him.
nodes.text_bbcode: Keith steps out of the boys' locker room and finds Paige, Kimi, and [b]Taylor[/b] waiting for him.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: What's up, girls?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not your self-esteem, that's for sure.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We saw your practice, Keith.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Aww, man. It's kind of sad, huh?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: From what they've told me, it's depressing, Keith!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Well, this is really fun... I love being cheered up.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, shut up! We're trying to help you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do you even like cheerleading anymore?!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Honestly, now that Hector's gone... It sucks.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So?!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: So... What?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So, do something about it! I didn't spend some of my best years as Head Cheerleader teaching you how to do things right, just so you could screw them up later!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: She's saying...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Those Wilson guys are going to `pay` for what they did.
nodes.text_bbcode: Those Wilson guys are going to [color=#e23b3b][i]pay[/i][/color] for what they did.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You mean 'at the next game', right?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I mean right now! I'm gathering up the guys, and we're heading over there for `payback!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean right now! I'm gathering up the guys, and we're heading over there for [color=#e23b3b][i]payback![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm going too! I've got a few choice words I'd like to share with those weasels.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa... I think we all need to slow down for a minute!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: There'll be plenty of time to slow down later. Now, it's time to put the smackdown on those jabronis!
Spencer storms out of the room, Paige marching just behind him! Flustered, Owen scrambles after them!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait! That's not how slowing down works!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: More or less...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I knew it!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No need to say anything. Your silence says it all!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Bruise?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All right, look... I can explain. I went over to that side of town because--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Stop right there. I know what's going on.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's obvious.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You went over there to try and get revenge on Wilson on your own! You didn't want the team to risk getting suspended, so you stood up for us... and those punks ganged up on you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Revenge? I... Well...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That `has` to be it. That's the only reason a loyal Twin Branches man like you would be caught dead on enemy ground. Right?
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#e23b3b][i]has[/i][/color] to be it. That's the only reason a loyal Twin Branches man like you would be caught dead on enemy ground. Right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen, is this true? Is that really what happened?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You weren't?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No. I was at Wilson.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't lie my way out of this one...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But... That would mean you got your bruise at `Wilson...`
nodes.text_bbcode: But... That would mean you got your bruise at [color=#3b78e2][i]Wilson...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was going to save them for... A special occasion!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh stop it, Owen! You're just digging yourself deeper! I know you didn't just buy fireworks.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Which means you probably got that huge `bruise` while you were at Wilson!
nodes.text_bbcode: Which means you probably got that huge [color=#3b78e2][i]bruise[/i][/color] while you were at Wilson!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: When 'the time is right'? Don't you trust me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Of course. But this is just something that's hard to explain. Something I have to sort out before I'm ready to talk about it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do you know what I mean?
Paige averts her eyes for a moment...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I... I think I do, actually.
Suddenly, the door bursts open!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Spencer? What's up?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't 'what's up' me! I know where you were just now!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen, what's he talking about?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Chris told me he saw you on the bus headed to the other side of town!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And there are only two reasons to go to the other side of town. Going to Wilson High, or going to buy fireworks!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Look. There's more to the story--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I can't believe you went to go buy fireworks without me! You know how much I love Purple Dragon Rockets!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You don't understand! I...

options.label: Was going to share the fireworks with you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nothing, huh?
Paige pokes at the bruise again, harder this time.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: OW!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's obviously a lie! Not to mention the laziest lie I've ever heard!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, okay! It's a long story... But I promise I'll tell you when the time is right.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You 'fell down'?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yup.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Which isn't really a lie! Nevermind that I fell because of getting slammed onto a wrestling mat over and over this afternoon.
Paige peers into Owen's eyes, studying him... Then sighs.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well... Be more careful, you dork.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I will. There's a story behind it, but I promise I'll tell you when the time is right.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This city was crying out for a hero. A symbol of justice to strike fear into the hearts of criminals--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: OW!
Owen recoils as Paige pokes at the bruise again, harder this time.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's a line from that movie you made me watch! I'm not dumb, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, okay! You're right, there's more to the story. But I'll tell you when the time is right.
Owen pushes with all his might, redirecting Skazz's momentum and rolling on top of him!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ha!
Now on top, Owen scores a quick, solid pin! The referee slaps the mat, signaling Owen's victory!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: No!
Owen climbs to his feet and extends a hand to Skazz...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Good match.
...But Skazz slaps his hand away!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I'll admit. You can wrestle. But you're `not` really one of us.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll admit. You can wrestle. But you're [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] really one of us.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Around here, you'll always be an outsider. And over there, you'll always be a traitor.
Later, after a long, grueling practice, Owen walks outside, nursing his aching shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I gotta remember to ice down this shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: `Beedle-dee-boop!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Beedle-dee-boop![/i]

nodes.text: Owen pulls out his phone!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Hey `Owen`! Did you say 'remember'? Would you like me to set a calendar reminder for `'ice down this shoulder'`?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey [i]Owen[/i]! Did you say 'remember'? Would you like me to set a calendar reminder for [i]'ice down this shoulder'[/i]?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, Branchi.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Awesome! Canceling reminder. Would you like to check in at your location of `'Wilson High School'`?
nodes.text_bbcode: Awesome! Canceling reminder. Would you like to check in at your location of [i]'Wilson High School'[/i]?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No! Never check in!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Okay! No problem!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: ...You have a calendar reminder in `20 minutes` for `'Study Session with Paige'`.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...You have a calendar reminder in [i]20 minutes[/i] for [i]'Study Session with Paige'[/i].

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Aw, man! I gotta get going!
Later, Owen rushes into the library back at Twin Branches, limping and out of breath.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... Sorry I'm... Late!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You'd better be sorry. These study session are some of the only times I get to see you. Where have you been?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just... Went for a run.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really? You just `had` to go running before our study session--
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? You just [color=#3b78e2][i]had[/i][/color] to go running before our study session--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait... What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't gimme that. You're all... Limpy.
Paige pokes Owen's shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ow!
Paige pulls aside Owen's shirt collar... Revealing the huge, dark bruise on his shoulder!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What the?!
She lifts Owen's shirt, revealing scattered bruises on his back from too many falls at practice.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's fine, don't worry about it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Too late. Don't move.
Paige exits to the hallway and comes back soon after with a cold canned soft drink from the vending machine.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's not ice cold, but it'll have to do.
She places the can gently against Owen's shoulder. He gives out a sigh.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks nothing! Tell me where you got this bruise!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're not in trouble, are you? This doesn't have to do with the 12th Street Kids again, does it?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No! I swear!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Then tell me what happened. And remember, I can `tell` when you're lying!
nodes.text_bbcode: Then tell me what happened. And remember, I can [color=#3b78e2][i]tell[/i][/color] when you're lying!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't lie... But I can't tell her about Wilson either! If word gets around to Spencer, he'll kill me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well... The thing is...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hrrah!
Skazz torques Owen's arm, wrenching him off balance!
Owen hits the mat with a thud!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Aah!
Skazz shifts his weight onto Owen, going for the pin! Desperate, Owen...
Owen shoots in low, grabbing Skazz's legs! Heaving upward, he lifts Skazz off his feet and dumps him to the mat!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Oof!
Covering him quickly, Owen scores a solid pin! The referee slaps the mat, signaling Owen's victory!
Owen escapes the lock! Skazz staggers a bit, and Owen spots an opening!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Now's my chance!
Owen meets Skazz's force, stopping his maneuver!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hrrr!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Not done yet...
Frustrated, Skazz attempts to catch Owen in an armlock!
Owen resists, but Skazz changes direction and tries to push him back!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're on.
Owen and Skazz gear up and take position on the mat, facing off...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You're going `down.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're going [color=#e23b3b][i]down.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: A fellow teammate volunteers to referee. He stands between them...
...And signals the start of the match! Owen grabs for his opponent's neck and shoulder, and Skazz does the same! They lock into a strained grapple!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hrrrah!
Skazz attempts to pull Owen off balance!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks. That could've went badly. We both might have lost our spots on the team for fighting.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Yeah, well, just be careful from now on. I won't always be there to protect you.
The wrestling team breaks into laughter.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just made myself look weak in front of the team... Probably not the best move...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Enough talk. I wanna see what this guy's actually got.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You think you did `me` a favor? You would've gotten booted from the team for fighting!
nodes.text_bbcode: You think you did [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] a favor? You would've gotten booted from the team for fighting!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Plus, you wouldn't have lasted ten seconds against me and my friends.
All around, Skazz's teammates break into 'ooh's' and chuckles.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Yeah... Well... So what?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So I won't be intimidated by this macho act. Save it for the mat.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Fine! Let's see what you got!
Owen closes the app as a bus pulls up to the stop. He climbs aboard, keeping his head down as he takes a seat. Suddenly...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Wait! Don't close those doors!
Chris comes bounding up the street, just barely making it onto the bus!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh no... Can't let Chris recognize me!
Owen pulls his hood lower, hiding his face as Chris comes down the aisle toward him!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Whoa! That was a close one! Good thing you're here with me!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: You're the best, Branchi!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Branchi?!
Owen peeks over to discover Chris sitting a few rows over... Talking to his `phone!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Owen peeks over to discover Chris sitting a few rows over... Talking to his [b]phone![/b]

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: No problem, `'Chris'`! I'm programmed with all of Centerscore's bus schedules! Is there anything else I can do for you?
nodes.text_bbcode: No problem, [i]'Chris'[/i]! I'm programmed with all of Centerscore's bus schedules! Is there anything else I can do for you?

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Yeah, update my status to... 'Headin' across town, gonna buy some firecrackers! Hashtag 'BOOM', hashtag 'LOL', hashtag 'Baby, you're a firework!'
Owen sinks down into his seat, breathing a sigh of relief.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whew...
Later, Owen arrives at Wilson High's gym, where their wrestling team sets up blue mats for practice.
Owen takes off his hoodie... Revealing the `Wilson High` singlet underneath!
nodes.text_bbcode: Owen takes off his hoodie... Revealing the [b]Wilson High[/b] singlet underneath!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Well, well. I knew I recognized your face from somewhere! You're the Twin Branches turncloak who tried out for our wrestling team!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Coach says you've got talent. That you might help us win a state championship. But all I see is a wannabe and a traitor.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Cram it, Skazz. I'm only here because my school doesn't have a wrestling team, and this is my `only` shot at a wrestling scholarship.
nodes.text_bbcode: Cram it, Skazz. I'm only here because my school doesn't have a wrestling team, and this is my [color=#e23b3b][i]only[/i][/color] shot at a wrestling scholarship.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Do your buddies on the basketball team know you're here?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I... They... What I do is `my` business.
nodes.text_bbcode: I... They... What I do is [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] business.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Ha. Figured. Look, I don't have a problem with some Twin Branches punk tagging along with us, as long as you know your place.
Skazz smirks, staring Owen down.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Trying to size me up, huh? Well, I'm not backing down.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Speaking of backing down... It was a good move, trying to break up the fight yesterday. Although I never got a thank you for saving your butt.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: If it weren't for me, that little confrontation after the basketball game would've broken out into a full-blown fight.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well...

options.label: Guess I owe you one, then.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Okay! What are you up to?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just waiting for the bus to Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Great! I've recorded your status as `'Just waiting for the bus to Wilson High'`. Would you like to post this to the public newsfeed?
nodes.text_bbcode: Great! I've recorded your status as [i]'Just waiting for the bus to Wilson High'[/i]. Would you like to post this to the public newsfeed?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?! Public newsfeed? `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! Public newsfeed? [color=#e23b3b][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `No one` can know where I'm about to go! No public posts!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]No one[/i][/color] can know where I'm about to go! No public posts!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Okay! Setting this update to 'private'!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Great. You do that. I gotta get through practice and be back in time for my study session with Paige, otherwise she'll kill me.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Cool! I'll set a calendar reminder!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah... Great.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Okay! You have a scheduled event starting in 20 minutes... `'Practice at Wilson High'`.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay! You have a scheduled event starting in 20 minutes... [i]'Practice at Wilson High'[/i].

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Don't remind me.` I feel shady enough as it is, sneaking around like this.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Don't remind me.[/i][/color] I feel shady enough as it is, sneaking around like this.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Got it! Canceling calendar reminder.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoa! I didn't mean that literally, but all right.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: You have one more event for today. `'Study Session with Paige'`.
nodes.text_bbcode: You have one more event for today. [i]'Study Session with Paige'[/i].

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do `not` cancel that reminder! If I miss it, Paige will kill me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Do [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] cancel that reminder! If I miss it, Paige will kill me.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Cool! I'll be sure to remind you then!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Huh. Well, I guess that `is` pretty convenient.
nodes.text_bbcode: Huh. Well, I guess that [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] pretty convenient.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Fine... What do you suggest then, we just turn tail and run?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We can't do that! They'll smell our fear!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just let me try and handle it.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Like... With words?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah... Something like that.
Owen steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: So what's it gonna be?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Yeah, you guys finally ready to step up?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's enough! None of us need this. It's probably better for `everyone` if we all just walk away!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's enough! None of us need this. It's probably better for [color=#e23b3b][i]everyone[/i][/color] if we all just walk away!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: That's never going to work. These Wilson cretins won't listen to reason!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Walk away?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Psshh.
Skazz steps forward, searching Owen... Suddenly, his eyes widen.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Guys... Let's just get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, what?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Like he says. It's just better this way! Let's go!
Darren and Steve follow as Skazz makes his exit.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Whew!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Good riddance.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Is everyone all right? Did anyone's blood get drained?
Spencer gives Owen a suspicious look.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Owen, how'd you get them to just give up like that?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... No idea! Guess I'm just really persuasive!
You are now playing as Owen.
The next day, Owen waits at a deserted bus stop after school. He pulls up the hood of his jacket and scans the sidewalk for anyone who might recognize him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Normally I'd drive, but I can't risk anyone recognizing me! No one can know where I'm about to go!
Suddenly, his phone vibrates and chimes in his pocket!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Huh?
Owen pulls out his smartphone and reads the display...
'Your Twin Branches app has been updated! Introducing `Branchi`, the new automated, voice-controlled interface for the TB App!
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Your Twin Branches app has been updated! Introducing [b]Branchi[/b], the new automated, voice-controlled interface for the TB App!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: 'Branchi'?

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: `Beedle-dee-boop!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Beedle-dee-boop![/i]

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Hello, `'Owen'`! I'm Branchi! I'll be your guide to the Twin Branches app!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hello, [i]'Owen'[/i]! I'm Branchi! I'll be your guide to the Twin Branches app!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Would you like to update your status or check the schedule on your calendar?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Um...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: As much as I wanna cream these dorks, Owen's got a point.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If Coach finds out there was a scrap, there's gonna be a world of trouble for us. We could get benched, or worse.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm tired of talk. Let's pound these Wilson dorks!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Hey! Are you guys done with your group huddle over there, or do you need more time to talk about your feelings?
Spencer clenches his fist and strides toward the Wilson guys with Jacob, Chris, and Andy in tow!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I got something for you to talk about right here...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: I'm shaking. You're all talk. You goodie-goodies wouldn't risk getting suspended by your coach!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Suspended?` I didn't think about that...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Suspended?[/i][/color] I didn't think about that...

nodes.text: Owen pulls Spencer back.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That was my point! Getting into a scrap could mean getting benched for the whole season!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: We should what?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I dunno, but I'm tired of talking. Let's pound these Wilson dorks!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are they really that bad?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: They're worse. I heard they steal all their plays from other schools.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I heard they all put steel plates in their shoes so they can kick other players in the shins.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I heard the Wilson team roams the countryside at night, draining the blood from herds of innocent goats.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: That's the mythical `chupacabra.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's the mythical [color=#e23b3b][i]chupacabra.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know! It's like no one is who they seem to be these days.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Anyway, Spencer's right! The Wilson guys are like our mortal enemies!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: The snake to our mongoose! The dog to our mailman!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I can't stand them, Owen. Them and everything they stand for...
Just then, the doors of the school swing open, and three guys stride out smugly.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Well, well, well... Are the Twin Branches boys trying to walk off that crushing defeat we just handed them?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Maybe they're just trying to air out the smell of `loser!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe they're just trying to air out the smell of [color=#e23b3b][i]loser![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Darren, Steve, you punks just got lucky. And Skazz, you're not even on the basketball team.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: No, I just came to see you Twin Branches guys get destroyed on the court.
Owen's eyes flash with sudden recognition, and he pulls Spencer aside.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey... Forget this, let's just get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No way I'm walking away from this! Can't make us look weak!
Spencer steps forward with his fellow teammates.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, we're not on the court now. You wanna see who gets destroyed out here?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Guys, cool it! Maybe we should just let it be!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Are you backing down, Owen?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No! I just mean... A fight could be more trouble than it's worth!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: But they disrespected all of us! We can't just let them get away with that!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Guys, we should...

options.label: Stand up to these Wilson jerks!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, I've played against Wilson too, but I didn't lose my cool. It's all part of sportsmanship, you know?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's the thing! They `have` no sportsmanship! No respect for the game!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's the thing! They [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] no sportsmanship! No respect for the game!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All they do is talk trash, and it's taken this rivalry to a whole new level!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoa... I didn't know that's how you felt.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, now you know.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What are you talking about? I've loved the game just as long as you! Played alongside you, even! Does that mean nothing?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Look, that's not what I meant.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I know you got love for the game, just like me. But I've been competing against Wilson longer, and those guys are the `worst.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I know you got love for the game, just like me. But I've been competing against Wilson longer, and those guys are the [color=#e23b3b][i]worst.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All they do is talk trash. No sportsmanship. No respect for the game!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoa... I didn't know that's how it was.

nodes.title: The Secret Life of Owen Harris
nodes.subtitle: What is Owen hiding from his best friends?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: `Rrraagh!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Rrraagh!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer flings the school doors open as he storms out, fuming!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why? Of all schools, why did we have to lose to `them?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Why? Of all schools, why did we have to lose to [color=#e23b3b][i]them?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer's basketball teammates come trailing behind him.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Come on, Spencer, we played a good game!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Yeah, shake it off, man!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We live to fight another day!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But we lost to `Wilson High!` I can handle losing, but not to `those` jerks!
nodes.text_bbcode: But we lost to [color=#e23b3b][i]Wilson High![/i][/color] I can handle losing, but not to [color=#e23b3b][i]those[/i][/color] jerks!

nodes.text: As Spencer continues to vent, Owen exits the building and joins them.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, Spence. I saw the game. Don't let it get to you man, you'll get 'em next time.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Easy for you to say, Owen. You're not on the basketball team anymore. We might have had a chance if you were still on the team!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah, Chris isn't the best replacement for your position.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: I'm standing right here, guys!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was sad to leave the team, Spence. But you know I'm trying to get a scholarship by any means necessary.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. You went bookworm and started studying like crazy.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah... Studying...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But you just don't understand how much I...
Owen maintains his grip and balance, pulling off the perfect sleeper hold! Skazz slowly drops to one knee!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Perfect! Now just pretend to go to sleep!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: No problem... Watch this!
Skazz raises his voice for all to hear...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: `Strength... Fading! Legs... Getting Weak!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Strength... Fading! Legs... Getting Weak![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: `Curse you, Owen! And curse Twin Brancheeeesss!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Curse you, Owen! And curse Twin Brancheeeesss!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Skazz sinks to the ground and shuts his eyes tight!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: A little over the top, but okay.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Lights out!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Whoa!
Owen stands over Skazz triumphantly and points at Darren and Steve.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Let that be a lesson to you! No one gangs up on someone from Twin Branches and gets away with it!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: What does he mean, 'gangs up on'?

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: I dunno! Whatever, let's just get Skazz and get out of here...
The two Wilson boys drag away Skazz, who lies convincingly limp.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Way to go, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Yeah, that was pretty awesome!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `La chupacabra` has been vanquished! Goats everywhere will sleep soundly tonight!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]La chupacabra[/i][/color] has been vanquished! Goats everywhere will sleep soundly tonight!

nodes.text: Owen's friends rush over to him, spouting praises.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. No big deal, guys.
Spencer puts a hand on Owen's good shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You know, yesterday, I was afraid for a second that you had gone soft on us. That you wouldn't stand by me against Wilson.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But now I know, you would `never` leave me hanging. You got more `loyalty` and `heart` then anyone I know.
nodes.text_bbcode: But now I know, you would [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] leave me hanging. You got more [color=#e23b3b][i]loyalty[/i][/color] and [color=#e23b3b][i]heart[/i][/color] then anyone I know.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah... Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now come on. Let's get some dinner. I'm starving!
The other guys head back toward the van. Owen lingers, as Paige sidles up beside him.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That was quite a show you put on.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ah, it was nothing. I just got lucky.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah. Especially lucky that he never went hard on your bruised shoulder. Not even once.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Maybe he never saw an opening.
Paige slips her hand into Owen's.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen, I hope you know that you can always be completely truthful with me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...I know. And you can do the same with me.
The two search each other's eyes, but the moment comes and goes in sweet and heavy silence.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on. We should get going.
The next day, the Troublemakers gather in the Student Lounge for detention with Mr. Hart.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Afternoon, everyone! I hope you all are having a great day and are ready for some community service!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hooray!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are we gonna get to do some `actual` community service this time? Picking up garbage? Washing dogs, maybe?
nodes.text_bbcode: Are we gonna get to do some [color=#e23b3b][i]actual[/i][/color] community service this time? Picking up garbage? Washing dogs, maybe?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Oh, that was the old program! We're more 'new school' here!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm not sure that turn of phrase is as impactful within the context of an actual school...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: What I'm trying to say is, we're gonna do something different! Everyone take out your phones!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'll pass.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, come on, Spencer! When else are we allowed to use our phones at school?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Never. That's why it's weird.
Except for Spencer, everyone pulls out their phones.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I hope y'all have updated your Twin Branches smartphone apps!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, and got that Branchi thing asking me questions? It's kinda cool... But also kinda...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Dorky? Creepy? Nosey?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Aw, I think Branchi is cute! It's like a diary that you can actually talk to!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I like to think of Branchi as an invisible workplace acquaintance. We enjoy small talk but respect each other's personal boundaries! Like a coworker, who is also a ghost!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't even... Erik... What?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think you all are being a little generous. 'Branchi' lacks the A.I. for any significant conversation or comprehension. At best, it's a voice control interface reading from a bank of canned responses.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Well, aren't you six just the `brightest` bunch? I'm gonna have to put on my `sunglasses` in a minute!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, aren't you six just the [color=#e23b3b][i]brightest[/i][/color] bunch? I'm gonna have to put on my [color=#e23b3b][i]sunglasses[/i][/color] in a minute!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...Barf.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: But seriously, your '`fun`-munity' service assignment is to help test out the new Branchi feature on the Twin Branches smart phone app!
nodes.text_bbcode: But seriously, your '[color=#e23b3b][i]fun[/i][/color]-munity' service assignment is to help test out the new Branchi feature on the Twin Branches smart phone app!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: So go wild! Post some statuses! Check out your friends' profiles! Check-in and let everyone know you're here at the Student Lounge! Or as I like to call it, 'Good Times Central', am I right?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: The sky is the limit with this new--

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: `Beedle-dee-boop!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Beedle-dee-boop![/i]

nodes.text: All at once, every phone in the room chimes with an alert! Then, a deep, robotic voice begins speaking form each device...

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: `...Students of Twin Branches. I am the Town Crier. I have hijacked your app to bring you the truth.'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's not Branchi...

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: `This recording comes as a warning.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]This recording comes as a warning.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: `Do not trust your new technology.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Do not trust your new technology.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: `You are being watched.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]You are being watched.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: `Your words are being recorded.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Your words are being recorded.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: `No one's secrets are safe. No one's.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]No one's secrets are safe. No one's.[/i]

nodes.text: The audio cuts away, leaving the room in a tense, stunned silence...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Well, someone sure has a heaping helping of explaining to do...

Owen's grip falters, and he falls from Skazz's back, hitting the asphalt with a thud!

nodes.text: I... I can explain!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Is this some kind of act? Are you guys working `together?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Is this some kind of act? Are you guys working [color=#e23b3b][i]together?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, Skazz--

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Forget it, man! I'm out. This is `your` problem!
nodes.text_bbcode: Forget it, man! I'm out. This is [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] problem!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen, what did you do?
Helpless, Owen looks around to faces of anger and disappointment, and he knows...
...He has failed.

nodes.text: Sorry, but I'm not taking a dive for `anybody`... Especially some Twin Branches punk!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, but I'm not taking a dive for [color=#e23b3b][i]anybody[/i][/color]... Especially some Twin Branches punk!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `AAAH!`

nodes.text: Owen!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Let's get 'em!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait! No!
As the sounds of scuffling and shouting surround him, Owen is helpless to stop the chaos! Dreading the inevitable fallout out this conflict, deep inside he knows...
...He has failed.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well then... What if I said I could help Wilson get a state wrestling championship?
Owen reverses the lock, catching Skazz in a lock of his own!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You've got to play along, because...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You can't threaten me! I'm not scared of you!

nodes.speaker: Owen

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No trick! Just listen! And keep your voice down!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Well? Got nothing to say?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just let me explain!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can beat any one of them in a fair fight. Give me a chance to... You know, defend my honor!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah... I can respect that. We'll hang back and let you do your thing... But if things go south, we're rushing in!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Deal.

Owen assumes a wrestling stance but whispers to Skazz in a lowered voice.

nodes.text_bbcode: Er, uh... [color=#3b78e2][i]You're missing some children's sized...[/i][/color] Gloves?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, yes... How dare you expose the secret of my tiny hands.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hate to break it to you, dude. But we all know about your little girl hands.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?! I don't have--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Er... I should've never hid it from you.
Owen resumes whispering to Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You almost ruined me!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry! But you should know that telling me that size of a secret is hazardous!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Apparently!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anyway...
Kimi manages to stifle her urge to shout, whispering instead.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: For real?! That's a big deal, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know, but right now we don't really have time to discuss the finer details.
Kimi lets the news sink in for a moment...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Kimi? You okay? You're kind of frozen...
Just then, Owen forces himself in between Kimi and Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey! Watch it!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sorry! I just `really` need to talk to Kimi.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry! I just [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] need to talk to Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine. She and I are done anyway.
Paige gets up, leaving Owen and Kimi alone.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What is it?
Owen whispers to Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Promise me you'll keep this quiet...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh no. Not another one...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do you promise?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I... I promise.
Owen leans over and whispers in Kimi's ear.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm on the wrestling team... At Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You promise?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, I give you my word.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's not good enough.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well that's all I've got.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever. Just don't mess this up.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks for the advice, friend.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You promise?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, I give you my word.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's not good enough.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well that's all I've got.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever. Just don't mess this up.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks for the advice, friend.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Remember?! I helped you take down the cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: If you get caught, I will too!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, that's right! Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, glad I could be of help. It's nice to know you trust me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I trust you! I'm just freaking out!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I know. Me too.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You promise?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, I give you my word.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's not good enough.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well that's all I've got.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever. Just don't mess this up.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks for the advice, friend.
Kimi sits there, blank-faced...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hello?! Earth to Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, sorry... I don't know what happened there.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So? Reassurance?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, I promise I'll do it.
You are now playing as Spencer.
Back outside the bookstore...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Did it work? Did you guys get permission?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We did!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't ask me how though. Owen just started talking funny and that did the trick.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I'm glad funny talking worked!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Me too! Thanks, buddy!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No problem!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, so... I guess that just leaves one question.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why am I here?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, why is he here?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, right. The first half of tonight was all about convincing.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But the second half is all about... Uh... Wooing.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're going to woo me, Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Should I leave?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No! I just want some advice on how to make tonight perfect for $ALLISON!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And you and Emily are all in love and stuff.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You must know what you're doing.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That means a lot to me, buddy.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey! Paige and I are in love too, you know.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whatever. I already know how to fight.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What do you say, Kale? Are you going to help me or not?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll do more than help... I'll let you in on my top tips for a successful first date!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What are they?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: First, you've got to compliment her in a way she's `never` been complimented before.
nodes.text_bbcode: First, you've got to compliment her in a way she's [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] been complimented before.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Second, you've got to make her laugh `hard` at least once.
nodes.text_bbcode: Second, you've got to make her laugh [color=#e23b3b][i]hard[/i][/color] at least once.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And third, kiss her early!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Early?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah! Instead of waiting for the typical moment at the end of the date, kiss her before then.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It'll be romantic `and` it'll take off all the pressure! You won't be nearly as nervous.
nodes.text_bbcode: It'll be romantic [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] it'll take off all the pressure! You won't be nearly as nervous.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I like that. Good tips.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not bad, actually.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm just honored that you asked for my advice.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just don't send a twerk or whatever about it on your phone.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, don't worry, I won't.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't want Mr. Hart to know everything I'm doing.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not that it matters...
He gives Owen a friendly punch to the arm.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Can't be hurt if you've got nothing to hide, right? We've got no secrets!
Owen inconspicuously rubs his arm.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Right, no secrets...
You are now playing as Kimi.
The next day, as detention winds down, Mr. Hart chuckles softly to himself.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Well, I didn't receive any tips on our Town Crier.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Then why do you seem so happy?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Because obviously I was right about our prankster! One threatening text blast, and where is he?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Gone. Scared away by my promise to bring him to justice!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Facing a real threat, your Town Crier is nothing more than a--

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: `Beedle-dee-boop!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Beedle-dee-boop![/i]

nodes.text: Once again, everyone's phone chimes at once! A deep robotic voice comes through each device.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: This is the Town Crier.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: I have made a difficult decision. I am going to send all of you a link and a password.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: This will give you access to `everything` the administration has been gathering on you.
nodes.text_bbcode: This will give you access to [i]everything[/i] the administration has been gathering on you.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: The decision is difficult because it also exposes `everything` you've been keeping private.
nodes.text_bbcode: The decision is difficult because it also exposes [i]everything[/i] you've been keeping private.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: By exposing them, I'm reluctantly exposing you. But it is the only way to bring them down.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: You have only a few hours before they'll be able to get through my code and take down the site. Good luck.
The Troublemakers turn to Mr. Hart, glaring daggers at him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You lied to us!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: To our faces!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You acted like I was crazy, but I was right!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Listen--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: How could you do this, Mr. Hart?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah, how could you?!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Listen--

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: We actually trusted you... And you betrayed us!
Mr. Hart slams his palm down on the desk!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Listen! Any of you say one more word about this to me and I will have you suspended `so fast` you won't know what day it is!
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen! Any of you say one more word about this to me and I will have you suspended [color=#e23b3b][i]so fast[/i][/color] you won't know what day it is!

nodes.text: Spencer starts to say something, but $ALLISON covers his mouth!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hmmmph!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Don't. He's serious.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Very serious. Now sit `down.` All of you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Very serious. Now sit [color=#e23b3b][i]down.[/i][/color] All of you.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: This is `still` a detention. That means you will be quiet and seated while I fix this boo-boo!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#e23b3b][i]still[/i][/color] a detention. That means you will be quiet and seated while I fix this boo-boo!

nodes.text: The Troublemakers slowly sit down, eying each other as Mr. Hart furiously types on his computer, distracted.
They all carefully pull out their phones.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Psst! It looks like the nerds are heading over to the computer lab right now!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: They're going to log in and grab as much information as they can!
Paige switches seats, putting herself right next to Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You `have` to go over there and stop them from getting my information!
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to go over there and stop them from getting my information!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What? Why?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because!
Paige lowers her voice so only Kimi can hear!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because of what I did to the cheerleading team! If Owen ever found out I purposefully demolished it to get at Maria, he'd probably dump me!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You guys can't break up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, that's what going to happen!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's not a problem if you didn't write anything down about it!
Paige shoots Kimi a look.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You wrote something down about it?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Wait... Why am I the one who has to do something about it?! Why can't `you` do something about it?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... Why am I the one who has to do something about it?! Why can't [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] do something about it?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because! You've actually spent time with the nerds! You're friends with Ben! And you know Kevin--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You're talking about Kevin, the guy I had a really bad breakup with? That Kevin? That's my in?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's better than mine!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Look, you'd be doing me a `huge` favor. I `never` beg, and I'm begging you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, you'd be doing me a [color=#3b78e2][i]huge[/i][/color] favor. I [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] beg, and I'm begging you!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Fine. I'll do it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How do I know?! I have to know that you are for real going to do something.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Oh yeah? What's that?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's a beautiful girl like you doing in a store like this.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Beautiful? You think `I` look beautiful?
nodes.text_bbcode: Beautiful? You think [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] look beautiful?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you kidding? It's like you're robbing my breath with your looks.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Robbing?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ha! Yep!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I wish we could rob girls with `our` looks!
nodes.text_bbcode: I wish we could rob girls with [color=#e23b3b][i]our[/i][/color] looks!

nodes.text: Quick as a flash, the girl is holding a can of pepper spray and pointing it at Owen and Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... What.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Don't move! I've already triggered the alarm! The police are on their way!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoa! Whoa whoa whoa whoa whoa! We're not trying to rob you! We're just trying to flirt with you for favors!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, that sounds bad. But, it's not as bad as--

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Shut up, or I'll spray you! I swear!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: She's totally bluffing!
Spencer reaches for the can of pepper spray, and she pulls the trigger, filling the air with a burning, fiery mist!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hack! Hack! Hack!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: She! Hack! Wasn't bluffing!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why did you even test her?!
Owen and Spencer collapse to the floor, completely immobilized by the spray. In the distance, a police siren wails, growing ever closer...
From his position on the ground, all Owen can think is...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was just doing Spencer a favor...
And deep down he knows that...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Oh yeah? What's that?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: My friend would really like to have a romantic dinner date here.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: That `is` weird. I don't know...
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] weird. I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sounds like you're saying we shouldn't `book` a reservation here...
nodes.text_bbcode: Sounds like you're saying we shouldn't [color=#e23b3b][i]book[/i][/color] a reservation here...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Heh.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh... Heh.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll try not to `read` anything into that laugh.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll try not to [color=#e23b3b][i]read[/i][/color] anything into that laugh.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh... Ha ha.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: I don't know, I might be able to let you come in next week...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It'd mean a lot to me and my friend if it were tonight...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I don't want to cause any `fiction` between us.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I don't want to cause any [color=#e23b3b][i]fiction[/i][/color] between us.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Ooh. That was bad.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, it was.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Totally... Bad.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: But, you know what they say? Even a bad pun is mightier than the sword.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. Nice one.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Your friend can have dinner here... But he has to supply everything!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: And if anything happens to any of the books, it's coming out of his wallet.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Got it. Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: So the Town Crier isn't you. No matter.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I can squash this instigator quickly regardless of who it is.
Mr. Hart logs onto his computer and types out a message. A moment later...

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: `Beedle-dee-boop!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Beedle-dee-boop![/i]

nodes.text: All the phones in the room chime at once.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Recently, we had a mild security breach with our app. If anyone has any information on who the perpetrator is, please inform the administration.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: You will remain anonymous and receive a monetary reward for your good deed!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: In the meantime, please continue to enjoy the Twin Branches app with confidence.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: That should cover it.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's your answer? Get the students to rat on each other?!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Yes, actually. The motivation of a reward should be enough.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I expect to know who this Town Crier is by the end of the day!
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Psst! Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You seem, I don't know... Happier than usual. Something up?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yup! I'm planning a big date with $ALLISON!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nice.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Actually, if you're not busy after school, I could use your help with something...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure I don't have wres--Er, I don't have anything going on today!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Cool cool! See you then!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Bye!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, and look sharp because I need you to charm a nerdy girl!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait... What?!
That night, Spencer and Owen meet up with their friend Ben outside of a used bookstore.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Where you been, Kale?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, seems like forever since I saw you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You both saw me in class `this morning!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You both saw me in class [color=#e23b3b][i]this morning![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, right. Well, it feels like a long time.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess I have been spending a lot of my free time with Emily lately...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And we've been spending a lot of our free time... Not free at all. Stupid detention.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well maybe I'll throw a party to get everyone together again!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That sounds awesome!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Anyway... What are we doing outside of a bookstore?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Preparing! I'm trying to plan the `perfect` date with $ALLISON!
nodes.text_bbcode: Preparing! I'm trying to plan the [color=#e23b3b][i]perfect[/i][/color] date with $ALLISON!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So you're getting her a book?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Better. We're going to have dinner here!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Have you been playing football without a helmet again?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Real funny, dorkus.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Seriously, I'm not sure this needs to be said, but... This isn't a restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I know it isn't! But that doesn't mean it can't become one, at least for tomorrow night!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You know how much $ALLISON loves books. How happy would she be to have dinner with me in a bookstore?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll admit, if you can pull it off, you'd be pretty much the man.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But it's a big `if`. How are you going to swing dinner at a bookstore?
nodes.text_bbcode: But it's a big [color=#e23b3b][i]if[/i][/color]. How are you going to swing dinner at a bookstore?

nodes.text: Spencer turns to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Someone` is going to convince the nerdy girl who works there for me!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Someone[/i][/color] is going to convince the nerdy girl who works there for me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is 'someone' you? I really hope 'someone' is you.
Spencer pats Owen's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sorry, bro. Someone is you.
You are now playing as Owen.
A moment later, Owen and Spencer are standing at the front counter.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't understand why you need me for this. You're a big boy. You can't ask for permission?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you kidding?! Do I need to remind you what happens when I try to be nice to salespeople?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The coffee incident...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I asked for this `without` cream!
nodes.text_bbcode: I asked for this [color=#e23b3b][i]without[/i][/color] cream!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The Sports Hut...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `'Where are my manners?!'` You're going to be missing more than my manners in a second, buddy!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]'Where are my manners?!'[/i][/color] You're going to be missing more than my manners in a second, buddy!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And of course...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The Tech Mart disaster.
Spencer stands in the middle of an electronics store without power, a blown out speaker fizzling weakly behind him.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grrrrrrrrr! I said, `I WANT TECH SUPPORT!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Grrrrrrrrr! I said, [color=#e23b3b][i]I WANT TECH SUPPORT![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I forgot about that.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, well, that's why I need you.
A bookish sales clerk approaches. Owen notices a sticker on the cash register that says 'The early word gets the (book)worm!'. Spencer talks to Owen under his breath.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Remember, get her to give me permission. And I don't care how you get it, just get it!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: How can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, actually, we have kind of an odd request...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Doesn't that count as an alibi or something?!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: No! You could have easily timed the message to occur while you were in detention!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?! How is that even possible?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You just set a timer on the text blast.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah, it wouldn't be very hard to do, as long as you had the right program.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Super easy, dude.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Okay, I get it. Everyone's a tech genius but me. Doesn't that prove my innocence?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: You really don't know anything about technology do you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, I have a phone!
Spencer pulls out an old, gigantic phone. The Troublemakers gasp!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did you buy that in the 90's?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Shut up. All of you.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Crying is for wusses!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If I were the Town Crier, my name would be 'Blast Master' or 'Technotron' or something really cool like...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `'Amaze-o Deluxe'!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]'Amaze-o Deluxe'![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I hate to say it, but never has anyone been exonerated in fewer sentences spoken...

nodes.title: Exposed
nodes.subtitle: When secrets are revealed, nothing will ever be the same...

nodes.text: You are now playing as Spencer.
The day after the Town Crier's announcement...
In detention, the Troublemakers are angrily crowded around Mr. Hart's desk...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What is this about us being watched?!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I can assure you--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And our words being recorded?!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: There's nothing to--

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Or our secrets not being safe?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I used the school site to write some of my most private thoughts. I thought I was doing so `in private!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I used the school site to write some of my most private thoughts. I thought I was doing so [color=#3b78e2][i]in private![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: You were! Please, everyone, if we could all just take some chill pills, I think you'll find there isn't anything to be worry-warts about!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Prove it!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Now, now... There's no way for me to prove the administration isn't spying on you.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ha! So you are!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: But I also can't prove that this room isn't... Full of ghosts!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ha! Ghosts!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: ...It's not, right? 'Cause ghosts aren't real... Right?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: The burden of proof is on this Town Crier.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: And guess what, he hasn't supplied any evidence... Because there is none! The system is secure, I assure you!
The Troublemakers ease back from Mr. Hart's desk.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So... It isn't true then?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: No, it isn't! This Town Crier is probably just some prankster, someone trying to rile all of you up against me, someone with major issues with privacy...
Everyone turns to Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Sounds a lot like you, Mr. Cooper.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You think `I'm` the Town Crier?! That's impossible!
nodes.text_bbcode: You think [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] the Town Crier?! That's impossible!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Is it? You and I haven't exactly seen eye-to-eye. And you were one of the only students to refuse a laptop.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Pfft. That's true, but...

options.label: I was here when the message was sent!
I'd never call myself the Town Crier!

nodes.text: His phone buzzes in his pocket, startling him!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa!
$ALLISON slinks back.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, sorry. I should have turned that off.
As he goes to turn off his phone, he sees that he's got a text from Ben.
He glances at it, then stops, his eyes going wide!
Spencer looks up at $ALLISON...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What is it, Spencer? What's happened?
To be continued!
