nodes.text: Spencer hesitates... And the moment passes.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So, some interesting literature around us.
As $ALLISON moves on to talking about literature, Spencer knows that he's missed a golden opportunity...
...One that will never present itself again.
He knows that...
He leans forward, and with his hand, he cups her face, bringing her closer to him...
Spencer leans forward, closes his eyes, and puckers his lips ever so gently for his first kiss with $ALLISON...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm trying to kiss you.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You thought that `now` was a good time for it.
nodes.text_bbcode: You thought that [color=#3b78e2][i]now[/i][/color] was a good time for it.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I did. Until you said what you just said.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, it wasn't.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, now I know.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: `Now` is too late. Everything feels really uncomfortable.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Now[/i][/color] is too late. Everything feels really uncomfortable.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So, what are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm saying... Take me home.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you serious?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Does it seem like I'm joking?! I want you to take me home `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Does it seem like I'm joking?! I want you to take me home [color=#3b78e2][i]now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine.
Spencer pulls her out of the bookstore and into his car.
On the way back to $ALLISON's house, he realizes that he'll probably never go on another date with her again...
He realizes with certainty that...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's not like you left so you could start an anti-Spencer club.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: An anti-Spencer club?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, you know, down with Spencer! He's so dumb, he has to take off his shoes to count past ten!
$ALLISON doubles over with laughter.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So funny! I can just imagine you counting on your toes!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heh. You don't have to tell me about that book club meeting...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So... How was that?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You definitely scored some points.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If that got me points, I can't wait to know how many points this gets me!
Spencer takes off $ALLISON's blindfold, revealing a small table in the back of the store.
On the table are a bouquet of flowers, some candles, and a tablecloth made to look like book covers.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I know, it's weird. But, look.
Spencer points at the tablecloth, knocking over one of the candles.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoops. Glad that's not lit.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And these are books. Because you like books. And I don't know if you saw, but we're in a bookstore.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Are we having dinner here?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. We are. It's our second date... Or the second half of our first date. Kinda depends on how you do math...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But it's special. And I thought maybe we could do something neither of us have ever done before.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, I've never had dinner in a bookstore...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Do you like it?
$ALLISON nods, smiling.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I love it.
A few moments later, during dinner...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Okay. My turn. I have never told anyone this, but I... I really like reading trashy novels.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heh!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Why is that so humorous?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Because even your confession is still about you doing something smart.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Okay, fine. I occasionally watch a sport on television.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? Really? What sport?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's embarrassing, but... I enjoy watching basketball.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes. I get inspired by athleticism, and there's a certain elegance to the game.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That is so awesome!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Have I earned points now too?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you kidding?! You just slam dunked some points!
$ALLISON suddenly goes quiet...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What is it? What'd I say?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Nothing... I just feel like before the night continues, we should discuss what transpired during our previous date.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, it was no big deal. Did you help your sister out?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What? Oh... Well... Don't worry about that. Amanda's fine.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What I really want to say is--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You know what? Whatever it is you're going to say, you don't have to.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think you might want to hear--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's no big deal, $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And by the way, tonight, in that dress, you look like The Red Amazon... When she's not in the ring.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I take it from context that she's a wrestler?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: One of the best! When she's in the ring, she's all muscle-y and sweaty.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But when she's doing interviews or whatever, she looks like my dream girl, she looks how you look now.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not that I'd rather be here with the Red Amazon! I just meant...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I know what you meant. I don't think anyone's ever said anything like that to me before...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... How do you know she's into Nate?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: She wrote about it in this diary... 'Do I really have feelings... For Nate?!'.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer's planning a big date with her right now. He has to know.
Ben takes out his phone to text Spencer, but Kimi rushes over to him.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, Ben. Please. Don't tell him. It'll ruin everything!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, Kimi. He's my bro. I have to.
Ben types out a text and sends it.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry, $ALLISON, you're on your own now...
You are now playing as Spencer.
Spencer, beaming, holds the door to the used bookstore open and lets in a blindfolded $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I cannot comprehend how impaired vision will increase my joy...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...Especially when you consider that you already led me into that bush!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, I'm not the one who walks three times faster when she's got a blindfold on.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I do not!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Do too. You're like one of those little dogs with tiny feet.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Comparing me to a dog is not going to win you any points tonight, you know?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, right. Did I forget to tell you how you look in that dress?
$ALLISON blushes.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You did not say anything. Though I did note how you sucked in a little air.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Humans call that gasping.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Are you making fun of how I speak?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No. I'd never do that.
The moment gets quiet...
Kevin stares at Kimi for just a moment...
...Then returns to his computer monitor.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: No, you don't. You want something from me.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What? How do you know?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Because I'm still the 'distant' guy who plays video games all the time.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Aww, Kevin...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Please, spare me your pity.
Kevin clicks on $ALLISON's entry.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Whoa! Hey, everyone, according to this diary entry, $ALLISON's into that Nate guy.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Can you send me that file?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Sure thing!
Before Kimi can react, Kevin sends the file to Dex.
Kevin stops for a moment, then skips over $ALLISON's diary entry.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah, I am. But I'm not doing this for you. I'm doing this for $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: If what's in here is devastating enough for you to talk to me, it must be really bad.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks, Kevin... We had our problems, but I always thought you were nice.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Hooray for being nice.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'll go now.
A moment later, Kimi settles into a chair, sighing with relief.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I did it! I got them all!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Well, would you look at that? According to this, that $ALLISON girl has quite the secret! Looks like she's into Nate, of all people.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uh, how'd you find stuff on her? Weren't you starting at the Z's?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Oh, I thought you said `you` were starting at the Z's. Whoops.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I thought you said [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] were starting at the Z's. Whoops.

nodes.text: Kimi notices that Kevin is grabbing all the diary entries that start with A and is almost at $ALLISON Applebee's!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ahem. Hey, Kevin.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Whatever.
Kimi gets close to Kevin, whispering...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Listen, can you... Can you do me a favor?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: That's funny. It sounded like `you` asked `me` for a favor.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's funny. It sounded like [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] asked [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] for a favor.

nodes.text: Kevin moves the cursor to just below $ALLISON's entry.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: See that entry by $ALLISON? Can you skip that one?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Why would I do something for you after you dumped me?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Because...

options.label: I want to get back together!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: No, it's not. It's just a simple click.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, but if someone's checking in from Wilson High, they're probably just getting fireworks.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Still, better safe than sorry.
Ashley's cursor moves toward the file...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I've gotta do `something!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I've gotta do [color=#3b78e2][i]something![/i][/color]

nodes.text: ...Kimi reaches over and powers off Ashley's computer!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: What'd you do that for?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh, it sounded like it was overheating!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: No, it didn't.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, you can't hear it `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you can't hear it [color=#3b78e2][i]now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: And I didn't hear it then!
Ashley angrily powers her computer back on.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I `hope` you didn't wipe my progress!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]hope[/i][/color] you didn't wipe my progress!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And I hope you forget where you were...
Sure enough, when Ashley's machine reboots, she resumes in a different spot.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: It is?! How do you know?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Come on, what's more likely?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Someone checking in at Wilson High when it `isn't` firework season...
nodes.text_bbcode: Someone checking in at Wilson High when it [color=#3b78e2][i]isn't[/i][/color] firework season...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...Or a virus that one of those jerks from Wilson High managed to insert into the system?!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Ohmygosh, you're right! Thanks, Kimi. That was close!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You're welcome, Ashley!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And you're very welcome, Owen!
As Ashley moves on to another section...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Nope.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Huh. Guess my mind's slipping. Oh well.
While Ben blissfully forgets about Paige's 'Musing', Kimi hears Ashley mumbling to herself...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: That's odd... There are a bunch of check-in files from Wilson High here...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Owen!
Kimi spins toward Ashley!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Don't click on that!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: What? Why not?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ben loves parties. Good idea!
The girls hurry over to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So, Ben, I heard you're thinking about throwing a party...
Ben's eyes don't move from the machine.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh huh...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What's the party for?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Huh? Sorry, I'm kind of focused on this right now...
Ben is about to click on Paige's 'Musing'...
...When Kimi leaps across him and smacks the mouse out of his hands! It skitters across the floor!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Bet you didn't see that coming!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're right, I didn't expect to be attacked by my friend while I'm doing something time-sensitive and important!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry...
As Ben scrambles to pick up his mouse, Kimi refreshes the page. A second later, Ben returns...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Was this where I was? Did you touch my machine?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Kissing? Really?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: He's a guy. Trust me!
The girls hurry over to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So, Ben, Kimi and I were just talking about... What a good kisser you are.
Ben stops working.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh really?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh, yeah. The best actually.
Ben swivels in his computer chair, smiling.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Were you wondering how I perfected my techniques?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I wasn't, but now I'm curious.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well...
As Ben distractedly talks to Emily, Kimi leans over and refreshes the page on his machine.
A moment later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: In conclusion, never underestimate the critical factor of saliva control.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's... Fascinating... And gross.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know. Now, The Kissmaster has work to do.
Ben turns his attention back to his monitor.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Was this where I was? Did you touch my machine?
Score Up!
On the other side of campus, Kimi rushes into the computer lab! Emily greets her!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Kimi! You got the message about us getting the files?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I came as soon as I could! How's it going?
Emily nods at a wall of computers, where Ben, Kevin, Dex, and Ashley are working furiously!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm getting all the check-ins from the app! The fact that the administration was keeping all of this is... Is `so` wrong!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm getting all the check-ins from the app! The fact that the administration was keeping all of this is... Is [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] wrong!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I just found recordings of everything people said to Branchi! This is unreal! How could they do this?!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Tell me about it. Dex, you want to help me with all these alphabetized files from the site?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I'll start with the A's, you start with the Z's?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Meet you in the middle!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Intense!
Kimi pulls Emily aside.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay, I need your help! Big time!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: A lot of my friends from detention have huge secrets! And if those secrets got out, it would be devastating!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I think everyone at the school is in that position...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Are they also the ex-girlfriend of one of the people collecting all the secrets?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: If Kevin gets his hands on any of these, he could really hurt me!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Do you think he'd do that?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: When we broke up, I told him that playing video games was lame.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Right. I'll totally help you.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And that's why we're friends!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What do you want me to do?
A loud shout comes from Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: These check-ins led me to the 'Personal Musings' section from the website. It's got everyone's private entries! Oooh! There's one here from `QueenOfTB` called 'How I destroyed that witch, Maria!'
nodes.text_bbcode: These check-ins led me to the 'Personal Musings' section from the website. It's got everyone's private entries! Oooh! There's one here from [color=#e23b3b][i]QueenOfTB[/i][/color] called 'How I destroyed that witch, Maria!'

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's Paige's!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Help me distract Ben right now!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't know! Just talk about...
Spencer loses it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Hrrraah!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hrrraah!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He grabs Nate by the collar of his shirt and slams his back against a locker!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's it! I've had it with you!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You're gonna regret this...
Suddenly, Spencer is interrupted by a voice from down the hall!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: What's going on here?
Mr. Hart storms toward the two of them! Spencer drops Nate and steps away!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Mr. Hart! I wasn't going to...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: That's enough! I won't have bullies in this school!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Bullies? But I wasn't--

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Wasn't slamming this poor boy against a locker? Nathan, what happened here?
Nate puts on a sad face and rubs his shoulder, as if nursing the pain...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I... I don't want to rat out a friend...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: That's very admirable, Nathan.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But... You don't know the whole story!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Oh, I think we'll let the camera footage determine the story! My office. NOW.
Spencer trudges after Mr. Hart, his head hanging low. As he leaves, Nate's facade melts away, revealing a knowing smirk...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Good luck with `that,` Spence.
nodes.text_bbcode: Good luck with [color=#e23b3b][i]that,[/i][/color] Spence.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why you...
Spencer seethes with anger, but holds his tongue. And as he makes his way to Mr. Hart's office, he knows...
...He has failed.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I see what you're trying to do. You're trying to bait me into a fight. But it's not gonna work.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Everything you've done was all some attempt to get under my skin.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Pretty pathetic, man. Even for `you.` I don't have time for this.
nodes.text_bbcode: Pretty pathetic, man. Even for [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color] I don't have time for this.

nodes.text: Spencer turns and begins to walk away.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey! Where do you think you're going?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm done.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: 'Done'? Not by a longshot! Do you really think $ALLISON was the `only` one keeping secrets from you?
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Done'? Not by a longshot! Do you really think $ALLISON was the [color=#e23b3b][i]only[/i][/color] one keeping secrets from you?

nodes.text: Spencer freezes in his tracks and turns back to Nate...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Maybe you should see for yourself. Check out the wrestling match at Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I hate Wilson High. Why would I `ever` want to go to one of their sporting events?
nodes.text_bbcode: I hate Wilson High. Why would I [color=#e23b3b][i]ever[/i][/color] want to go to one of their sporting events?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Trust me. You're gonna want to see this one.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If this is some trick, you can forget about it. I'm not gonna fall for it.
Before Spencer can finish, Nate turns and walks away, smugly...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Suit yourself. You're gonna find out about him sooner or later.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whatever, man. I don't care anymore.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I gotta say, you're being an awfully good sport about this.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: If someone stole my girl, I wouldn't just take it lying down. But it's great that you know your place.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: My 'place'?
Spencer's rage reaches a boiling point!
Spencer takes a deep breath, keeping the anger in check!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not a mind reader. I don't know what she was thinking.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Oh, but I think I do. She was thinking that hanging around with a meathead jock like you was getting old. So she decided to upgrade.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Upgrade?! You think you're better than me?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: $ALLISON seems to think so.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh yeah?
Spencer grits his teeth...

options.label: Wipe the smile off his face!

nodes.text: Spencer stifles his rage!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It is what it is.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I never meant for this to happen, man. I can't help it if $ALLISON finds me attractive!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Maybe I was just a breath of fresh air compared to who she... `Usually` hangs out with.
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe I was just a breath of fresh air compared to who she... [color=#e23b3b][i]Usually[/i][/color] hangs out with.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?
Spencer seethes, his face flushing hot!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Much better!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Now, I'm sure many of you are concerned about this 'Town Crier' character and the claims that I have been monitoring your information on the Twin Branches App...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Well, I'm here to tell you... That it's `true.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I'm here to tell you... That it's [color=#e23b3b][i]true.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The voices of the crowd raise into a ruckus!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Now settle down! Just look at yourselves! All of this fighting... And what is it caused by? `Secrets!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now settle down! Just look at yourselves! All of this fighting... And what is it caused by? [color=#e23b3b][i]Secrets![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Higher surveillance means more security! More safety from all the unseen schemes that would hurt us!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: See? He makes a good point!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: That's why, not only will I continue monitoring info as usual... I am increasing the amount of surveillance on campus!
Mr. Hart pulls a cloth off of a display behind him... Revealing a camera mounted on the wall!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Introducing, BranchiCam! These cameras are now installed all over campus! With this eye in the sky, Branchi is watching out for all of you like a big brother!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Security cams?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Imagine! We could prevent violence and wrongdoings before they happen! No bullying, no fighting, no mischief!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: No bullying? That does sound good.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: With BranchiCam, we won't have to worry about secrets hurting us ever again!
The crowd breaks out in applause! Mr. Hart smiles to the audience as he proudly displays the camera.
Suddenly, Andrew stands up in the audience!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: No! This is wrong! Spencer was right not to trust you!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: This is going way too far, Mr. Hart! `Spencer was right!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is going way too far, Mr. Hart! [color=#3b78e2][i]Spencer was right![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yeah! And delete our search histories too! `Spencer was right!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! And delete our search histories too! [color=#e23b3b][i]Spencer was right![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, guys...
One by one, a dozen students rise from their seats, joining the chant!

nodes.speaker: Voices
nodes.text: `Spencer was right!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Spencer was right![/i]

nodes.text: Other students boo and jeer them, returning the crowd to a state of chaos and infighting! Mr. Hart looks on with a scowl, his eyes meeting Spencer's!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's it. I'm outta here...
Spencer exits to the hallway, striding quickly...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just gotta clear my head...
Suddenly, a voice sounds from behind him...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey there, Spence. You don't look too good.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Nate!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Nate![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You better take a breather, buddy. You look like you're about ready to blow a gasket.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm gonna make you regret that...
Spencer takes a step toward Nate, fists clenched!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Not so fast! We're not alone...
Spencer freezes in his tracks as Nate points upward...
...High up on the wall, a security camera looks down on them!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Wouldn't want Mr. Hart to catch you doing anything rash, now, would you? You heard what he said. 'No bullying, no fighting, no mischief'!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Arrgh... Gotta keep my cool!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You gotta admit, though... There's kind of a poetic justice to it.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: One day, you go behind my back and steal my spot on the Steelman Football Program...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: ...And the next, your girl is going behind `your` back to date `me.`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...And the next, your girl is going behind [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] back to date [color=#e23b3b][i]me.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Anger roils up inside Spencer's gut...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Rrr...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You're booing him? After all the resources he's brought to our school?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'll boo whoever I want!
The bickering gets even worse, until...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: `Silence!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Silence![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A stunned silence falls over the crowd...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: 'Let him talk'? You mean let him stomp all over our liberties?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Look, I'm just trying to get through this! You got a problem with that?
The bickering gets even worse, until...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: `Silence!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Silence![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A stunned silence falls over the crowd...
The crowd hushes and turns to Spencer in stunned silence!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't care what side you're on. But the sooner we get through this assembly, the sooner we can leave.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Huh. Yeah, works for me.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh... Um... `HEY!`

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: 'Hey' yourself! You got a problem?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Um... Yes?
`BFFF BFFF BFFF!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]BFFF BFFF BFFF![/b]

nodes.text: The speakers boom as someone taps on a microphone. All eyes turn to the stage as Mr. Hart appears at the podium.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Morning, Twin Branchers! Looks like we've got a doozie of an assembly to get through, so if y'all could just settle down, we can get right to it...
Despite Mr. Hart's pleas, the crowd only gets louder, in a mix of cheers and boos!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Woo!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Down with tyranny!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Branchi! Branchi!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What I search for is my business!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ugh... This is getting ridiculous!
Spencer takes a deep breath and shouts...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I had a bad feeling about him from the start.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But what about the people who `actually` deceived us? Kept secrets and talked behind our backs? Shouldn't we blame `them` too?
nodes.text_bbcode: But what about the people who [color=#3b78e2][i]actually[/i][/color] deceived us? Kept secrets and talked behind our backs? Shouldn't we blame [color=#3b78e2][i]them[/i][/color] too?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah... I mean, I guess so...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The only way to keep from getting backstabbed is to always keep your guard up.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just like the ref says in boxing... 'Protect yourself at all times'. It's the same with... You know, friendships and stuff.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's one of those... Comparison things. Like they use in books.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Metaphors?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. Those.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: That's... `Deep,` man!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's... [color=#e23b3b][i]Deep,[/i][/color] man!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You and me? We're done here.
He turns and trudges toward the exit, never looking back...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Spencer, wait!
You are now playing as Spencer.
The next day, the entire Twin Branches student body is herded into the auditorium for an assembly.
...And the whole crowd is in chaos! All around, students bicker loudly with each other!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What the heck? Everyone's at each other's throats!
Spencer plops down into a seat next to Chris. Just in front of him, Andrew argues with Dex...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: This is an outrage! Mr. Hart collecting our data is a gross violation of our basic rights to privacy!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You're just being dramatic. Mr. Hart has brought a lot of good to this school, too!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Why should we all suffer just 'cause the `less tech-savvy` failed to read the Terms of Agreement and surrendered their private info?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why should we all suffer just 'cause the [color=#e23b3b][i]less tech-savvy[/i][/color] failed to read the Terms of Agreement and surrendered their private info?

nodes.text: The debate heats up all around Spencer as surrounding students join in.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I, for one, am `glad` Mr. Hart collected the info! There are way too many snakes making schemes behind people's backs at this school!
nodes.text_bbcode: I, for one, am [color=#3b78e2][i]glad[/i][/color] Mr. Hart collected the info! There are way too many snakes making schemes behind people's backs at this school!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Maybe this surveillance thing will teach those backstabbers a lesson.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ugh. Paranoid, much? Just because you're bitter that all of the cheerleaders moved on except for `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh. Paranoid, much? Just because you're bitter that all of the cheerleaders moved on except for [color=#3b78e2][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm into different things now. Like vinyl records and social justice. Which, by the way, means I think this whole surveillance thing is totally `not cool.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm into different things now. Like vinyl records and social justice. Which, by the way, means I think this whole surveillance thing is totally [color=#3b78e2][i]not cool.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: You guys are just ungrateful! The Branchi app is awesome!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Hashtag 'robotfriend', hashtag 'truth', hashtag 'sorrynotsorry'!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: See how far we have fallen?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: We need to rise up against Mr. Hart!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm down. The mainstream needs to like, wake up!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm with Drama Geek and Cute Hipster Girl!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Plus, I don't want anyone knowing what's in my search engine history!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Um... Sure, that too.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What do `you` think Spencer?
nodes.text_bbcode: What do [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] think Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Me?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, didn't you butt heads with Mr. Hart from the very beginning?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Look. All I'll say is, you shouldn't be so quick to trust...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: There's no one else like you. What I feel for you is genuine.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. Same...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But what you feel for Nate... I guess that's genuine too.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Of course not! You just wrote it in your fancy computer diary and hoped you could keep the wool over my eyes forever, is that it?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No! Not at all! I simply meant... Possibly at the right moment...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The moment isn't the problem. If you don't get that, then maybe there's nothing left to talk about.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're saying 'it's complicated'? That might as well be a yes! You `do` feel something for Nate!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're saying 'it's complicated'? That might as well be a yes! You [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] feel something for Nate!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, of course I feel `something,` I'm just not sure what it is!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, of course I feel [color=#3b78e2][i]something,[/i][/color] I'm just not sure what it is!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So, what, you'll just go on dating both of us until you figure it out?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No! That's not what I meant!
Spencer turns his gaze toward the floor, his fists clenching tightly...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh no! His anger is reaching its boiling point!
$ALLISON's stomach turns as she waits for Spencer to flip out...
...But he never does! He simply looks up at $ALLISON with pain in his eyes...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...I really didn't expect this from you.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Spencer, you must believe me...

options.label: I didn't mean for you to find out this way...

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't want to lie to you. My emotional status is... Unusually complicated. Even by my standards.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't feel that I'm obligated to say at this juncture.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No, you don't owe me an answer...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But I hoped that, as a friend, you'd be straight with me.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... I suppose I should have been more open, yes.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: The reality is, I'm not 100% certain. My emotional status is... Unusually complicated. Even by my standards.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Is that supposed to make me feel better?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: $ALLISON, you know my history with Nate. You know what a scumbag he is!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: He's not a... A 'scumbag', as you say. He may come off as abrasive at times, but he does have some redeeming qualities once you get to know him...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't `want` to get to know him. I wanted to know `you.` But I feel like everything I knew is wrong.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't [color=#e23b3b][i]want[/i][/color] to get to know him. I wanted to know [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color] But I feel like everything I knew is wrong.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That... That's not true! I haven't been dishonest!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I simply... Hadn't divulged the truth in its entirety..
Spencer looks away, gritting his teeth.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, tell me this... You don't actually have feelings for him, do you?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, honestly...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not exactly? What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, we did get dinner together after the first book club meeting.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...But having a date was `not` my intention!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...But having a date was [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] my intention!

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... won't try to skirt around the truth. You deserve a direct response.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: We did get dinner together after the first book club meeting...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...But having a date was `not` my intention!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...But having a date was [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] my intention!

nodes.title: Spencer Betrayed
nodes.subtitle: Spencer's world is about to be turned upside down!

nodes.text: You are now playing as $ALLISON.
Spencer and $ALLISON smile at each other over dinner at what seems to be the perfect date!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So what happens after this lovely meal?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, I thought we'd grab a book and read together.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You're being serious? You want to read with me?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I am.
Spencer locks eyes with $ALLISON, who smiles up at him.
He leans forward, and with his hand, he cups her face, bringing her closer to him...
His phone buzzes in his pocket, startling him!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa!
$ALLISON slinks back.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, sorry. I should have turned that off.
As he goes to turn off his phone, he sees that he's got a text from Ben.
He glances at it, then stops, his eyes going wide!
Spencer looks up at $ALLISON...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What is it, Spencer? What's happened?
Spencer's expression hardens into a scowl...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This can't be true...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What's wrong...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's a text from Ben. He says the nerds have found some info leaked from Mr. Hart's phone app.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What... What kind of info?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: He says you went on a `date` with Nate. Is that true?
nodes.text_bbcode: He says you went on a [color=#e23b3b][i]date[/i][/color] with Nate. Is that true?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well...

options.label: Yes. But there's more to the story...

nodes.prompt: Spencer's world is about to be turned upside down!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hrrah!
Spencer shoulder checks Darren, sending him stumbling backwards into a trash can!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Aah!
Steve leaps forward, grabbing Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: I got him!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Get off me!
Spencer heaves, shoving free of Steve's grip and knocking him down to the wrestling mat!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Just try that with me!
Skazz charges forward, trying to grab at Spencer's shoulders...
But Spencer drops low and grabs Skazz's legs, lifting him up off of the ground before dumping him to the mat!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Oof!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Anyone else?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: So now, we have to convince them all that you `weren't` right. That all this surveillance is a `good idea.`
nodes.text_bbcode: So now, we have to convince them all that you [color=#e23b3b][i]weren't[/i][/color] right. That all this surveillance is a [color=#e23b3b][i]good idea.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And why would I do that? This surveillance is a `horrible` idea!
nodes.text_bbcode: And why would I do that? This surveillance is a [color=#e23b3b][i]horrible[/i][/color] idea!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Oh, Spencer. Do you really still think so? Look around you.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: All the fighting. All the `betrayal.` All the friendships and relationships `destroyed.`
nodes.text_bbcode: All the fighting. All the [color=#e23b3b][i]betrayal.[/i][/color] All the friendships and relationships [color=#e23b3b][i]destroyed.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: ...Have you seen any of this happening?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...Maybe a little.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Okay fine. More than a little. But so what?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Think about it. All of these problems were caused by the `secrets,` not the surveillance!
nodes.text_bbcode: Think about it. All of these problems were caused by the [color=#e23b3b][i]secrets,[/i][/color] not the surveillance!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: There's no pain of betrayal... When it becomes impossible to `betray.`
nodes.text_bbcode: There's no pain of betrayal... When it becomes impossible to [color=#e23b3b][i]betray.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Join me, Spencer. Together we can crush this rebellion and get rid of all the scheming and all the shadiness once and for all! What do you say?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: ...Haven't `secrets` caused enough pain?
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Haven't [color=#e23b3b][i]secrets[/i][/color] caused enough pain?

nodes.text: Later that afternoon, a dozen passionate students meet in secret in an empty classroom.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Fellow rebels! Our resistance is growing stronger! The time has almost come to gather all supporters and march on Mr. Hart's office!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Our picket signs are ready! Hashtag 'Spencer was right!' and hashtag 'Down with Branchi!'

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Those hashtags are ironic, by the way.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: All right! Let's go bust some doors down!
Just then, the classroom door opens!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Hold your horses there, folks...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Mr. Hart! Our nefarious foe makes an appearance... How did you know of our meeting?!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Oh, don't be silly. It's my job to know!
Mr. Hart points up to the `security camera` in the corner of the room.
nodes.text_bbcode: Mr. Hart points up to the [b]security camera[/b] in the corner of the room.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Right. Cameras. I knew we were forgetting something.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Now before you brave warriors go off on the warpath, I've got a good friend who has a few words to say...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Forget it. There's no one who could change our--
Suddenly, a second figure appears in the doorway and and takes a place at Mr. Hart's side...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: `Spencer?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Spencer?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You guys need to clear out of here! I was wrong. Mr. Hart was right!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Wait... `What?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... [color=#e23b3b][i]What?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You heard me.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `...I'm with Mr. Hart now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]...I'm with Mr. Hart now.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: You have reached the end of `Season 3, Episode 5: Spencer Betrayed!`

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: People. Don't. Like. You.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If I were you, I'd be pretty worried right about now.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Oh, please. I'm in charge of discipline and detention. Of `course` there are delinquent students who don't like me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, please. I'm in charge of discipline and detention. Of [color=#e23b3b][i]course[/i][/color] there are delinquent students who don't like me.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: That's not what's troubling me.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's not?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: No. It's the fact that these rabble-rousers now have a poster-boy. `You.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No. It's the fact that these rabble-rousers now have a poster-boy. [color=#e23b3b][i]You.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Me?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: That's right. At the assembly, they were rallying under cries of 'Spencer was right!'
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I was the first to say this computer stuff was a bad idea. People remember that, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: They do indeed. You are the poster-boy, the image that rallied this little uprising.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: 'We'?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Oh yes. We're in this together, buddy!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What does this have to do with `me`?
nodes.text_bbcode: What does this have to do with [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color]?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: This resistance, this uprising of anti-Branchi students... They said something during that assembly. Something I found very troubling. Do you remember what is was?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You mean...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Everyone's at each other's throats. Some people are mad at `you` too.
nodes.text_bbcode: Everyone's at each other's throats. Some people are mad at [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] too.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Yes indeed. We've got ourselves in quite the pickle, haven't we?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Before you say anything, no one was hurt, and those guys stepped to `me` first!
nodes.text_bbcode: Before you say anything, no one was hurt, and those guys stepped to [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] first!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: ...What are you talking about? I'm not concerned about what happened on another campus!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh! Right! Forget what I said then...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Given the circumstances, I think I'll let you plead the Fifth Amendment.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Which one is the fifth one? I'm missing history class, remember?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Nevermind. Spencer, this is about what happened at the assembly yesterday.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: The student body is up in arms. Most of Twin Branches sees the beauty of the Branchi system... But others aren't taking too well to it. Some are even mad at `me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The student body is up in arms. Most of Twin Branches sees the beauty of the Branchi system... But others aren't taking too well to it. Some are even mad at [color=#e23b3b][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: It looks like we've got ourselves in quite the pickle.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What, did you think I couldn't handle the truth?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? After all your talk about hating Wilson?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All it would've done is make you flip out... Just like you're doing right now!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Flip out? `...Flip out?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Flip out? [color=#e23b3b][i]...Flip out?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm `sick` of everyone thinking they have to protect me from the truth!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]sick[/i][/color] of everyone thinking they have to protect me from the truth!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: 'Everyone'? Who else--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Why is everyone keeping things from me?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Why is everyone keeping things from me?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `What?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]What?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Can you put me down?
Spencer looks down and realizes that he has lifted Owen off the ground, pinning him high against the wall!
All around him, confused spectators look on in awkward silence!
Spencer drops Owen, dusts himself off, and turns away coldly.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's it. I'm outta here.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Spence! Wait!
Spencer drops his gaze, and, for the second time in two days...
...He walks out on a friend.
The next day, Spencer pulls books from his locker and dumps them into his bag, his mind wandering...
The bell rings, and the halls empty as students scurry off to class, but Spencer takes his time, dragging his feet.
Suddenly, a voice calls from behind...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Hey there, Spence! You don't mind if I call you Spence, do you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Mr. Hart?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Don't wear it out! Anyway, I've got a bit of business to chat about with you. Mind stepping into my office for a sec?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's this about?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Oh, we'll get to the details. Come on!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I, uh... Have history next period, and I need to catch up, so if this could wait--

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I'm gonna have to `insist` here, Spence.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm gonna have to [color=#e23b3b][i]insist[/i][/color] here, Spence.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine...
Spencer follows Mr. Hart to his office and takes a seat in front of the desk.
Mr. Hart peeks through the blinds of his window before snapping them shut.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So what's the trouble this time?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: 'Trouble'?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I can tell. You're always extra smiley when there's something shady going on.
Mr. Harts smile wavers... But only for a moment.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: You're a smart cookie, Spencer. I trust, then, that you know what this is about?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. This is about what happened...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All you had to do was be straight up with me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: 'Selfish'? Who else did it benefit besides yourself?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We `all` have to think about ourselves at some point... To do what's best for our future!
nodes.text_bbcode: We [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] have to think about ourselves at some point... To do what's best for our future!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I... I guess you're right...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But why couldn't you have just been straight with me?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know, it's messed up... But we gotta think about college, right?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just like how you pushed to get into the Steelman Football Camp. That was to help get into college too!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's different. Unlike you, I was never...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You'd sell out your own classmates for a shot at a scholarship?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Like I said, Twin Branches doesn't have a wrestling team! If they did, this wouldn't be an issue!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I've `never` wrestled against Twin Branches, and I never would!
nodes.text_bbcode: I've [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] wrestled against Twin Branches, and I never would!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But what about me?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You `know` how much I hate Wilson. How could you side with them, after all that?
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] how much I hate Wilson. How could you side with them, after all that?

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You know how much I hate Wilson. How could you side with them, after all that?
With no one left in his way, Spencer marches toward a stunned Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Spence, look... I was gonna tell you!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Enough!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Enough![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer grabs Owen by the shoulders and pins him angrily against the gym wall!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No more lies! No more games!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I risked my neck to stand up for you against Wilson! But that was all a fake too, wasn't it?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Look, man... Our school doesn't have a wrestling team, and you `know` how much an athletic scholarship means to me...
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, man... Our school doesn't have a wrestling team, and you [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] how much an athletic scholarship means to me...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: A scholarship? That's what this is about? What about loyalty?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Loyalty to who?
Spencer rushes headlong into a grapple with the Wilson boys... But they overpower him!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hrrrah!
Skazz shoots for Spencer's legs, tripping him and taking him down to the mat!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ah!
Darren and Steve dog-pile on top of him, pinning him down!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Get.. Off of me!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: No way!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: We're kicking you to the curb with the rest of the trash!
All three guys pick Spencer up, lifting him roughly to his feet...
...And drag him outside as he kicks and shouts!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just wait... When I come back, `all` of you are going down!
nodes.text_bbcode: Just wait... When I come back, [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] of you are going down!

nodes.text: With one final heave, they toss Spencer into the grass at the edge of the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Whatever, man. We're not scared of you.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Yeah, no one cares about you here. Not even your 'friend', Owen.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: So walk your loser self back across town to Twin Branches. `Alone.`
nodes.text_bbcode: So walk your loser self back across town to Twin Branches. [color=#e23b3b][i]Alone.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The boys laugh sadistically as they return to the gym, leaving Spencer in the dirt to dust himself off.
Defeated, humiliated, and betrayed, Spencer knows...
...He has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.
