menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: That afternoon, Spencer leaves the school, grumbling to himself.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nate, that weasel! I bet this is all some trick. I wouldn't put it past him...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not gonna fall for it. No way.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But... If it's `not` a trick... And there `is` some secret being kept at Wilson...
nodes.text_bbcode: But... If it's [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] a trick... And there [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] some secret being kept at Wilson...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I guess I... I'd want to find out what it is.
Spencer heads down the road toward the bus stop. Any minute now, the bus to Wilson High will arrive...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine... I'll go over and check it out.
Before long, the bus arrives outside Wilson High, where Spencer gets off and approaches the school...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm sure it's just some trick...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: At least... I'm `pretty` sure...
nodes.text_bbcode: At least... I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]pretty[/i][/color] sure...

nodes.text: Spencer walks to the gym and pushes through the doors.
Inside, the bleachers have been pulled out, and a crowd watches as two teams prepare for a wrestling meet.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't get it. It's just a regular wrestling meet between Wilson and--
Just then, Spencer's eyes lock on a familiar face... A wrestler on the Wilson side...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's Owen...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...In a `Wilson wrestling uniform?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...In a [color=#e23b3b][i]Wilson wrestling uniform?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer strides across the wrestling mats toward Owen, fuming!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Owen!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Owen![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Spencer?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What the heck are you doing wearing Wilson colors?
Another Wilson wrestler steps forward, heading straight for Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Slow down there, chief. We're about to start a meet. Owen's one of us now.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Out of my way!
Just then, two more students hop down from the bleachers.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: You mess with one Wilson guy, you mess with us all.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: He's `not` one of you!
nodes.text_bbcode: He's [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] one of you!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Why don't you just turn around and keep on walking? Before we `make` you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Why don't you just turn around and keep on walking? Before we [color=#e23b3b][i]make[/i][/color] you.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not leaving til I settle the score with Owen... and any punk standing in my way!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: There's no way you're getting through us.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Let's get 'im!
The three Wilson guys rush toward Spencer, and he charges forward to meet them!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Gotta fight them off!

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: I told them I couldn't go shopping with them because I had something else to do...

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: ...But secretly my 'something else' was going to see Wrestle Slam Jam 7!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You... You like wrestling?!

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Uh, I can imitate every one of Atomic Tom's Atomic Blasts, so yeah, I kind of `love` wrestling.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, I can imitate every one of Atomic Tom's Atomic Blasts, so yeah, I kind of [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] wrestling.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Crazy! You're like the first girl I've met who watches! I mean, not that that's wrong or anything...

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Tell that to my so-called friends. When the appointment on my calendar leaked, they all stopped hanging out with me.

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Girly girls hate tomboys like me.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't understand. Don't you hate me then, since all this surveillance caused you to lose your friends?

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: How could I? It's not like the surveillance made my friends act like that.

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: All the surveillance did was tell me that my friends weren't really my friends.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kinda like what happened to me...

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Yeah.
Just then, Spencer sees Ryan near the exit, trying to leave the dance! He runs over and blocks him, Candace standing beside him.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey! No one leaves!

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Yeah, no one leaves!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What... What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Helping!
She jams a finger in Ryan's chest!

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: You know the rules! No one can leave till the dance is over!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: But this dance sucks! I don't want to pet animals, and I want to be able to actually dance with girls!

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: What's stopping you?! Other than the girls!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: My... My pathetic nature, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Yeah, well try harder!
Meanwhile, on the other side of the dance floor, $ALLISON watches as Spencer and Candace laugh, high-fiving each other...

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: I... I lost a bunch of my so-called friends...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's rough.

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: You know what it feels like.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I do.

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: You're also like the only person who's actually understanding.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What am I going do, snap at you?

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: With how people have been acting lately, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So... What happened?

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Oh, really? Because I think losing all my so-called friends kinda qualifies me for knowing something!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You didn't lose your friends! `I` lost my friends!
nodes.text_bbcode: You didn't lose your friends! [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] lost my friends!

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Yeah, that's what I'm saying, idiot! We `both` lost our friends!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, that's what I'm saying, idiot! We [color=#3b78e2][i]both[/i][/color] lost our friends!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey! You called me an idiot. No one ever does that.

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Sometimes you gotta call 'em like you see 'em.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait, so... What happened with your friends?
Spencer stands there blank-faced, not saying anything.

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Uh, hello?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, uh... You don't know anything!
As Spencer moves on, he feels `something,` he's just not sure what... An indescribable emptiness.
nodes.text_bbcode: As Spencer moves on, he feels [b]something,[/b] he's just not sure what... An indescribable emptiness.

nodes.text: As he cuts his way through the crowd of dancers, he hears them whispering about him...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Am I a big bother?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Shh! Shh! Spencer's coming!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If Mr. Hart hadn't been watching everyone, I never would have found out about $ALLISON's feelings for that jerk Nate...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Everyone keep your distance! Spencer's coming!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I never would have found out about Owen being a traitor and wrestling for Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: There he goes!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If it hadn't been for Mr. Hart, I wouldn't have found out that my friends weren't my friends at all!
Spencer accidentally walks into someone!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Hey! Watch where you're going!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I was distracted!

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Sure you were--oh wait! You're the guy everyone hates now! The one $ALLISON used to actually like.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, well, she and I are over.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Ha! Candace, come check out how pathetic this guy is now!
Spencer tries to ignore her...

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Hey, Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Don't call him by his name! This guy couldn't even land $ALLISON, and she's like the most pathetic girl in the whole school!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: She's not pathetic!

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! He still likes her probably!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Stop talking about me like I'm not here! I'll send you home!

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Like I care about this dumb dance anyway! Come on, Candace. Let's go make fun of the people who came here alone!
Veronica saunters off, but Candace stays behind.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? Are you gonna take a shot at me too? Because I've got no problem sending you home either!

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: I... I just wanted to say I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: I know how everyone's against you now, and I know what that's like...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ooooh! I'm so scared!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Actually, I am kinda scared.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?! Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Didn't you see what happened to Andrew and Nicole during lunch? Mr. Hart isn't messing around, and I can't miss school...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Errg! Fine!
Brendan and Taylor resume dancing but far apart from each other.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Satisfied, Big Bother?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't let it happen again.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, yeah?! You're going to tell `my` parents that I can't dance with my boyfriend?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, yeah?! You're going to tell [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] parents that I can't dance with my boyfriend?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's exactly what I'm going to do!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Be my guest!
Taylor pulls out her phone, dials a number, and hands it to Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh...
A moment later, a gruff voice answers.

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: Hello? Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This isn't Taylor. This is Spencer, I'm, uh, an enforcer. That's not important.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What is important is I'm at the dance, and she's not following the rules! She's--

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: What is the rule?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, the rule is that she has to dance with at least a foot between her and whoever she's--

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: Hahahahahahahahahaha!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hello? Hello?

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: Hahahahahahahahahaha! That's ridiculous. Don't call me again.
Spencer hands the phone back to Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: He wouldn't stop laughing. Then he hung up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why don't you go enforce somewhere else, okay, big bother?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine. And stop calling me that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I did it because... Because...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You know what?! I shouldn't have to justify myself to you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Fine. I'll see you later. I don't want to be around you now.
Owen storms off, leaving Paige alone. Rather than enter the dance, she heads to the bus stop toward home.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Stupid Owen and his stupid face.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And stupid me... Some Winter Queen I am... Taking the bus...
You are now playing as Spencer.
Inside the gymnasium, the Winter Dance is underway! Along the perimeter of the gym are sheep and llamas, and up near the stage, a pigpen.
Spencer patrols the dance floor...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: A foot apart, Brendan and Taylor! Not an inch!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry, Taylor... It doesn't look like we can dance very close...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, not with `BIG BOTHER` watching us!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, not with [color=#3b78e2][i]BIG BOTHER[/i][/color] watching us!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What did you call me?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You heard me! But I'll clarify since you're so thick-headed.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now that you're working for Mr. Hart, you're nothing but a big, ogre-y, `bother`.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now that you're working for Mr. Hart, you're nothing but a big, ogre-y, [color=#3b78e2][i]bother[/i][/color].

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And it's also a pun since `Big Brother` is symbolic of oppressive surveillance, like in the novel, '1984'.
nodes.text_bbcode: And it's also a pun since [color=#e23b3b][i]Big Brother[/i][/color] is symbolic of oppressive surveillance, like in the novel, '1984'.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thanks, Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just shut up, both of you. Mr. Hart's `helping us.` So if he says dance farther apart, dance farther apart!
nodes.text_bbcode: Just shut up, both of you. Mr. Hart's [color=#e23b3b][i]helping us.[/i][/color] So if he says dance farther apart, dance farther apart!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are you gonna do if we don't? Beat us up?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No! But if you don't follow the rules, I'll...

nodes.prompt: If you don't follow the rules, I'll...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: If you don't follow the rules, I'll...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, so I'm not talking to the person who tricked me into a Thanksgiving dinner date?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That was a long time ago!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What about the person who tricked me into going to a wedding? Who was that?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That was me, too, but--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And the person who schemed to `destroy that wedding?`
nodes.text_bbcode: And the person who schemed to [color=#e23b3b][i]destroy that wedding?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine! That was also me. I get it, you have reasons to judge me!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I just didn't realize you had so much evidence...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But I'm right in `this` case!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I'm right in [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] case!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure you are!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I am!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hypocritical? How?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A moment ago, I was consoling you because you've been wrestling `for Wilson High!`
nodes.text_bbcode: A moment ago, I was consoling you because you've been wrestling [color=#3b78e2][i]for Wilson High![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, right...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Unless we're in one of those relationships where only `you` get to do morally questionable things...
nodes.text_bbcode: Unless we're in one of those relationships where only [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] get to do morally questionable things...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait a second! What you did is `way` worse!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a second! What you did is [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] worse!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How so?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm wrestling for--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: --The enemy.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: --A scholarship!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But you destroyed the cheerleaders so you could ride in a limo!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And that's what you think?! That I did it for the limo?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well? Didn't you?!
A moment later, the limo drives off...
Later that night, the limo drops them off outside the school gymnasium. They get out and head toward the dance...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How fun was that?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'd come to school naked everyday if it meant that I could eat lobster tail like we just had for every meal.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What situation would require you to go to school naked?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know. I'm just saying... I would do embarrassing things for that food.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You mean... Like ice skating! Because that seemed a `little` bit embarrassing for you!
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean... Like ice skating! Because that seemed a [color=#3b78e2][i]little[/i][/color] bit embarrassing for you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, I only fell down once or twice!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Or three or four or five times! My favorite part was when that little girl offered you tips.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Karen's been skating for most of her life!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh yeah, like three years?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Har har!
Just outside the gym doors, Paige gives Owen's arm a squeeze and he stops walking to look at her.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: About this traitor thing...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh huh...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Do you really think `I` care about the fact that you did something questionable?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you really think [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] care about the fact that you did something questionable?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Do you really think `I'm` upset about you going after a scholarship?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you really think [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] upset about you going after a scholarship?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If anything, I'm `proud` of you, for doing something you believe in so strongly.
nodes.text_bbcode: If anything, I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]proud[/i][/color] of you, for doing something you believe in so strongly.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really?
Paige caresses Owen's cheek, leaning into him, when--

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: --There you are!
Maria comes marching up, Chris tagging along behind her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Maria...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I know what you did to the cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... What are you talking about? I didn't do anything!
Maria pulls out a sheet of paper and reads...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: 'Today, I'm going to take down the cheerleaders. Maria will never see it coming. Winter Queen is mine!'

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where did you get that?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I'm not even gonna ask if it's true, because I know it is! All I'm gonna say is...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: ...Congratulations. You won. I would have done the same thing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... What.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: A chance to get a great date for your boyfriend `and` take down a rival at the same time?
nodes.text_bbcode: A chance to get a great date for your boyfriend [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] take down a rival at the same time?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Impressive work...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But this is just the beginning. I've got plans... And you're gonna be a part of them whether you want to be or not!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Enjoy your night! Come along, Craig!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Chris, Craig, close enough.
Maria walks off, Chris scampering to catch up. Meanwhile, Paige can feel Owen glaring at her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What do you mean 'what?!' Is it true, Paige?! Did you try to destroy the cheerleading team?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, it's true! But you don't know all the facts!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know what you're capable of!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really? Don't you think you're being...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's not really saying anything...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's saying `everything!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's saying [color=#3b78e2][i]everything![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Who was there for me when my mother was going to marry Tad?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Who was there for me when I was actually thinking about being with Cromwell? Ugh.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And who overcame his issues to come and play in the big football game?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Me again. I get it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Who can drive better than any high schooler ever?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not exactly related to loyalty, but I think you're talking about me.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's right. Don't forget who you are, Mr. Loyalty.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I won't.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Good! Ready for this date?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm ready!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How am I confused?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You just forgot who you were for a second, that's all.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You didn't really mean to wrestle for that scumbag Wilson team!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is your argument for me that I accidentally joined the Wilson High team?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah! I mean... Maybe they tricked you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nobody tricked me, Paige! I made a choice to wrestle for them because I want a scholarship.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever. Can we just put this aside for a second and enjoy this date?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, fine.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: This concludes the announcements!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Remember, we'll be watching you!
As Mr. Hart walks off, the students all voice their disapproval, but their complaints fall on deaf ears.
Back at the girls' table...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Locking us in? Dancing a foot apart? He can't get away with this!
Neither $ALLISON nor Paige seem to hear her.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hello? $ALLISON?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Huh? Oh, apologies. My mind's completely distracted by this fiasco with Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Paige, what about you? The dance is going to be a prison where we're surrounded by farm animals! Aren't you upset?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? Oh... Who cares? Didn't you hear? I'm going on a fancy limo date with Owen!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Where is he anyway?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't know. I haven't seen him since the whole Spencer, Wilson High, 'traitor' thing.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well even if you two don't care about the dance, `I` do!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well even if you two don't care about the dance, [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] do!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Nothing's going to get in the way of my excitement, because...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...I'm finally going to meet my secret admirer!
Both Paige and $ALLISON snap to attention!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You're serious?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Super serious! Check out this letter...
As the girls hover around Kimi, Maria glares at Paige from across the cafeteria.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Grrr!
You are now playing as Paige.
It's the night of the dance, and Paige and Owen are riding in the back of a limousine as part of their Winter Royalty Prize!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Isn't this amazing?! I mean, I've been in these before, but never as a poor person!
Paige crawls over all the seats in the back of the limousine. She opens up the moonroof, standing up and cheering!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Woohoo! I'm in a limo that I can't afford!
She plops back down.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hello? Really long car? Amazing, right?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Huh? Oh, yeah. It's amazing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Stop the limo!
The limo driver slams on the brakes, and the limo comes to a screeching halt!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you crazy?! We're in the middle of the road!
Paige turns to Owen, ignoring him and the sounds of honking behind them.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We're in a limo, Owen. We do what we want.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Now, listen up, I know that you're feeling sad because everyone found out that you're wrestling for Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not sad!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Two seconds ago you said, 'Huh? Oh, yeah. It's amazing. I'm Owen, and I'm stuck in the mall of sadness.'

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?! Mall of sadness? That's not--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Shh! I know when you're sad because `I know you.` And I'm telling you right now, you have nothing to be sad about!
nodes.text_bbcode: Shh! I know when you're sad because [color=#3b78e2][i]I know you.[/i][/color] And I'm telling you right now, you have nothing to be sad about!

nodes.text: Owen sighs.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, maybe I'm a little sad, but everyone at school thinks I'm a traitor! I'm public enemy number one!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, cause `you're` a traitor! Are you kidding me with this?! Owen, you're not a traitor! You're...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, cause [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] a traitor! Are you kidding me with this?! Owen, you're not a traitor! You're...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: This isn't a dance for... For younger people.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We're mature.
The other students assent.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And responsible.
A few students call out, 'Yeah!'.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And we have rights!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: You have rights as citizens, but when you're put in the care of this school, you must obey my rules!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Just like you have the right to wear whatever you want... But still must adhere to my dress code!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: But if you don't like the rules, you don't have to continue attending!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So that's it?! The dance is just ruined?!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Do you want to be suspended too?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, sir!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Then sit down!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yes, sir!
Kimi reluctantly sits.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: That is a splendiferous point, Miss Chen.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks! So you'll fix things?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: There's nothing to fix.
He addresses the entire crowd of students.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Every adult deserves privacy...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: ...But you are not adults.
The students cry out!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: You are still children. On the cusp of adulthood, perhaps, but children nevertheless.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: And what you deserve is guidance, stringency, and `super`vision!
nodes.text_bbcode: And what you deserve is guidance, stringency, and [color=#e23b3b][i]super[/i][/color]vision!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: So let's make all your days `super!`
nodes.text_bbcode: So let's make all your days [color=#e23b3b][i]super![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Psst! Both of you! Quiet down!
$ALLISON and Paige look around, noticing the attention they're getting.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Thanks for the warning, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, thanks. That could have gotten a lot uglier.
Their attention turns to Mr. Hart.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Where's my assistant? Erik? Could you come up here to make these announcements?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh, sure thing, Mr. H!
Erik bounds up to the front. Mr. Hart hands him some index cards.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Let's see... First, the Winter Dance is coming... Pause for applause. Whoops! Shouldn't have read that part!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Mr. Hart, what do I do if no one applauds?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Just keep going!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Roger! Uh... Congratulations to Paige for `winning Winter Queen!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Roger! Uh... Congratulations to Paige for [color=#e23b3b][i]winning Winter Queen![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It was nothing, really!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: As part of her prize for winning, Paige and a guest will get a limo ride, a fancy dinner, and afterward, ice skating! I think we all know who her guest will be... Paige's boyfriend, Owen!
Several of the football players stand up.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Traitor! He's a traitor! He left us for Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Expel him!
Spencer steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Guys, shut up! Owen might be a traitor, but this isn't the time for discussion!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So uncomfortable! My rash is acting up!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Keep reading! The next card!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay, card two! Uh... Oh gosh...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The theme for this week's Winter Dance has changed...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: From 'Snowmance' to, uh, 'Petting Zoo'? Is this a typo, Mr. H?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: No, I think it'll be a real hoot!
Kimi whispers her frustration to Paige and $ALLISON...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: When did this become a dance for babies?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Next card... There will also be some new rules at this dance.
The students begin murmuring...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Everyone will remain `indoors` once the dance begins!
nodes.text_bbcode: Everyone will remain [color=#e23b3b][i]indoors[/i][/color] once the dance begins!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Oppression!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: We won't stand for this!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Fine! Both of you are suspended! One day!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You... You can't do that!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I can, and I just did. Do you want to protest more and be suspended longer? Or do you want to pack up your things and head home?
Andrew and Nicole quietly leave the cafeteria. At Kimi's table...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! Did you guys see that?! We can't let him get away with this!
Meanwhile...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Read, Erickson!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay! Additionally, anyone dancing at a distance of closer than a foot apart will be subject to punishment, a measure to be enforced by Spencer.
Instinctively, Kimi stands up.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Mr. Hart! You can't do this!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: And why not?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Speak carefully, Kimi...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh, because...
Kimi's mind is a blank. She does nothing to interrupt!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm talking about his heart! He has a noble heart!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He's an ugly egomaniac!

nodes.text: `QUIET! DOWN!`

nodes.text: You couldn't have said anything?

nodes.text: I'm sorry. He's not a slimeball. He just styles his hair weird and oh, he also completely sucks since he framed Spencer for cheating!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not to mention all that weird stuff with your book club.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yeah, I know he's done some really `really` apprehensible things, but there's something else about him...

In the cafeteria, the students sedately assemble their lunches while BranchiCams, overhead cameras mounted on the ceiling, whir from side to side, tracking the students' movements.
Kimi sits down at a table with $ALLISON and Paige.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay! So, I know that Mr. Hart's regime of surveillance or whatever is really killing everyone's mood, but, come on! The Winter Dance is coming!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's not just Mr. Hart's surveillance, Perky Sue... It's who's working with him now...
Just then, Mr. Hart enters the cafeteria, Spencer beside him. The girls' voices drop down to whispers...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Spencer joining Mr. Hart significantly deflated everyone's spirits.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I still can't believe it. Spencer hates Mr. Hart!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Hated.` Until $ALLISON's big secret got out. Now `that` was news I couldn't believe!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Hated.[/i][/color] Until $ALLISON's big secret got out. Now [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] was news I couldn't believe!

nodes.text: Mr. Hart stands at the front of the cafeteria...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Quiet down now. Let's put on our shushing caps, everyone!
Paige turns to $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You really have feelings `for Nate?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You really have feelings [color=#3b78e2][i]for Nate?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That is a private matter!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes. You've convinced me.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Now, what's the letter from your admirer say?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Squee! You'll help me?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I will. It'll be a perfect distraction.
Kimi reads the clue to $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It says, 'You've almost found me. But first, find the scent of romance in the place where girls pair off.'

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I already checked the dance floor, but I didn't find any scent... Unless body odor counts.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think your admirer's talking about how girls often go somewhere together...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The bathroom! Genius! See? You're already paying off!
In the girls' bathroom...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Look, this stall's been taped off with this 'Out of Order' sign!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's probably where it is. Check it out!
Kimi takes down the sign and the tape and steps in.
A moment later...
`PSSSSSSSSSSHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]PSSSSSSSSSSHHHHH![/b]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `Ahhhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Kimi?! Are you okay?! What happened?!
Kimi hops out.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I found this bottle and sprayed some of it on me. It smells like... Like I don't know what!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's in my hair!
$ALLISON leans over and delicately sniffs Kimi's hair...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's truffle oil!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Truffle oil? Like... chocolate truffles?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No... Like mushroom truffles...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What?! Why would my admirer give me `mushroom` perfume?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! Why would my admirer give me [color=#3b78e2][i]mushroom[/i][/color] perfume?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It is a gift most peculiar...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: There's also another clue here.
'Ready to see the product of my rage? Your destiny awaits you, just backstage.'

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: 'The product of my rage' doesn't sound good at all...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Who cares? I'm going to meet him! Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Wait! This whole affair is monumentally strange! Clues in toilets? Mushroom perfume? Weird poems?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Aren't you worried that this person could be unsavory?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, but they could also be the love of my life... And besides, there's already an embarrassing music video of me on the internet that's been viewed a couple million times.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I think I can handle a little more embarrassment.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: A very fair point...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Then let's do this!
A few moments later, Kimi is walking backstage...
...Past a badger pen...

nodes.speaker: Badger
nodes.text: Grnkle!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Cute.
...Past a lizard terrarium...

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: Hsss!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey, Lyla.
...And past a pig pen--
--The pigs begin to snort loudly!

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: Oink! Oink! Oink!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Those pigs seem... Rowdy, don't they?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, actually... I wonder what's--

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh no! The truffle oil! Pigs love truffles!
A moment later, the pigs burst through the pig pen, knocking down the fence and tearing after Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `AHHHHHHHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AHHHHHHHHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Kimi runs from the pigs in the only direction she can, `onstage!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Kimi runs from the pigs in the only direction she can, [b]onstage![/b]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Gotta outrun 'em!

nodes.prompt: Make your choice! Outrun the pigs!

nodes.text: Kimi and the pigs burst onto the stage, the music cuts out, and the attention of the entire school focuses on her.
From across the gymnasium, Kimi's old rival, `Brinna`, holds a microphone...
nodes.text_bbcode: From across the gymnasium, Kimi's old rival, [b]Brinna[/b], holds a microphone...

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Ladies and gentlemen of Twin Branches, I present to you...
A big sign drops down above Kimi, flashing the word `'Undateable'` over and over in big red letters.
nodes.text_bbcode: A big sign drops down above Kimi, flashing the word [b]'Undateable'[/b] over and over in big red letters.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: ...Pig Girl!
Laughter bursts out from the students!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Bwahahahaha! How embarrassing!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey! The sign says 'Undateable'! So true! I wouldn't date her! Ha!

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Wow! This is my new favorite moment ever!
She takes a pic with her phone. A moment later, nearly everyone pulls out their phone to get a shot.
Soon there's a rousing chorus of...

nodes.speaker: Chorus
nodes.text: `Pig Girl, Pig Girl, Pig Girl!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Pig Girl, Pig Girl, Pig Girl![/i]

nodes.text: Meanwhile, Kimi is still running...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: At least! They haven't! Caught me!

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: Oink! Oink! Oink!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: At least! They haven't! Caught--
Kimi stumbles, slows, and sprawls out across the stage!

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: Oink!
In an instant, the pigs are upon her, happily licking at her hair!

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: Snort! Snort!
At last, the pigs are rounded up by a custodian, and Kimi manages to scramble away!
$ALLISON meets her backstage...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I feel so distraught for you, Kimi. Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No!
Kimi plunks herself down on a small staircase and bursts into tears!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Listen, Kimi, I know it seems like this occurrence is terrible beyond belief, but...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...But you'll overcome it! The same way you overcame the embarrassment from your online video.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You don't understand! I don't care about being embarrassed!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You don't? Then I'm admittedly perplexed... And a bit impressed. I don't think I could shrug this off so easily.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, well, like you said... I've got experience.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Why are you upset then?
Kimi blows her nose into a tissue.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Because I thought I was actually going to find love! It's like everyone finds it but me!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I thought that maybe I could be the Paige to someone's Owen...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The Delilah to someone's Erik...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The $ALLISON to someone's Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm not sure that last one's going to happen...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...But I know what you mean.
$ALLISON puts her arm around Kimi, holding her tight while she cries...
Meanwhile...
At the front door of Paige's mother Margot's apartment, Owen knocks...
...He can hear Paige arguing with her mother, then the door opens.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Hey, Owen. She doesn't want to talk right now.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't really care because I want to talk to her...
Margot turns her head back into the apartment, whispers fiercely, and finally opens the door fully, revealing Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Can we talk?
She steps out, closing the door behind her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Go ahead.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Look--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Before you say `anything,` you should know that you're being unfair!
nodes.text_bbcode: Before you say [color=#3b78e2][i]anything,[/i][/color] you should know that you're being unfair!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige....

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes, `I` sabotaged the cheerleading team, and yes, that was wrong!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] sabotaged the cheerleading team, and yes, that was wrong!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But I did it to hurt Maria who was being obnoxious `and` I was good about making sure everyone who quit got a better opportunity!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I did it to hurt Maria who was being obnoxious [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] I was good about making sure everyone who quit got a better opportunity!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But more importantly, I did it for us! So we could have a night out! One that I can't afford anymore and that you couldn't afford ever!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Would you let me say something?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I guess... Go.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't always like the things you do or how mean you get sometimes, but at this point...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `...I know you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]...I know you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I kinda know what I'm getting into with you, you know?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And what is it you're `getting into,` exactly?
nodes.text_bbcode: And what is it you're [color=#3b78e2][i]getting into,[/i][/color] exactly?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, someone who can be mean... And rude... And insulting...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't like that you're smiling when you say that...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, you're also someone who is exciting... And passionate... And compelling.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I like that better...
Owen pulls her in close.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Pretty and beautiful and gorgeous.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Those are all synonyms.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Got a problem?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not complaining.
He leans down and kisses her, deeply, in a way he's never kissed her before. Then he pulls back and says...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I love you, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did you just say... What I think you said?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I did. And I meant it.
Mr. Hart grumbles on the way to his office...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Stupid to leave my umbrella all the way in here... Missing out on the dance and the animals... Real smooth, Gary, real smooth.
He steps inside his office, flicks on the light...
...And discovers Erik sitting in his chair, typing on his computer!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh oh! I mean, huh ho, Mr. Hart! So good to see you!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I was just, um, just doing some late night filing on your behalf.
Mr. Hart casually rests his briefcase on a nearby chair.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I should have known it sooner. You have access to my files, and you possess the required technical skills...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Not to mention your strong moral backbone.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm not sure what you're getting at...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: `You're the Town Crier.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You're the Town Crier.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Who? What? Noooooo...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: And now I've got you, you weasel!
Erik sidles away from Mr. Hart, near the open window...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Let me just say one thing on my behalf, okay?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're right. I am the Town Crier. And I'm going to bring you down, buddy.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Also, `smokebomb!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Also, [color=#e23b3b][i]smokebomb![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Erik leaps out of the window just as Mr. Hart lunges after him, narrowly escaping and running awkwardly across the campus!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: You can't run far, Erickson! You can't run far!
You have reached the end of `Season 3, Episode 6: The Winter Dance!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 3, Episode 6: The Winter Dance![/b]

nodes.text: Want to catch up?! Check out `Troublemakers 1: Origins` and `Troublemakers 2: Holiday Hearts!` Both in More Episodes!
nodes.text_bbcode: Want to catch up?! Check out [b]Troublemakers 1: Origins[/b] and [b]Troublemakers 2: Holiday Hearts![/b] Both in More Episodes!

nodes.text: And remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam!
...She has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's the only way you'll get rid of your feelings of guilt!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Okay... I trust you! I'll do it!
A moment later, $ALLISON approaches Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I know that you're mad at me...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: More like disappointed.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...but I think it might be good to discuss what we're feeling.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Okay! Let's discuss it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm disappointed in you for going on a date with Nate!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I hate that you're into him!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I can't even bear to look at you right now!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How's that for discussing?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think this might have been a bad idea...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You think? Well, I'm just getting started!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What does that mean?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Insubordination! How's that for a big word, $ALLISON?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It means you're suspended!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You can't suspend me!
Spencer calls over to Mr. Hart, getting his attention.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Yes, what seems to be the trouble, Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Insubordination. I'm suspending $ALLISON. She was planning on leaving the dance early in protest.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I was not! This is completely absurd and ridic--
Mr. Hart turns to $ALLISON...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Do you want to be suspended for longer?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Keep talking, young lady, and you'll be suspended for a week! I trust Spencer way more than I trust you.
Over Mr. Hart's shoulder, Spencer smiles broadly.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Fine.
$ALLISON turns and walks out of the gym. On the way, she shoots a glare at Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Your advice led me astray, Kimi. Now I feel much `much` worse...
nodes.text_bbcode: Your advice led me astray, Kimi. Now I feel much [color=#3b78e2][i]much[/i][/color] worse...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry...
As $ALLISON leaves the gym, Kimi knows...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Right now, Spencer seems pretty angry and confused.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'll bet he's got a lot of walls put up. He'd have to in order to be working for Mr. Hart.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But this can't last forever. Something big's going to change things, and then you'll have your chance. I promise!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You've made a compelling case.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah?
You are now playing as Kimi.
At the table with $ALLISON, Kimi scans the crowd...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Look, $ALLISON, I know you're all hung up on this Spencer-Nate thing, but--
She pauses when she sees a cute guy, but then keeps scanning when the guy puts his arm around a nearby girl.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: --but come on!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I mean... you've got to get out of this funk somehow. Besides, I need someone focused to help me figure out who my secret admirer is!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And how, praytell, am I supposed to 'get out of this funk'?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I feel so much guilt, and yet I'm not certain I've done anything wrong!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Admittedly, I wish I didn't feel what I feel for Nate, but I can't help that!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And I didn't act on those feelings! I wrote about them, that's all. Am I at fault for expressing my feelings privately?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, not at all! But there are ways to feel better!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The best way to deal with guilt is to address it head on!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You mean, by going and conversing with Spencer right now?

options.label: Yes, you should talk to him now!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Anyway, you should watch this...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, sure thing, Mr. H.! Whatever you say!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: That's right! You do what I say!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't have to watch anything!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Wait... Please, Spencer! I'm begging you!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: It's so super important that you watch this!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine, just... Stop whining.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Not your finest hour, Gary... But at least it got the job done...
The video begins to play...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You--seemed romantically interested in me.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well? Am I wrong?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: --You're not wrong about me being interested in you.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I care about you, $ALLISON.
$ALLISON smiles at Nate, but without context, it seems romantic.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: What are you thinking?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: `Frankly,` I didn't know you were capable of surprising me like that.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Frankly,[/i][/color] I didn't know you were capable of surprising me like that.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Heh. Want me to catch you up on 'The Count of Monte Cristo'?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes, please.
The video stops...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why did you show me this? What does it have to do with Erik?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: My boy, you joined me because surveillance prevents people from deception.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: And if no one had been deceptive, you would never have gotten so hurt.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Ericson is against me! He's on the side of deception!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: This video is a reminder of the pain deception causes.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: $ALLISON never told you about her date with what's his name, did she?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No, she didn't.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: But it was Erik who felt the need to expose that secret. He's the reason you're feeling the hurt you're feeling now.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: And he did it all underneath `our` noses!
nodes.text_bbcode: And he did it all underneath [color=#e23b3b][i]our[/i][/color] noses!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's like he's the most untrustworthy of them all!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I trust I have your allegiance?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'll find Erik, Mr. Hart. I'll bring that traitor justice, Spencer style!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Excellent!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: On an unrelated note...
Mr. Hart unwraps a fancy box and hands a new phone to Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's this?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: A gift.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Really? This looks expensive.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I want you to have it, as a 'thank you' for your service.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I feel like when we started you were so super reluctant to accept anything from me...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: But maybe now... Maybe things... Have changed?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: They have... Thanks, Mr. H....

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: It's nothing...
Spencer trudges out of the office, powering up his new phone.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Nothing... `But a little insurance!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Nothing... [color=#e23b3b][i]But a little insurance![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hmm... That's true. I don't keep secrets!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: And that's one of the virtues I value in you most, buddy!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: That and your angry vulnerability, which I'm exploiting to my advantage!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Thanks, Mr. H.. I appreciate it.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's true. Wait... Can't you bug me even if I don't use tech?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Isn't the bug itself tech?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Uh, it's all really complicated. I'm sure you wouldn't understand...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Maybe. Why don't you try me?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I would, but there's something more pressing for us to discuss!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I anticipated that you'd be hesitant to act against Ericson. I didn't want to have to show this to you, but...
Mr. Hart queues up a video of $ALLISON's book club.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: This happened about an hour ago. I crossed the audio from the bug on $ALLISON with the camera footage.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You bugged $ALLISON?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Don't be so surprised. I bugged all the Troublemakers.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: ...Except you, of course!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why not me?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Uh... Why didn't I bug you? Because...
Mr. Hart's knuckles clench tight...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: He's not `cool.` He's an enemy!
nodes.text_bbcode: He's not [color=#e23b3b][i]cool.[/i][/color] He's an enemy!

nodes.text: Mr. Hart slaps a mug off his desk, and it shatters against the wall!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa! Relax, Mr. H.!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I will not relax! Not until you call Ericson what he is! A nasty enemy!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, okay. He's an enemy.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Good. Good. Super.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Not exactly in control, Gary... But you can still win this!
Mr. Hart's knuckles clench tight...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: He's not `cool.` He's an enemy!
nodes.text_bbcode: He's not [color=#e23b3b][i]cool.[/i][/color] He's an enemy!

nodes.text: Mr. Hart slaps a mug off his desk, and it shatters against the wall!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa! Relax, Mr. H.!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I will not relax! Not until you call Ericson what he is! A nasty enemy!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, okay. He's an enemy.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Good. Good. Super.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Not exactly in control, Gary... But you can still win this!
Mr. Hart's knuckles clench tight...
But he takes a deep breath and relaxes.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Stay calm, Gary. Stick to the plan, and you'll win 'cause you're a winner!
Mr. Hart's knuckles clench tight...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: He's not `cool.` He's an enemy!
nodes.text_bbcode: He's not [color=#e23b3b][i]cool.[/i][/color] He's an enemy!

nodes.text: Mr. Hart slaps a mug off his desk, and it shatters against the wall!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa! Relax, Mr. H.!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I will not relax! Not until you call Ericson what he is! A nasty enemy!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, okay. He's an enemy.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Good. Good. Super.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Not exactly in control, Gary... But you can still win this!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I need you to do something for me. It could get icky, but I need you to bring in the Town Crier.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You mean Erik?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Yes, `him.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, [color=#e23b3b][i]him.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But he's... Kind of... My friend. I mean, he's a nerd, but they can be cool too.
Mr. Hart can feel anger boiling up inside him!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Just tell me what you need.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Oh, right... Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Not exactly dominant, Mr. Polite.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I came as soon as I saw your message.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: And you didn't dawdle along the way?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, I had to use the restroom...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I didn't call you so you could dawdle. You're a big boy, you can hold it.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Just don't let it happen again!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Score one, Gary!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So, what do you need?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No offense, but my feelings for Spencer are... Deeper. Maybe because I've had them longer, I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You really like Spencer, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Nothing too strong... But maybe the beginnings of something like that...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Unfortunately, it seems he's courting that Candace girl now.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: That is unfortunate.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I find it difficult to take your sympathy seriously, all things considered.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Frankly, at last glance, you hated Spencer `and` seemed romantically interested in me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Frankly, at last glance, you hated Spencer [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] seemed romantically interested in me.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I don't know why you'd ever start a sentence with 'frankly'. Everything you say is frankly.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well? Am I wrong?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yes and no. You're not wrong about me and Spencer. And you're not wrong about me being interested in you.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: But my sympathy's legit. Romantic competition aside... I care about you, $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And seeing you hurting like this... It kinda hurts me too.
$ALLISON gives Nate a warm, friendly smile.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: What are you thinking?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: `Frankly,` I didn't know you were capable of surprising me like that.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Frankly,[/i][/color] I didn't know you were capable of surprising me like that.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Heh. Want me to catch you up on 'The Count of Monte Cristo'?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes, please.
As Nate pulls out his copy, a BranchiCam whirs softly overhead, pointed at the two of them...
You are now playing as Mr. Hart.
A little while later, in Mr. Hart's office...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Okay, Gary, the video's ready. Just make sure you maintain control.
Spencer steps in.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Well, who can blame you for those?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I can! Because frankly, some of those feelings are feelings of loathing!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Don't hold back or anything.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Who are you, Nate? Are you the guy who tries to frame Spencer for cheating? Or are you the guy who tries to bail me out of Book Club?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I was the crappy framing guy. I'm now the awesome bailing-you-out guy.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And look, I understand what's going on...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Because you have feelings for someone other than Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Because the other guy is... Not exactly the nicest guy you've ever met?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes again.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And because this other guy... He's been acting different lately, and you can't tell how genuine he is.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You know the situation so well.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I might be involved.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You haven't read the book, so `I'll` be taking over the discussion!
nodes.text_bbcode: You haven't read the book, so [color=#e23b3b][i]I'll[/i][/color] be taking over the discussion!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: She read the book, she just doesn't--

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No, Nate, it's okay. Andrew's right. I didn't read the book.
The other book club members murmur in surprise.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I've been... Distracted.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Blah blah blah. Now let's continue with what's `really` important!
nodes.text_bbcode: Blah blah blah. Now let's continue with what's [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] important!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I contend that Edmund Dantes was, in fact, the villain of this story!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: How do you figure?!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah, even I know that's not true!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Even Zach knows that's not true.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well, `I'm` running this! And what I say goes!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] running this! And what I say goes!

nodes.text: The rest of the book club session is equally unbearable.
Afterward, Nate pulls her aside.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Well, we finally got through that mess.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm sorry... It was all my fault. If I had read the book, we wouldn't have had to hear the Andrew Knows Everything show.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: It wasn't so bad...
They don't say anything for a moment, then...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Okay, it was pretty bad.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Heh.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Listen, can we sit for a second?
Nate leads the session successfully, sparking an interesting sharing of ideas.
Afterward, he pulls $ALLISON aside.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Good job taking over.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: No problem. Can we sit for a second?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh... Sure.
They sit.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: So... What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Why does something have to be wrong?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Because you haven't done your homework, and the last time that happened was... Never.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: So what's the matter? Are you sick?
Nate playfully reaches out to feel $ALLISON's forehead, but she bats his hand away.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm fine. Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You also don't usually lie.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I merely meant that I'm `not` sick.
nodes.text_bbcode: I merely meant that I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] sick.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Fine. `And` I definitely have feelings for Spencer...
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. [color=#3b78e2][i]And[/i][/color] I definitely have feelings for Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And I definitely...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Cow-B? You're talking about Edmund's love, Cowbee?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Pig-C? You're talking about Edmund's love, Pigsy?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hay-D... Er... Haydee! You're talking about Haydee, Edmund's love.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Hmmm. I guess you did read the book. I apologize for questioning the integrity of a fellow bibliophile!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Just as long as it doesn't happen again.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Nate, you seemed interested in leading this session today. That sounds like a fabulous idea.
Nate gives her a wink as he begins leading the book club.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Phew! Thank you, Nate!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Tractor-F? That can't be right...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I assume your lack of an answer confirms my belief.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Something's gotta be done about him! He's put surveillance up all over the school! Plus, now that Erik's been exposed as the Town Crier, he's starting a school-wide manhunt!

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: I wish I'd known about his agenda... Maybe if you'd come to me sooner...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: To be honest, when you're in the Troublemakers, it's easy to forget who actually runs the school...
McCormick picks up her nameplate and adds it to a box of desktop trinkets.

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: Well, unfortunately, I can't do anything about it now. I'm no longer the principal of Twin Branches!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What?! But you've always been the principal!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, they can't get rid of you!

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: They have.
She sighs.

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: I guess I might as well tell you, since it's going to be public knowledge anyway.

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: Our friend Mr. Hart has footage of me and, ahem, `a certain officer of the law` kissing in the parking lot.
nodes.text_bbcode: Our friend Mr. Hart has footage of me and, ahem, [color=#3b78e2][i]a certain officer of the law[/i][/color] kissing in the parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Awww! You and Monte! That's cute!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Try gross! Ugh.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't understand. Why did that cost you your position?

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: We're both government officials, and we were in an unreported relationship.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't imagine having to report my relationship status!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hee hee! With Owen. Not with Owen. With Owen again. Repeat for, like, ever.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Real hilarious. You're a comic genius.

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: The bad news doesn't stop there.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: There's going to be a district board meeting in City Hall today. Everyone important in education will be there, including Mayor Crawford... At the meeting, Mr. Hart will be declared `the new principal`!
nodes.text_bbcode: There's going to be a district board meeting in City Hall today. Everyone important in education will be there, including Mayor Crawford... At the meeting, Mr. Hart will be declared [color=#3b78e2][i]the new principal[/i][/color]!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is everyone imagining the same dystopic world I am right now?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I think so, assuming dystopic means the worst thing of all time.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He put cameras in the restrooms! The `restrooms`, Principal McCormick! I can't even, you know, do what I need to do there anymore!
nodes.text_bbcode: He put cameras in the restrooms! The [color=#3b78e2][i]restrooms[/i][/color], Principal McCormick! I can't even, you know, do what I need to do there anymore!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: There must be some course of action against him, right?

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: Actually... Funny you should mention that...

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: If some students were to attend the meeting and report on Hart's shortcomings as a leader, that could significantly sway the board's decision...

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: But you didn't hear that from me!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Thank you, Principal McCormick!
A moment later, they step out into the hall...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We `have` to be at that meeting!
nodes.text_bbcode: We [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] to be at that meeting!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Let's head over right after detention, and bust Mr. Hart!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sounds good to me!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'll reschedule my book club to lunchtime!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's on then! Today! After detention!
At book club during lunch, $ALLISON's mind wanders...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is Spencer `dating` Candace? They looked like they were enjoying each other's company at the Winter Dance...
nodes.text_bbcode: Is Spencer [color=#3b78e2][i]dating[/i][/color] Candace? They looked like they were enjoying each other's company at the Winter Dance...

nodes.text: She notices everyone staring at her.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, right! Hello, everyone. Thank you for meeting me at this earlier time...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: It was no problem, $ALLISON!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Speak for yourself! I find this inconvenient, inconsiderate, and downright selfish! I have things to do too, you know?!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Like what? Stuffing a burrito in your face while playing Nerdopoly?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: That is startlingly accurate. And a little saddening...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Ha! You're depressed!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey, Zach! I brought you into this club, but I'll kick you out if you can't act like an adult.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Sorry... I'll behave.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is Spencer dating Candace now? I saw them at the dance but...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Hello? We can start any day now!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sorry... This week's book is... 'Madame Bovary'. What did you all think of--

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Did you say 'Madame Bovary'? I thought we were reading 'The Count of Monte Cristo'.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh... Yes, sorry. That's correct. I forgot, Candace...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Er... Ashley. Excuse me.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You read the book, right? I am sacrificing my time here. It'd be comforting to know that it's not being wasted!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: All right. Enough, Andrew. You're talking about $ALLISON. She read the book.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Or not!
Nate catches the panic in $ALLISON's eyes.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Uh, but... Maybe for a change `I'll` run the club this week!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, but... Maybe for a change [color=#e23b3b][i]I'll[/i][/color] run the club this week!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I don't think so. I don't need some meathead's interpretation of classic literature!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Besides, we'll know soon enough whether $ALLISON's up to speed or not.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Quiz time!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is this really necessary?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Yes! Who `wrote` 'The Count of Monte Cristo'?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes! Who [color=#e23b3b][i]wrote[/i][/color] 'The Count of Monte Cristo'?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, uh, Dumas.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Too easy. But what's the name of the girl Edmund falls in love with by the end of the novel?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh... Uh... You mean...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey, Andrew, have you ever heard of an allergy that you can get while working on a farm? You know, `something` fever?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, Andrew, have you ever heard of an allergy that you can get while working on a farm? You know, [color=#e23b3b][i]something[/i][/color] fever?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Can't you see I'm busy right now?!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Sorry... By the way, Zach, I'm sorry about that `bad grade` you got on Mr. Dean's test...
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry... By the way, Zach, I'm sorry about that [color=#e23b3b][i]bad grade[/i][/color] you got on Mr. Dean's test...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Thanks, man. I didn't think anyone cared...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well, $ALLISON...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think Nate was trying to leave me a clue just now!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh! Sorry, Andrew. I thought I answered. You're obviously talking about...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Principal McCormick, if it pleases you, we'd appreciate the opportunity to discuss a matter most--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: $ALLISON! We don't have time to re-enact 'Pride and Prejudice'! Get to the point!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I love that movie!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You are aware it's a classic piece of literature, right?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's a book?!

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: Ahem. Does someone want to actually `tell me` what's going on?
nodes.text_bbcode: Ahem. Does someone want to actually [color=#3b78e2][i]tell me[/i][/color] what's going on?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Apologies...

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: No, I appreciate your sensibilities, Miss Applebee. And all of you should read Jane Austen.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: A fellow Austen fan? All right!

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: But I sense you're not here to invite me to your book club...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Not at all. It's about Mr. Hart...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's Mr. Hart! He's out of control! We demand--

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: Now wait just a minute. You can't just barge into someone's office!

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: And you certainly can't do it in this manner, `demanding` action of me.
nodes.text_bbcode: And you certainly can't do it in this manner, [color=#3b78e2][i]demanding[/i][/color] action of me.

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: Hopefully the faculty at this school is teaching you some manners along with their curriculum.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I'm normally more myself.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If ever there was a time for you to be you, $ALLISON, that was it.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You don't have to be so hard on her.

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: Ahem. Does someone want to actually tell `me` what's going on?
nodes.text_bbcode: Ahem. Does someone want to actually tell [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] what's going on?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I will... Like $ALLISON said, Mr. Hart's out of control...

nodes.title: Heart to Hart
nodes.subtitle: Can the Troublemakers get rid of Mr. Hart?

nodes.text: You are now playing as $ALLISON...
$ALLISON, Paige, Owen, and Kimi burst into Principal McCormick's office!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What the--?! What makes you think you can just come in here uninvited?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Principal McCormick, I can explain!

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: You'd better.
Erik uses all his might to push Spencer back!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What the--?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: May the power of nerd protect me!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you serious?! I'm a linebacker!
Spencer shoves back, barreling into the closet! The force throws Erik back, but to the side of his equipment.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Phew!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Just... Before you take me to Mr. Hart, please do me one favor and look at something for me.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sure. Fine. Anything to get you to stop talking about sports.
A second later, Erik heads over to his workstation...
But it's all been damaged beyond recognition in the skirmish.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I have a video, I swear!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine. Why don't you just tell me what's on it?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's $ALLISON and Nate at their book club earlier today!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've already seen it!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know, but the one you saw was edited by Mr. Hart! $ALLISON still cares about you!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sure she does! That's why I saw her getting all cozy with Nate!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I swear! If you could just see the footage!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've seen enough!
Spencer grabs Erik and escorts him out.
As Spencer marches Erik toward Mr. Hart's office, Erik knows that it's all over...
He knows that...
Spencer stops.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How is this like football?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, there's a quarterback, that's you.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I play linebacker!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh, right. And then... There's the ball, that's me.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But then there's a runner back? Er, a tight end? That means there must be a loose end too, right?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What are you even talking about?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know! Why is that sport so dumb with its naming conventions?!
