Spencer grabs Erik and hoists him up!
Spencer suddenly stops.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?! How is this like wrestling?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, in wrestling, isn't there a duo of good guys, of friends, who end up on opposite sides?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The Catastrophe Clowns. How do you know about them?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And how'd they end up on opposite sides?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It was a horrible misunderstanding. Crazy Clown got jealous because he thought Chubby Clown was after his girl.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But Chubby Clown was just trying to tell The Marvelous Sue that his brother liked her.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: See? They're not that different from us.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I mean... I made some enemies when I exposed everyone's secrets...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But the secrets I exposed would have existed with or without me.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I was trying to help. Just like Chubby Clown.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And you're saying I might have overreacted, just like Crazy Clown?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Maybe just a little... I mean, maybe I'm not your enemy.
Spencer thinks for a moment, then...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Maybe you're not my enemy, but you're definitely not my friend. I'm still going to take you in!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Like... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Football?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why would I?! You're my enemy!
Spencer flushes Erik out from his hiding place. There's no place left for him to go in the cramped closet.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, I'm not your enemy! Please, you have to understand!
Spencer looms over him.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: This whole overly dramatic situation, it's just like...
Erik scampers under a table!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Come back here, you little shrimp!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not while you're like this!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Don't you care about me?!
Erik dashes behind a computer, but Spencer shoves it over!
`Crrrrrrash!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Crrrrrrash![/b]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My machine!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Should have picked a smarter hiding place!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You don't care that you're hurting me?
Erik freezes up, opting to hide behind a computer at the last moment!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You think we're friends? You're not my friend anymore! Everything's ruined because of you!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I didn't ruin anything, I exposed it! Mr. Hart's at fault! I just pointed out what he was doing wrong!
Spencer lunges at Erik, who hides...
Erik keeps running, and his shirt tears off in Spencer's hand! Erik's momentum sends him careening forward! He slams into a monitor!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: It topples over with a loud metallic `crunch!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It topples over with a loud metallic [b]crunch![/b]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That can't be good...
Erik starts wiggling dramatically!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What are you doing, weirdo?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Aaaaaaaaaaand... Huzzah!
Erik frees himself at the exact moment that Spencer yanks the shirt, sending Spencer flying backward into a broom rack!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oof!
But Spencer's back on his feet, angrier than ever!
Unsure of what to do Erik starts running, stretching the shirt to its limits!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're gonna rip it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grr! Get back here!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Spencer! Wait! I'm your friend!
Spencer reaches out and grabs the collar of Erik's shirt!
Erik dodges out of the way!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Whoop!
Erik panics, letting out a scream!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ahhhhhhhh!
Spencer covers his ears, as Erik runs frantically around the closet, smashing into his PC!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Youch!
Sparks fly everywhere!
Spencer gives a hard push...
And sends Erik flying back into his workstation! A monitor topples over!
`CRRRRRASH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]CRRRRRASH![/b]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Noooo...
Spencer looms in the doorway.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yes!
You are now playing as Erik.
Meanwhile, Erik is sitting at a computer station inside a utility closet. In front of him is an impressive display of monitors, all simultaneously running bits of code.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sounds like Spencer's meeting with Mr. Hart wrapped up, `and` Spencer's got a new phone! Better buzz him!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sounds like Spencer's meeting with Mr. Hart wrapped up, [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] Spencer's got a new phone! Better buzz him!

nodes.text: Erik takes out a device and turns a knob until he hears a humming noise. A series of seven digits displays on the device.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hot dog! That's the number! I'll just send this untraceable message aaaaaaaaand...
He presses send.
A few seconds later, there's a pounding on the door!
`BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]BOOM! BOOM! BOOM![/b]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Big mistake telling me where you were, nerd! Now open the door and make this easy on yourself!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know he's going to be mad. I just need to tire him out so I can show him the `real` video of $ALLISON and Nate!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know he's going to be mad. I just need to tire him out so I can show him the [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] video of $ALLISON and Nate!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And I need my equipment to remain intact!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I know you're in there!
`SLAM!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]SLAM![/b]

nodes.text: Spencer's body slams into the door, causing it to warp in the middle!
Erik moves to the door, pushing his weight against it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm coming in!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've gotta hold it! Gotta make him tired!
`SLAM!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]SLAM![/b]

nodes.text: Spencer's next collision knocks the door off its hinges! With the door broken, Spencer pushes forward, and Erik's feet begin to slide!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hrrah!
Owen grips the wheel, turning it with strained precision!
The car stabilizes, tires gripping the ground!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yes!
Owen turns to Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And Spence, I should've been straight with you about joining the Wilson wrestling team. Sorry, man.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I also would like to express regret. The way things transpired... It's not what I intended, and I apologize.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa, okay! A lot of apology flying around, here. I'm not good with mushiness, but...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Let's just say jerk moves were made all around. I'm sorry for my part, too.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Awwww! It's such a precious moment right now, you guys!
Kimi wraps her arms around as many people as she can, squeezing them into a tight group hug.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is real sweet and all, but I feel like someone should remind everyone... Mr. Hart still needs to be stopped! So unless anyone's got a miracle in their back pocket, we need to think of a plan B.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, I've got it covered. I sent a text as soon as we got stuck in the ditch...
Just then, a loud, low rumbling sounds from down the road...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: What is `that?`
nodes.text_bbcode: What is [color=#e23b3b][i]that?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: ...A huge farm tractor comes sputtering toward them!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's my `miracle.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's my [color=#e23b3b][i]miracle.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Hey there, Troublemakers!
Delilah waves from behind the wheel of the tractor! Pulling it to a stop, she hops down, dragging a chain towards Nate's car...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Hear y'all got a car that needs towing. I think I might able to help!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I shouldn't have snapped at you. You were only doing what you thought was right.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And really, I think you `were` right.
nodes.text_bbcode: And really, I think you [color=#e23b3b][i]were[/i][/color] right.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks, Owen! It means a lot.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's hard for me to just pretend things are okay, you know?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh. No, I understand.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, Owen? I know I'm usually the tough one, but maybe you should cut Erik a little slack.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He was only trying to take down Hart. Things got messy, but that wasn't his plan.
Owen sighs.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah. I guess Paige is right. Sorry, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks, Owen. It means a lot.
Later, the Troublemakers gather outside the car, watching as Owen tries and fails to back it out of the ditch. After one last attempt, he shuts off the engine and climbs out.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's no use. The car works fine, but it's got no traction on this loose dirt. It's stuck until someone tows it out.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Well, that's just great. So glad I came to help.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Shut it, Nate. You don't even care about what we're trying to do. You're just here to impress $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'd appreciate it if you didn't talk about me like I wasn't here.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, that didn't stop you and Owen from keeping secrets right under my nose.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Spencer, you're throwing around a lot of judgments for someone who joined the enemy just a while back.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, you were the one that led Mr. Hart's goons straight to Erik.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But it was `Erik` that leaked everyone's secrets to the public!
nodes.text_bbcode: But it was [color=#e23b3b][i]Erik[/i][/color] that leaked everyone's secrets to the public!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's true! Can we go back to `that` for a second?
nodes.text_bbcode: That's true! Can we go back to [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] for a second?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I too feel that some explanation is still due us!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What were you `thinking,` Erik?! You better have a good story, or so help me--
nodes.text_bbcode: What were you [color=#e23b3b][i]thinking,[/i][/color] Erik?! You better have a good story, or so help me--

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I did what I thought was `right!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I did what I thought was [color=#e23b3b][i]right![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The Troublemakers freeze in stunned silence...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't often take a stand. Usually I'm in the background, along for the ride and the hilarious hijinks.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I saw something I couldn't stand for. Mr. Hart was corrupt and power crazy! Harmful to our school!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What would Paul Revere do? He'd rally a revolution, that's what!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I truly am sorry that it hurt you all... I had no idea you were hiding `so much` from each other.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I truly am sorry that it hurt you all... I had no idea you were hiding [color=#e23b3b][i]so much[/i][/color] from each other.

nodes.text: The others look around at each other, exchanging somber looks.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Erik, listen...
The car spins out and slides into a fence, dinging the driver's side door!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoops!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You better believe I'm sending you a repair bill, Harris!
He turns the corner, when suddenly...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Look out!
`HONK HOOOONNNK!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]HONK HOOOONNNK![/b]

nodes.text: ...A huge truck blares its horn as it barrels toward the car!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Everyone hold on!
Owen jerks the wheel, sending the car off of the main road and onto a footpath through the city park!
The car slips, sweeping a serpentine pattern into the loose gravel beneath its wheels!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Gotta regain control, quick!
Owen slows down... And the cart knocks into the car's side door!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Aah!
Owen struggles to right the car's path before continuing on his way...
Owen guns the gas, speeding out of the cart's path!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ha! As I was saying, Spence...
Owen draws a blank... And the cart knocks into the car's side door!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: She can't take much abuse! Be careful!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nate, we're kind of in the middle of something!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, just pipe down back there!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Owen, you got a lot of nerve calling me out when `you're` the one who turned traitor `first.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Owen, you got a lot of nerve calling me out when [color=#e23b3b][i]you're[/i][/color] the one who turned traitor [color=#e23b3b][i]first.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is that right? Well, I guess you got it all figured out, huh?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Fruit cart. `Fruit cart!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Fruit cart. [color=#e23b3b][i]Fruit cart![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A street vendor's cart full of produce rolls off of the curb and sails into the road, threatening to hit the car's side!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: One sec!
Owen slides the car cleanly into a perfect turn, narrowly missing the surrounding cars!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey, easy! Cutting it close there!
The car turns too wide... And scrapes against a streetlight with a crunch!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoops!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ho ho! My dear Kimi, only one nefarious character is cunning and devious enough to orchestrate such a plot!
Erik smiles and gives a jaunty wink!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: ...None other than the Town Crier himself!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: ...With help from his girlfriend who happens to live on a farm.
Erik leads the others, pushing through the crowd and making his way to the exit!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Troublemakers, away!
You are now playing as Owen.
The Troublemakers rush out to the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We've got to get across town to City Hall before the meeting ends!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: My grandma's station wagon will never make it there in time. If only we had something with `real` horsepower...
nodes.text_bbcode: My grandma's station wagon will never make it there in time. If only we had something with [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] horsepower...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Nate has a sports car. He's boasted of its efficacy on several occasions. It's parked right there!
$ALLISON points across the lot to a gleaming red sports car!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Whoa whoa whoa, `my` car?
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa whoa whoa, [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] car?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: My dad JUST bought that. No one even `touches` that thing but me!
nodes.text_bbcode: My dad JUST bought that. No one even [color=#e23b3b][i]touches[/i][/color] that thing but me!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But we need it! Unless you think it's not fast enough...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey, we're talking about a top of the line machine, here! That's three hundred and five horses under the hood!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Perfect. So either make yourself useful and hand over the keys, or get out of our way.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: But...
Nate pulls the car keys out of his pocket and ponders them... When Paige snatches them up!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey! If `anyone` is gonna drive this car, it's gonna be--
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey! If [color=#e23b3b][i]anyone[/i][/color] is gonna drive this car, it's gonna be--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Trust me. You wanna get somewhere fast? Let Owen drive.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And I'm supposed to just trust him with my car?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Believe me. There are a lot of names I could call Owen. But 'bad driver' is not one of them.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean? What other names would you call me?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No time for that now. Let's go!
Owen takes the keys and climbs into the driver's seat while Spencer takes shotgun, forcing the rest of the Troublemakers to squeeze into the backseat, much to Nate's chagrin!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: All right, but everyone just watch the upholstery...
Owen turns the ignition, and the engine roars to life! With quick, expert movements, he shifts the car into gear and peels out of the parking lot at top speed!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Step on it, Owen. We can't let Mr. Hart speak at that City Hall meeting!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know what's at stake here.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well if things go south, you can always go join Wilson High. You already wrestle for them. But the `rest` of us can't switch sides so easily.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well if things go south, you can always go join Wilson High. You already wrestle for them. But the [color=#e23b3b][i]rest[/i][/color] of us can't switch sides so easily.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh yeah? You mean the way you switched over to Mr. Hart's side?
`SKREEE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]SKREEE![/b]

nodes.text: Tires screech as Owen takes a tight, high-speed turn!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That 'Pig Girl' reputation is coming back to haunt me!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You mean you have, like, pig-summoning powers? I thought that was just a nickname!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, I mean someone is playing another prank on me!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's not entirely accurate, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, no?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's a prank, of sorts, but not on you!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Admit it. This was you!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Because of... Um... Karma?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not karma... But perhaps an agent of destiny!
While $Travis and Kimi giggle and banter back and forth, the others sneak out of the room through the unwatched door!
Once they're clear, Kimi nods and follows...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, it was super cool talking to you, $Travis! I'll see you later!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Sure! See you--

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Wait, wha?
Out in the hall, Kimi calls to the others!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hurry, bar the door!
The Troublemakers drag a bench over and push it against the Student Lounge door, bracing it shut! $Travis bangs on the other side, roaring!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Phew!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That was awesome, Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks!
The Troublemakers bolt for the school exit with Nate in tow... But as the group rounds the corner, they slide to a horrified stop!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh no.
Down the hall, six more security guards mill about, keeping watch!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh! What do we do now? We can't have Kimi flirt with all of them.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...Or can we?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Baby steps.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey, am I crazy, or do you guys hear... Squealing?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Look!
Suddenly, the hallway doors burst open and a dozen small pigs scamper through!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoa!
Chaos ensues as the security guards scramble to round them up, and students flood the halls to watch the commotion!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Pigs! Why did it have to be pigs?!
Screams sound from the girls' locker room as the pigs make their way in!
A miniature herd stampedes into the cafeteria to the sound of tiny hoofbeats and platters crashing!
Still more pigs invade the Home Ec class and leave covered in spaghetti sauce!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: This is all happening because of...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey, $Travis! How many cat enthusiasts does it take to screw in a lightbulb?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Are you... Making fun of me?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What? No!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Yeah, right. The only time cute girls approach me is when they want to make fun of me.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's not true!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...Wait, did you just call me 'cute'?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Um, yeah. Duh.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You must be mistaken. After the Winter Dance, I'll forever be known as the 'Pig Girl'. `SO` not cute.
nodes.text_bbcode: You must be mistaken. After the Winter Dance, I'll forever be known as the 'Pig Girl'. [color=#3b78e2][i]SO[/i][/color] not cute.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Yeah, I heard about that. Whatever, though. Dumb pranks are dumb pranks. At the end of the day, you're still really cute.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmigod, $Travis! That is so `sweet!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ohmigod, $Travis! That is so [color=#3b78e2][i]sweet![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: No one's ever called me 'sweet' before... Heh heh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey, $Travis... You shouldn't be burying your face in that magazine all day.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Oh yeah? And why not?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Um, because... It's much too handsome?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: 'Handsome'?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: No one's ever called me handsome before. Especially not a cute girl.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: 'Cute girl'? I think you're mistaken. After the Winter Dance, everyone just knows me as the Pig Girl. `SO` not cute.
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Cute girl'? I think you're mistaken. After the Winter Dance, everyone just knows me as the Pig Girl. [color=#3b78e2][i]SO[/i][/color] not cute.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Yeah, I heard about that. Whatever, though. Dumb pranks are dumb pranks. At the end of the day, you're still really cute.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmigod, $Travis! That is so `sweet!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ohmigod, $Travis! That is so [color=#3b78e2][i]sweet![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: No one's ever called me 'sweet' before, either... Heh heh...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah. This is pointless.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hey, pipe down over there! This is supposed to be detention.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: You guys are like a litter of Japanese Bobtails!
The Troublemakers respond with vacant stares...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Widely known to be one of the most vocal cat breeds? Ugh!
The Troublemakers quiet down and wait for $Travis to continue reading...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We can still stop Mr. Hart! The Town Crier's got a few tricks up his sleeve, but first things first. We have to get out of this room!
Erik slowly, quietly rises to his feet... He looks to see $Travis, who slumps down behind his magazine in the chair by the door...
...Suddenly, Erik bolts for the exit!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Hrrk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hrrk![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Erik stops dead in his tracks as $Travis grabs his collar with a big, meaty fist!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Nice try.
$Travis stands and lifts Erik up with one arm, carrying him back to his seat and plopping him down with ease. Without another word, he sits back down in his chair by the door.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: So how exactly are we supposed to escape with Sasquatch over there on security duty? He tossed Erik like a sack of potatoes!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's true. I go limp as a defense mechanism.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Can't Owen or Spencer try?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, we're strong, but $Travis is a `giant.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, we're strong, but $Travis is a [color=#e23b3b][i]giant.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: One of the girls should distract him. You know, like... Charm him. Flatter him! Like they do in movies all the time!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You mean offer him embellished and undue compliments to inflate his ego?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Um, yeah... But the less robotic version of that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh. Like making him feel `'good'` about himself? All that `'self-esteem'` stuff?
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh. Like making him feel [color=#3b78e2][i]'good'[/i][/color] about himself? All that [color=#3b78e2][i]'self-esteem'[/i][/color] stuff?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why did you make air quotes when you said self-esteem?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, maybe we need a girl who's... You know, `nicer.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, maybe we need a girl who's... You know, [color=#e23b3b][i]nicer.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: All the Troublemakers turn to Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Me?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Forget it! Did you `see` what happened at the Winter Dance? The whole school laughed while pigs chased me on stage!
nodes.text_bbcode: Forget it! Did you [color=#3b78e2][i]see[/i][/color] what happened at the Winter Dance? The whole school laughed while pigs chased me on stage!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No guy will ever consider me datable again, let alone `charming!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No guy will ever consider me datable again, let alone [color=#3b78e2][i]charming![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's not true! Kimi, you can do this!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I've envied your warmth and approachability on several occasions.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `Arrrrrgghh,` Fine, I'll do it!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Arrrrrgghh,[/i][/color] Fine, I'll do it!

nodes.text: Kimi clears her throat...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey, $Travis... I need to say something to you...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Mr. Hart said I'm not supposed to talk to you guys. Besides, I'm reading my magazine.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It'll only take a second!
$Travis sighs and rolls his eyes before getting up and walking over to Kimi's seat.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I should try to...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure. Good luck trying to get Spencer to listen.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, I'm right here! Let's talk! Talk away!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: 'Talking' would involve actual speech, not just posturing and caveman grunts.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay, maybe that backfired! Everyone settle down!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Perhaps now is not the time to deliberate for resolution.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: In other words, let's all shut up and focus. We've got bigger things to worry about. We've got to stop Mr. Hart from becoming principal of Twin Branches!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We've got bigger things to worry about! We've got to stop Mr. Hart from becoming principal of Twin Branches!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kimi's right. We can't get caught up fighting over little things.

nodes.title: Hart Attack
nodes.subtitle: Can the Troublemakers stop Mr. Hart's plan once and for all?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Kimi.
$Travis shoves Spencer and Erik down into seats in the Student Lounge as the other Troublemakers look on.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, easy $Travis!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Nothing personal, Spencer. Mr. Hart hired me as a Campus Security Guard and Detention Monitor. Even gave me this ID badge!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Anyway, I gotta make sure that none of you leave this room for the next two hours.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So you mean you're our `jailor.`
nodes.text_bbcode: So you mean you're our [color=#e23b3b][i]jailor.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hey that sounds even cooler! I'm a jailor!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Congrats.
$Travis plops down into the seat by the door, puts on headphones, and bobs his head to music as he buries his face in an issue of 'Fancy Cats Magazine'.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nice of you to join us, Spence.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Are you guys all right?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We're fine.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Erik, they found you too?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, they found me when I met up with Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So Spencer led them right to you. Of course.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It means you stabbed Erik in the back! Just like you stabbed all of us in the back when you joined Mr. Hart.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I wouldn't be talking if I were you, Wilson boy.
Owen gets out of his seat.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You really wanna start this again?
The two stride toward each other, glaring.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Guys, don't worry! Everything will turn out fine!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. Once we figure out a way to get out of detention and over to that meeting at City Hall. If we don't, Hart's gonna convince the mayor to make him our principal!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: My dad may be the mayor, but the final decision is up to the school board members. They'll be in attendance too. I've been to a hundred of these things.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You should try the sugar cookies they put out.
Spencer's eyes lock on Nate, wide with rage.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Do you think this is a joke? And who asked `you?` And what the heck are you `doing` here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you think this is a joke? And who asked [color=#e23b3b][i]you?[/i][/color] And what the heck are you [color=#e23b3b][i]doing[/i][/color] here?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Look, I was just with $ALLISON when Hart's security guards came to bring her in. They grabbed me too. Didn't even ask questions.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: This bickering isn't getting us anywhere! I think we all need to...

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Spencer!
Candace interrupts the conversation as she rounds the corner toward them!

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Hey Spencer, come on! We've got a bus to catch!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, right!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Candace?
Spencer packs up his bag and closes his locker.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, sorry $ALLISON, I've gotta go.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Candace and I are going to see `Slamageddon 2014!` She `really` thinks El Guapo is gonna take the championship belt from Bashin' Bobby Bashwell, which is `crazy talk.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Candace and I are going to see [color=#e23b3b][i]Slamageddon 2014![/i][/color] She [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] thinks El Guapo is gonna take the championship belt from Bashin' Bobby Bashwell, which is [color=#e23b3b][i]crazy talk.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Hey, have you `seen` him do the Handsome Bomb? No opponent gets up from that finishing move!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, have you [color=#3b78e2][i]seen[/i][/color] him do the Handsome Bomb? No opponent gets up from that finishing move!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ah... A professional wrestling event. That sounds like a lot of fun.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah! Should be great!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Anyway... I'll talk to you later?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Of course! Don't let me keep you...

nodes.speaker: Candace
nodes.text: Bye, $ALLISON!
Candace and Spencer walk off, spouting excited catch phrases and pantomiming wrestling moves. $ALLISON sighs, before starting on her way to her Book Club meeting...
You have reached the end of `Season 3, Episode 8: Hart Attack!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 3, Episode 8: Hart Attack![/b]

nodes.text: Did you miss what happened over Winter Break?! Troublemakers Season 2: Holiday Hearts is available now in More Episodes!
And remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Book Club?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yeah! I mean... We're getting more members every day, but it would be nice to have another familiar face...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You mean, besides Nate's?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... Well... I only meant that...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Look, I get it. Not that it wouldn't be fun... But it's still kinda weird for me, you know?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sure... In that case, maybe some other--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: By `me?`
nodes.text_bbcode: By [color=#e23b3b][i]me?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes! I mean... I already thought very highly of you. But your compassion, your maturity...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's like I'm seeing a whole new side of you.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heh... Well, thanks.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hey... I know our last excursion to the bookstore went spectacularly awry, but perhaps it warrants another attempt... Anyway, I guess what I'm doing is asking you out--

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Me?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, yeah... You're somebody worth impressing.
Spencer looks down as $ALLISON's face begins to blush...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Spencer, I... I need to tell you something...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yeah... I think...

options.label: You should join my Book Club.
I'm very much impressed by you.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I know you two have issues, but I believe there is some good in him.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'll admit. Maybe he's not as much of a scumbag as I thought...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean I'm about to be all buddy-buddy with him.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Plus, I'm pretty sure he did it just to impress `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Plus, I'm pretty sure he did it just to impress [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, no duh. But I wouldn't say 'people'. More like one 'person'.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's pretty obvious that he was trying to impress `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's pretty obvious that he was trying to impress [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Thanks, $ALLISON! You sure know how to make a girl feel welcome.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Delilah this is SO exciting! I can't wait to teach you all you need to know about Twin Branches High!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The latest fashions, what's trending, what's over... Now, what season of 'Silly Little Gossips' are you on?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: ...I don't understand any of the words you just said.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: OMG. Marathon. My place. `Tonight.`
nodes.text_bbcode: OMG. Marathon. My place. [color=#3b78e2][i]Tonight.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Kimi pulls Delilah along as Erik rushes to keep up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: To clarify, not an `actual` marathon!
nodes.text_bbcode: To clarify, not an [color=#e23b3b][i]actual[/i][/color] marathon!

nodes.text: $ALLISON smiles and continues at her own pace...
...When she runs into Spencer at his locker.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh! Spencer! Hello...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Where are Paige and Owen?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, they're over at Wilson High for Owen's wrestling meet.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh! That's exciting!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, he and I hashed it out. The guy loves wrestling, and really wants that scholarship. Plus, he's my boy. I'm gonna back him up.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But you better believe I'm gonna be wearing my Twin Branches jersey in the crowd if I come cheer for him!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hee hee! I'm so glad you two were able to reconcile that misunderstanding.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, me too. Speaking of misunderstandings... Nate really did us a solid at that City Hall meeting.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes, I agree.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But I'm not sure he did it for the right reasons.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I believe he did it...

options.label: Because it was the right thing to do.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Oh... Well, it's nice to be useful, I suppose. Daddy says everyone should pull their weight.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Maybe I could hang out with y'all as a friend, too? And not just an escape plan?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh! Of course!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm sorry, I didn't mean for it to sound like our relationship is purely utilitarian.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I look forward to socializing with you in a friendly capacity.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Is that... A compliment?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Of course! I think you'll fit right in with our mischievous troupe!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: All right, all right... I think Mr. Ericson is blowing a few things out of proportion here!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I respectfully disagree, Mr. Hart. Your hoarding of information has reached obsessive degrees! You've overstepped your bounds by an appalling margin!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah! You also went `way` too far!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! You also went [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too far!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...But that's just what $ALLISON just said, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hee hee! Yep!
Spencer and $ALLISON exchange a slight smile... Nearby, Nate crosses his arms and scoffs...
The board members nod thoughtfully, eyeing Mr. Hart with new suspicion.

nodes.speaker: The Mayor
nodes.text: Hmm... The kids have a point...
Mr. Hart raises his hands to calm the roused crowd.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Members of the board, that's all well and good... But I feel I should point out...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: ...These children are `Troublemakers!` Repeat offenders! Detention rats!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...These children are [color=#e23b3b][i]Troublemakers![/i][/color] Repeat offenders! Detention rats!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `What?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I've read their files, and not one of them has a clean record!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Ms. Applebee has been disciplined for attacking another student in the halls! Just the kind of thing my surveillance would prevent!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: And who else's testimony should we consider, hmm? A football player who cheats on standardized tests? Or maybe his violent teammate from the wrong side of the tracks?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why that--

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: A purveyor of obscene fashion? A shoplifter? A malicious hacker?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: 'Obscene'?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He did `not` go there.
nodes.text_bbcode: He did [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] go there.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The fiend...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: We must take the word of `delinquents` with a grain of salt! Of `course` they oppose more strict monitoring!
nodes.text_bbcode: We must take the word of [color=#e23b3b][i]delinquents[/i][/color] with a grain of salt! Of [color=#e23b3b][i]course[/i][/color] they oppose more strict monitoring!

nodes.speaker: The Mayor
nodes.text: That `is` troubling...
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] troubling...

nodes.text: Erik's stomach sinks, and a feeling of dread spreads through his body as Mr. Hart flashes a confident smirk...

nodes.speaker: The Mayor
nodes.text: Does anyone else have anything to say before the board members deliberate?
A hush falls over the room...

nodes.speaker: The Mayor
nodes.text: Well, since no one has anything further to add, I can say with full confidence that this deliberation will be a formality. Mr. Hart, you may consider yourself princip--

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: `Wait.` I've got something to say.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Wait.[/i][/color] I've got something to say.

nodes.speaker: The Mayor
nodes.text: Son?
Nate locks eyes with Spencer. His expression hardens into a scowl...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: ...It's true. 'The Troublemakers' live up to their name at times.
...Until his gaze finds $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: ...But what you see in a person at first glance isn't always who they really are.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You need the whole story to judge someone... And Mr. Hart's system only seeks out the worst.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: The Troublemakers have been through a lot because of Mr. Hart's security initiative. And what they say is true. It'll cause problems. It's downright `wrong.`
nodes.text_bbcode: The Troublemakers have been through a lot because of Mr. Hart's security initiative. And what they say is true. It'll cause problems. It's downright [color=#e23b3b][i]wrong.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Mr. Hart is `not` a man you want as principal. I'm completely convinced.
nodes.text_bbcode: Mr. Hart is [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] a man you want as principal. I'm completely convinced.

nodes.text: The crowd applauds!

nodes.speaker: The Mayor
nodes.text: Hmph. Thank you Nate, that was very enlightening. I'm sure you've given the board a lot to think about.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Wait! That's not fair! You can't believe a word they say! They're lying!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: These brats are `lying!` In all my tenure I have never been anything but ethical!
nodes.text_bbcode: These brats are [color=#e23b3b][i]lying![/i][/color] In all my tenure I have never been anything but ethical!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Oh, I wouldn't say that.
All eyes turn to Officer Monte as he bursts through the entrance of the hall.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Officer Monte. How good of you to barge in. Unprofessional, as always.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You wanna talk about unprofessional? Let's talk about this surveillance camera I found. This one of yours?
Officer Monte holds up a tiny recording device for all to see.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Of course it is! Have you been living under a rock? I surveil everything that happens on the Twin Branches campus!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Then tell me why `this` camera was found hidden in `Ms. McCormick's car!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Then tell me why [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] camera was found hidden in [color=#e23b3b][i]Ms. McCormick's car![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I... Wait! There's a very good reason for that...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Keeping an eye out for punks and pickpockets is one thing... But bugging a colleague's personal property? Searching for dirt on your rival for the position of principal?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Doesn't seem much like 'ethical' to me.

nodes.speaker: The Mayor
nodes.text: Hart! If you ever want to work in education again, you've got a `lot` of explaining to do!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hart! If you ever want to work in education again, you've got a [color=#e23b3b][i]lot[/i][/color] of explaining to do!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Well... You see, the thing you must understand is...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: `YOU'LL NEVER TAKE ME ALIVE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]YOU'LL NEVER TAKE ME ALIVE![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Mr. Hart bolts for the emergency exit!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Oh, no you don't!
Officer Monte charges into a full sprint... And tackles Mr. Hart into a refreshment table!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Oof!
Iced tea and sugar cookies go flying, splattering all over them!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nice tackle!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Such a waste of good cookies...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That, Kimi, is the sweet, sugary taste of justice.
You are now playing as $ALLISON.
A few days later, the final bell of the day rings as $ALLISON walks through the hallways with Kimi and Erik.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm SO happy things are getting back to the way they were around here. All those cameras were `mega` creepy.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm SO happy things are getting back to the way they were around here. All those cameras were [color=#3b78e2][i]mega[/i][/color] creepy.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It `is` comforting to return to a certain degree of normalcy.
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] comforting to return to a certain degree of normalcy.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well... To be completely honest, there's something I miss about the whimsy and adventure of being the Town Crier...
Kimi's eyes lock on the entrance down the hall, where a familiar face appears in the door way...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I think I see something that might cheer you up. Look!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Hey everybody!
Erik and Delilah run and wrap each other in a tight hug!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Delilah! You're here! Does that mean what I think it means?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Yup! It's official, darlin'! I'm a...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: ...What's the Twin Branches mascot again? Was it a lizard or a squirrel?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Whatever the zoological totem, one thing is certain. You definitely...

options.label: Proved to be an asset to the team!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: How does that even apply? I `am` preparing! Preparing a safe environment for the student body!
nodes.text_bbcode: How does that even apply? I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] preparing! Preparing a safe environment for the student body!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, it's a pretty crummy environment if you ask me..

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not your best speech, Town Crier...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The point is, Mr. Hart... Stop spying on us!
The crowd applauds!
The crowd raises a roar of applause!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We will suffer your tyranny no more!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah! It's a basic right that you're taking away from us!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Spencer, it wasn't too long ago that you agreed that secrets were the cause of all your troubles. And that our monitoring `protected` people from those secrets.
nodes.text_bbcode: Spencer, it wasn't too long ago that you agreed that secrets were the cause of all your troubles. And that our monitoring [color=#e23b3b][i]protected[/i][/color] people from those secrets.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I know. But I was wrong.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah. Just because you `can` pry into someone's business doesn't mean you `should.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. Just because you [color=#3b78e2][i]can[/i][/color] pry into someone's business doesn't mean you [color=#3b78e2][i]should.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Trust and openness should be given, not taken by force.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The people have spoken, Mr. Hart! To paraphrase Benjamin Franklin...

options.label: By failing to prepare, you are preparing to fail!
Those who sacrifice freedom for security deserve neither!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's degrading to be watched over like a hawk!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Well, that seems like a personal matter to me. There are plenty of students whose egos aren't hurt by a little monitoring.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I think you'll just have to swallow your pride, Mr. Ericson.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's not just about pride! It's a matter of privacy!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So much is lost when we let people invade our private business!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Is that so? And what exactly have you sacrificed that's more important than security?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We've had to sacrifice so much for this so-called 'security'.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Why, yes! Vandalism is down, and fighting is at an all-time low!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It is? I... Was not aware...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I think Erik's point is, even if that's true, is it all worth it?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: We've sacrificed so much for this so-called 'security'.
The room goes completely silent as all eyes turn to the Troublemakers at the back of the meeting hall.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Well that was... Dramatic.
Up on stage, Nate's father, Mayor Crawford, shifts uncomfortably in his seat as the Troublemakers march up to the stage.

nodes.speaker: The Mayor
nodes.text: What... What's the meaning of this?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Mr. Hart `cannot` be allowed to be principal of Twin Branches!
nodes.text_bbcode: Mr. Hart [color=#e23b3b][i]cannot[/i][/color] be allowed to be principal of Twin Branches!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I'm sorry, kids, but I only do what's best for the student body. And right now that means stepping up to the plate as principal to ensure school security!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yes, but...
You are now playing as Erik.
The Troublemakers arrive outside of City Hall. As Owen throws Nate's car into park, the group pours out!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on! Let's hope we're not too late!
They run into the building...
Where the meeting is already well underway!
Up on stage, next to the mayor and members of the school board, Mr. Hart addresses the audience from behind a podium.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: So you see, good people of Centerscore, with my 'Branchi' system of information monitoring and security, I've created a safe, wholesome environment, ideal for education!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: If chosen to be the principal, I would continue to foster this ideal environment... And even assist other campuses in implementing the Branchi system!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh no... He's going to spread the Branchi system to other schools!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No...
Horror grips Erik... Desperate, he steps forward and shouts...
$ALLISON tries not to let her look linger for too long.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... I should be going. I think our meeting's over.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah, me too.
$ALLISON picks up her stuff and hustles out of the restaurant, confused...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What was that?
Before school the next day...
...$ALLISON rushes up to Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Kimi! I have to talk to you!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Me? Why?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Because! Something happened last night, and I'm feeling, well, I don't know how I'm feeling! And you said your resolution was to keep secrets...
Kimi's eyes go wide!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! It's about a guy, isn't it?! Is it Spencer?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eeep! Tell me! Wait, don't tell me!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm getting mixed signals... I thought your resolution was to `keep` secrets.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm getting mixed signals... I thought your resolution was to [color=#3b78e2][i]keep[/i][/color] secrets.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yes, but that doesn't mean we have to test it right away!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Okay, I guess I could go tell someone else. Like Paige...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No! No no no no no! You can tell me. I'll be good, I promise!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You're sure?
Kimi nods. $ALLISON tells Kimi about her book club meeting with Nate.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So... It was just the two of you?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh huh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And you got food together?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Who paid for the food?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, he did, but I got us a table. It was very efficient!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It was also a date...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What?! No, it wasn't!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Two people eating food together at night... `And` he paid for it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Two people eating food together at night... [color=#3b78e2][i]And[/i][/color] he paid for it.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: In phrasing you can relate to... That's the definition of a date, $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh my!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, going out on a date with a guy, even unintentionally, isn't the worst thing that's ever happened!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No, you don't understand... Spencer asked me out yesterday, and I postponed it so I could go to this book club.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: To be honest, dating two guys is not the worst thing either...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes, but rejecting Spencer to date his enemy, even unintentionally, feels so wrong.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What am I going to tell Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh... I recommend not doing that.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Don't tell him?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Telling him's just going to hurt him, $ALLISON. Besides, it's not like you have feelings for Nate, right?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I can't like Nate.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, it'd be like liking... A monster...
You have reached the end of `Season 3, Episode 1: The Date!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 3, Episode 1: The Date![/b]

nodes.text: Did you miss what happened this summer?! A New Start 7: Summer Showdowns is available now in More Episodes!
And remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I can't! I'm a cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really? `You` can't do something.
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? [color=#3b78e2][i]You[/i][/color] can't do something.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Well, I can do anything, but that's besides the point!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why don't you just face up to the fact that you've always wanted to be the head of something...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And that you're never going to be the head of the cheerleading team...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, haven't you been on that team, for, like, ever?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Too long...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The Tumbling Club Presidency is yours... If you can handle it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Or, I could just keep it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Or, I could just keep it...
Jill scoffs.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Pfft. `I'll` take it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Pfft. [color=#3b78e2][i]I'll[/i][/color] take it.

nodes.text: After school the next day...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's one down. How do we get Nicole to quit cheerleading? She loves being a cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, the same thing that worked with Jill isn't going to work with Nicole, that's for sure.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What is Nicole into? Wait... Never mind. That's super obvious... `Boys.`
nodes.text_bbcode: What is Nicole into? Wait... Never mind. That's super obvious... [color=#3b78e2][i]Boys.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's practically a sickness with her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Anyway, let's go find her. If I know how her mind works, she's probably infatuated with some dumb boy now.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I heard she was going to be at that new 50's-style diner that just opened up.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Let's go, uh, jitterbug then! That's an old dance, right?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Like I would know...
Not long after, Paige and Kimi are sitting at a table in the middle of a 50's-style diner. A rock 'n' roll song blares over a jukebox, and students crowd into vinyl-covered booths.
Paige nudges Kimi as Maria and the cheerleaders enter...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I can't believe Jill left us for some stupid aerobics class or whatever. I hope she's okay with being unpopular!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Pfft! What a loser!
Paige calls out to Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Psst! Nicole! Come here!
Nicole rolls her eyes and heads over to Paige and Kimi. Before she reaches them, Paige whispers to Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just follow my lead.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Got it.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm still not giving you info on Maria, okay?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We don't care about Maria... We want to know about you.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What for?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Frankly, we heard you...
$ALLISON and Spencer look up from their date...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh... Hi.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, we're kind of on a date right now, so...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, we know!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So, why are you here?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We're here because... Why are we here, Kimi?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We wanted to make it a double date!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Not that Paige and I are dating, just that there should always be four people on a date. That's a saying!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm not aware of this cultural phenomenon... I always believed it to be `two` people on a date.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not aware of this cultural phenomenon... I always believed it to be [color=#3b78e2][i]two[/i][/color] people on a date.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Seriously. You're not here for a date. So spill it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine! We're here because... Uh... Help me out, Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Because...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Because $ALLISON went out on a date with Nate at the book club!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Kimi?! How could you betray my trust?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?! So it's true?!
Paige sees the rage in Spencer's eyes and knows that whatever happens from here on out, there will be no chance of Spencer and $ALLISON ever being together...
She knows that she shouldn't have brought Kimi over...
She knows that...
As detention ends, Kimi rises from her seat, beelining toward the door.
Erik gets in her way.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What is it?! What secret do you want me to try and stop the nerds from discovering?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: None! I just wanted to confess a secret of my own.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you the Town Crier?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ha! That'd be a hoot!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I just wanted to say that I've been sneaking raisins here in detention, a clear violation of the 'No Snacks' policy.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It feels good to get that off my chest.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, thanks for clearing that up, Erik! Gotta go!
Kimi sidesteps Erik, racing out of detention!
After... Spencer sits down next to a worried-looking $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, Red. I know this Town Crier thing seems bad, but don't worry...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's to know? We're out of detention, and I've got a perfect, awesome, knockout date planned!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nothing can ruin it.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That `does` sound like the quintessential distraction.
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#3b78e2][i]does[/i][/color] sound like the quintessential distraction.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Then let's get out of here!
Spencer escorts $ALLISON out...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Gulp!
With a quick step forward, Spencer lunges at Erik, trying to bear hug him!
Owen motors along the park path, looking for an exit...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If I cut across this park, I should be able to get back onto the main road, just need to find a way to--

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Watch it! Fountain up ahead!
Owen's eyes lock on the large fountain in the center of the park just ahead of him!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Whoa!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Whoa![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He grips the wheel and turns hard...
...Maintaining control of the car! He swerves just enough to narrowly miss the fountain's edge!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Woo!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Ha! Gotta hand it to ya, Harris! You've got some serious--

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: `Look out!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Look out![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The car zooms back out onto the main road... Where warning signs for unfinished road work greet them!
Up ahead, orange safety cones surround a ditch on the roadside five feet deep! Owen moves to react, but it's too late!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Aah!
Nate's sports car barrels over the safety cones and dives into the soft dirt at the bottom of the ditch!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oof!
...But the car is too slow to respond!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Aah!
`KRRSSSHH!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]KRRSSSHH!!![/b]

nodes.text: The car careens off the path and barrels over the low wall of the fountain, sloshing down into the water!
Torrents of water spout up from the broken fixture in the center of the fountain and pour down all over the car.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: No no no no `no!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No no no no [color=#e23b3b][i]no![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Everyone all right?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: We're unharmed... Though I can't say the same for Nate's vehicle...
The group exits the car, slogging though the waist-high water to climb out of the fountain.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm guessing you might need a new front fender.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Forget the fender, the engine is flooded! Which means this car's not going `anywhere` any time soon.
nodes.text_bbcode: Forget the fender, the engine is flooded! Which means this car's not going [color=#e23b3b][i]anywhere[/i][/color] any time soon.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Which also means we'll never get to City Hall in time!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Which `also` means we won't be there to stop Mr. Hart from becoming our `principal!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Which [color=#e23b3b][i]also[/i][/color] means we won't be there to stop Mr. Hart from becoming our [color=#e23b3b][i]principal![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Which also means...
...Owen has failed.
