options.label: Episode Three: The Secret Life of Owen Harris

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That was intense.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You really pushed one of his buttons, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: More importantly, who passes up a laptop?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You are aware that you were offered something expensive `for free?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You are aware that you were offered something expensive [color=#3b78e2][i]for free?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, I got it. I don't know... At first, I was just refusing because of Ms. Lee and my dad's advice, but `now...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I got it. I don't know... At first, I was just refusing because of Ms. Lee and my dad's advice, but [color=#e23b3b][i]now...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I think something's up with Mr. Hart!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well butter my muffin, I'm proud of you, Spencer! You followed your instincts!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: They may be crazy, paranoid instincts, but you still followed them, and that's what matters.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh huh. Thanks, I guess.
A few moments later, things have calmed down. Mr. Hart has returned, and all the Troublemakers except Spencer are enjoying their new laptops.
Spencer notices that $ALLISON is fixated on her screen, clicking away obliviously and `alone.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Spencer notices that $ALLISON is fixated on her screen, clicking away obliviously and [b]alone.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This is my chance... Time to fulfill `my resolution` and ask her out!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is my chance... Time to fulfill [color=#e23b3b][i]my resolution[/i][/color] and ask her out!

nodes.text: He approaches her, trying not to seem too nervous...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: $ALLISON?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes?
He sits next to her, scooting his chair close.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I, uh... So I've got two tickets to this opera thing tonight.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's peculiar. You and opera go together like bulls and ballet.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, I knew you'd say something like that.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Look, I got the tickets so that we could go see them, er, it. The opera.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, I'd `love` to go!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I'd [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] to go!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Unfortunately...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What is it? Is it me? I can get better shoes!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What?! No!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I `just` created this book club on the school site, and it's already full! Can you believe it?!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] created this book club on the school site, and it's already full! Can you believe it?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No! That's... Ludicrous!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Nice usage! Who knew this school was a veritable nest of bookworms?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Anyway, tonight's our first meeting! If I went to the opera with you, I'd be abandoning all these new members!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why don't...

options.label: I come to the book club instead?

nodes.text: Paige lowers her voice to a whisper...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It all started at the Homecoming Dance...
`The past...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]The past...[/b]

nodes.text: Paige pulls Lee out of the dance and into the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Where are you dragging me?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Somewhere more fancy and more fun!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: More fancy and fun than a fancy, fun dance?! Are you still trying to one-up Owen?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes! Now let's go!
Just then, Owen and Maria burst out of the dance, Maria clutching a crown and struggling to slow Owen down.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Where are you taking me?! The Homecoming Queen isn't supposed to `leave` the dance! My subjects are waiting to worship me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Where are you taking me?! The Homecoming Queen isn't supposed to [color=#3b78e2][i]leave[/i][/color] the dance! My subjects are waiting to worship me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on! We have to make sure we do something more fun than--
Owen stops talking when he sees that Paige is within earshot.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Oh, I get it. You're trying to make little Miss Used-To-Be-Somebody jealous.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did you just say what I think you said?!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You heard me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you doing out here with this `garbage sack,` Owen?! It isn't trash night, is it?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you doing out here with this [color=#3b78e2][i]garbage sack,[/i][/color] Owen?! It isn't trash night, is it?!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Grr!
Both girls march out across the parking lot, stopping just a few inches away from each other.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's your problem, cheerleader?!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I don't know, you tell me! I just won Homecoming Queen!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So?!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So?! You're not jealous?! That used to mean something to you!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not anymore.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And what if I told you I'm going to be the Winter Queen too?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hashtag who cares?!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So you're telling me even though all Winter Royalty get a limo, a special dinner, and a private ice skating session, you don't care?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I am `so` confused! What are you getting at?!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] confused! What are you getting at?!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What do you think?! You used to be a threat. I'm wondering if you still are!
Meanwhile, Owen nods at Lee from across the parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Just hanging out.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Cool.
Back with the girls...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't care about popularity contests anymore, Maria. I've moved on.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Well, that explains your look... And why you no longer get invited to parties. But I'm not buying this whole 'I don't care' act.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Watch your back, because if you try to win Winter Queen, I'll be stepping all over you!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: See you never.
`The present...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]The present...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ouch.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's not even the worst part. I just found out that Maria's starting a campaign to make me the Winter Jester at the dance this year!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Is that the guy who has to wear that ugly costume and hold that creepy scepter?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes! One, the jester's always a guy! And two, he's always someone goofy who doesn't mind being laughed at by the whole school!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You're neither of those!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know! So now you understand why I need your help.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Of course! You want me to start a separate campaign to sway the Jester vote away from you... I'm in!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Kimi, Kimi, Kimi... You're not thinking big enough...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...My New Year's resolution isn't to avoid becoming the Jester...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...It's to `become the Winter Queen!`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...It's to [color=#3b78e2][i]become the Winter Queen![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh... No offense, but that's impossible. Maria's going to be Queen... She's super trending right now.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're forgetting who you're talking to. I used to run this school.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Keywords, 'used to'. I mean, it'd be hard enough to get your popularity back, let alone bring down Maria.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: She's the Head Cheerleader, and as long as she holds that position, you'll...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You'll... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh no, I don't like that look...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're right. As long as Maria's the Head Cheerleader, she rules...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...That's why we're going to `end cheerleading.`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...That's why we're going to [color=#3b78e2][i]end cheerleading.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Shhh!
Kimi grabs Paige and yanks her into the girls' restroom!
Inside, Kimi quickly checks under all the stalls to make sure the restroom's empty.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Are you crazy?! You can't `end` cheerleading!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you crazy?! You can't [color=#3b78e2][i]end[/i][/color] cheerleading!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why not?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh, it's kind of important to school spirit and morale! Plus, every school has cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Relax, we're not ending it permanently, just long enough for me to become Winter Royalty.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `We?` Oh no, I'm out. Way out!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]We?[/i][/color] Oh no, I'm out. Way out!

nodes.text: Kimi covers her ears!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't even want to know what I already know!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But I need your help! Come on, Kimi! It's for a good cause!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What cause?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm doing it...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hrrah!
Skazz torques Owen's arm, wrenching him off balance!
Owen hits the mat with a thud!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Aah!
Skazz shifts his weight onto Owen, going for the pin! Desperate, Owen...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Where's my assistant? Erik? Could you come up here to make these announcements?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh, sure thing, Mr. H!
Erik bounds up to the front. Mr. Hart hands him some index cards.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Let's see... First, the Winter Dance is coming... Pause for applause. Whoops! Shouldn't have read that part!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Mr. Hart, what do I do if no one applauds?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Just keep going!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Roger! Uh... Congratulations to Paige for `winning Winter Queen!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Roger! Uh... Congratulations to Paige for [color=#e23b3b][i]winning Winter Queen![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It was nothing, really!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: As part of her prize for winning, Paige and a guest will get a limo ride, a fancy dinner, and afterward, ice skating! I think we all know who her guest will be... Paige's boyfriend, Owen!
Several of the football players stand up.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Traitor! He's a traitor! He left us for Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Expel him!
Spencer steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Guys, shut up! Owen might be a traitor, but this isn't the time for discussion!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So uncomfortable! My rash is acting up!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Keep reading! The next card!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay, card two! Uh... Oh gosh...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The theme for this week's Winter Dance has changed...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: From 'Snowmance' to, uh, 'Petting Zoo'? Is this a typo, Mr. H?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: No, I think it'll be a real hoot!
Kimi whispers her frustration to Paige and $ALLISON...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: When did this become a dance for babies?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Next card... There will also be some new rules at this dance.
The students begin murmuring...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Everyone will remain `indoors` once the dance begins!
nodes.text_bbcode: Everyone will remain [color=#e23b3b][i]indoors[/i][/color] once the dance begins!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Oppression!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: We won't stand for this!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Fine! Both of you are suspended! One day!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You... You can't do that!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I can, and I just did. Do you want to protest more and be suspended longer? Or do you want to pack up your things and head home?
Andrew and Nicole quietly leave the cafeteria. At Kimi's table...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! Did you guys see that?! We can't let him get away with this!
Meanwhile...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Read, Erickson!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay! Additionally, anyone dancing at a distance of closer than a foot apart will be subject to punishment, a measure to be enforced by Spencer.
Instinctively, Kimi stands up.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Mr. Hart! You can't do this!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: And why not?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Speak carefully, Kimi...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh, because...
Later, during dessert...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So what happens after this lovely meal?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, I thought we'd grab a book and read together.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You're being serious? You want to read with me?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I am.
Spencer locks eyes with $ALLISON, who smiles up at him.
As they all log on to the school site, Mr. Hart notices that Spencer hasn't touched his laptop.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Something the matter?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nope. I'm just not interested.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Heh. Sure you don't want a `free` laptop. Here.
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. Sure you don't want a [color=#e23b3b][i]free[/i][/color] laptop. Here.

nodes.text: Mr. Hart picks up the laptop and tries to hand it to Spencer.

options.label: Knock it out of his hand!

nodes.text: Meanwhile...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We've gotta do something!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do you mean?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I can't tell you what's going on, but I know something! We have to help $ALLISON out! We have to end their date, now!
Later, Owen rushes into the library back at Twin Branches, limping and out of breath.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... Sorry I'm... Late!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You'd better be sorry. These study session are some of the only times I get to see you. Where have you been?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just... Went for a run.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really? You just `had` to go running before our study session--
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? You just [color=#3b78e2][i]had[/i][/color] to go running before our study session--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait... What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't gimme that. You're all... Limpy.
Paige pokes Owen's shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ow!
Paige pulls aside Owen's shirt collar... Revealing the huge, dark bruise on his shoulder!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What the?!
She lifts Owen's shirt, revealing scattered bruises on his back from too many falls at practice.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's fine, don't worry about it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Too late. Don't move.
Paige exits to the hallway and comes back soon after with a cold canned soft drink from the vending machine.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's not ice cold, but it'll have to do.
She places the can gently against Owen's shoulder. He gives out a sigh.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks nothing! Tell me where you got this bruise!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're not in trouble, are you? This doesn't have to do with the 12th Street Kids again, does it?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No! I swear!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Then tell me what happened. And remember, I can `tell` when you're lying!
nodes.text_bbcode: Then tell me what happened. And remember, I can [color=#3b78e2][i]tell[/i][/color] when you're lying!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't lie... But I can't tell her about Wilson either! If word gets around to Spencer, he'll kill me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well... The thing is...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: No!
Owen climbs to his feet and extends a hand to Skazz...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Good match.
...But Skazz slaps his hand away!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I'll admit. You can wrestle. But you're `not` really one of us.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll admit. You can wrestle. But you're [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] really one of us.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Around here, you'll always be an outsider. And over there, you'll always be a traitor.
Later, after a long, grueling practice, Owen walks outside, nursing his aching shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I gotta remember to ice down this shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: `Beedle-dee-boop!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Beedle-dee-boop![/i]

nodes.text: Owen pulls out his phone!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Hey `Owen`! Did you say 'remember'? Would you like me to set a calendar reminder for `'ice down this shoulder'`?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey [i]Owen[/i]! Did you say 'remember'? Would you like me to set a calendar reminder for [i]'ice down this shoulder'[/i]?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, Branchi.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Awesome! Canceling reminder. Would you like to check in at your location of `'Wilson High School'`?
nodes.text_bbcode: Awesome! Canceling reminder. Would you like to check in at your location of [i]'Wilson High School'[/i]?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No! Never check in!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Okay! No problem!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: ...You have a calendar reminder in `20 minutes` for `'Study Session with Paige'`.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...You have a calendar reminder in [i]20 minutes[/i] for [i]'Study Session with Paige'[/i].

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Aw, man! I gotta get going!
Skazz strides to meet Owen in the middle of the parking lot, out of earshot from the others, who look on from opposite sides!
Owen assumes a wrestling stance but whispers to Skazz in a lowered voice.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey... We don't have to fight for real. My friends think you guys jumped me. So if we just fake a fight and make it `look` like I'm beating you--
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey... We don't have to fight for real. My friends think you guys jumped me. So if we just fake a fight and make it [color=#e23b3b][i]look[/i][/color] like I'm beating you--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `--Arrgh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]--Arrgh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Skazz wraps an arm around Owen's neck in a tight headlock!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: What the heck are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Take it easy...

options.label: I'm not going to hurt you!

nodes.text: A bookish sales clerk approaches. Owen notices a sticker on the cash register that says 'The early word gets the (book)worm!'. Spencer talks to Owen under his breath.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Remember, get her to give me permission. And I don't care how you get it, just get it!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: How can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, actually, we have kind of an odd request...
...He has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You did not say anything. Though I did note how you sucked in a little air.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Humans call that gasping.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Are you making fun of how I speak?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No. I'd never do that.
The moment gets quiet...
$ALLISON suddenly goes quiet...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What is it? What'd I say?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Nothing... I just feel like before the night continues, we should discuss what transpired during our previous date.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, it was no big deal. Did you help your sister out?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What? Oh... Well... Don't worry about that. Amanda's fine.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What I really want to say is--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You know what? Whatever it is you're going to say, you don't have to.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think you might want to hear--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's no big deal, $ALLISON.
Spencer exits to the hallway, striding quickly...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just gotta clear my head...
Suddenly, a voice sounds from behind him...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey there, Spence. You don't look too good.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Nate!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Nate![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You better take a breather, buddy. You look like you're about ready to blow a gasket.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm gonna make you regret that...
Spencer takes a step toward Nate, fists clenched!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Not so fast! We're not alone...
Spencer freezes in his tracks as Nate points upward...
...High up on the wall, a security camera looks down on them!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Wouldn't want Mr. Hart to catch you doing anything rash, now, would you? You heard what he said. 'No bullying, no fighting, no mischief'!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Arrgh... Gotta keep my cool!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You gotta admit, though... There's kind of a poetic justice to it.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: One day, you go behind my back and steal my spot on the Steelman Football Program...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: ...And the next, your girl is going behind `your` back to date `me.`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...And the next, your girl is going behind [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] back to date [color=#e23b3b][i]me.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Anger roils up inside Spencer's gut...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Rrr...
Spencer walks to the gym and pushes through the doors.
Inside, the bleachers have been pulled out, and a crowd watches as two teams prepare for a wrestling meet.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't get it. It's just a regular wrestling meet between Wilson and--
Just then, Spencer's eyes lock on a familiar face... A wrestler on the Wilson side...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's Owen...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...In a `Wilson wrestling uniform?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...In a [color=#e23b3b][i]Wilson wrestling uniform?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer strides across the wrestling mats toward Owen, fuming!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Owen!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Owen![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Spencer?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What the heck are you doing wearing Wilson colors?
Another Wilson wrestler steps forward, heading straight for Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Slow down there, chief. We're about to start a meet. Owen's one of us now.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Out of my way!
Just then, two more students hop down from the bleachers.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: You mess with one Wilson guy, you mess with us all.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: He's `not` one of you!
nodes.text_bbcode: He's [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] one of you!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Why don't you just turn around and keep on walking? Before we `make` you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Why don't you just turn around and keep on walking? Before we [color=#e23b3b][i]make[/i][/color] you.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not leaving til I settle the score with Owen... and any punk standing in my way!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: There's no way you're getting through us.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Let's get 'im!
The three Wilson guys rush toward Spencer, and he charges forward to meet them!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Gotta fight them off!
...She has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The best way to deal with guilt is to address it head on!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You mean, by going and conversing with Spencer right now?

options.label: Yes, you should talk to him now!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh... Sure.
They sit.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: So... What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Why does something have to be wrong?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Because you haven't done your homework, and the last time that happened was... Never.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: So what's the matter? Are you sick?
Nate playfully reaches out to feel $ALLISON's forehead, but she bats his hand away.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm fine. Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You also don't usually lie.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I merely meant that I'm `not` sick.
nodes.text_bbcode: I merely meant that I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] sick.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Fine. `And` I definitely have feelings for Spencer...
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. [color=#3b78e2][i]And[/i][/color] I definitely have feelings for Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And I definitely...
Nate leads the session successfully, sparking an interesting sharing of ideas.
Afterward, he pulls $ALLISON aside.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Good job taking over.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: No problem. Can we sit for a second?
A few seconds later, there's a pounding on the door!
`BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]BOOM! BOOM! BOOM![/b]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Big mistake telling me where you were, nerd! Now open the door and make this easy on yourself!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know he's going to be mad. I just need to tire him out so I can show him the `real` video of $ALLISON and Nate!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know he's going to be mad. I just need to tire him out so I can show him the [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] video of $ALLISON and Nate!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And I need my equipment to remain intact!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I know you're in there!
`SLAM!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]SLAM![/b]

nodes.text: Spencer's body slams into the door, causing it to warp in the middle!
Erik moves to the door, pushing his weight against it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm coming in!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've gotta hold it! Gotta make him tired!
`SLAM!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]SLAM![/b]

nodes.text: Spencer's next collision knocks the door off its hinges! With the door broken, Spencer pushes forward, and Erik's feet begin to slide!
Owen takes the keys and climbs into the driver's seat while Spencer takes shotgun, forcing the rest of the Troublemakers to squeeze into the backseat, much to Nate's chagrin!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: All right, but everyone just watch the upholstery...
Owen turns the ignition, and the engine roars to life! With quick, expert movements, he shifts the car into gear and peels out of the parking lot at top speed!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Step on it, Owen. We can't let Mr. Hart speak at that City Hall meeting!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know what's at stake here.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well if things go south, you can always go join Wilson High. You already wrestle for them. But the `rest` of us can't switch sides so easily.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well if things go south, you can always go join Wilson High. You already wrestle for them. But the [color=#e23b3b][i]rest[/i][/color] of us can't switch sides so easily.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh yeah? You mean the way you switched over to Mr. Hart's side?
`SKREEE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]SKREEE![/b]

nodes.text: Tires screech as Owen takes a tight, high-speed turn!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.title: Spencer releases Nate from the wall, and Nate takes a second to recompose himself.

nodes.text: You are now playing as Nate.
It's the first day back from the winter break...
As classes let out, Nate looks around, hoping to catch Spencer before he goes into detention.
As if on cue, Spencer rounds the corner, a flower clenched in his hand!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Out of my way, people! Man on a mission here!
Nate watches, a small smirk on his face.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Predictable. Looks like he's finally going to ask $ALLISON out. Time to put a stop to this.
Nate steps out from the crowd, blocking Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't have time for your crap, Nate! `Move!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't have time for your crap, Nate! [color=#e23b3b][i]Move![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer tries to get by, but Nate stays in front of him!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: It's obvious you're in a rush, man. But there's something I have to say...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Then spill it! Quick!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: ...I'm sorry for threatening to date $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? You mean... You're not going to go after her anymore?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Nope. I made a New Year's resolution to let things go. You made it into the Steelman Program fair and square.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I was wrong to frame you for cheating, and my plan to pursue $ALLISON to get back at you... Well, it was really petty of me.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Can you forgive me?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you for real?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm for real.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's... Surprising.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I know. But, I've changed. Honest.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I can't forgive you. Not for what you did.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But if you've really changed then... Then cool, man.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I can accept 'cool'.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm done chatting now. Get outta my way. I'm not asking twice.
Spencer moves to get around Nate...
You are now playing as $ALLISON.
That night...
$ALLISON sets up chairs in a secluded corner of the public library.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm so excited for book club! Finally! A chance to be among my own!
She waits...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I hope I was clear about the meeting time.
...And waits...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Maybe there was some bad traffic. That I didn't see. That the internet doesn't know about.
...And waits...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Guess no one's coming...
She starts sadly packing up her things... when someone raps their knuckles on a nearby bookshelf. $ALLISON spins around.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Am I too late?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Nate? What are you doing here?!
He holds up a copy of 'Frankenstein'.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I heard that you paid some of Kimi's friends for cheat sheets on 'Madame Bovary'. That's really low.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: `That` was a mistake. To be honest, I just wanted to impress you. I didn't actually think I'd like reading because, well, I thought it was dumb.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]That[/i][/color] was a mistake. To be honest, I just wanted to impress you. I didn't actually think I'd like reading because, well, I thought it was dumb.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Quite the opposite, in fact.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I know that `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, I know that [color=#e23b3b][i]now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Anyway, what happened? Where is everyone?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't know. I guess people are less dependable than I foresaw. I was just about to leave actually...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yeah, I don't blame you. If this were my club and only one person showed up, I'd give up too.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm not 'giving up'! I'm merely facing facts!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Isn't a person who 'faces facts' pretty much a quitter? I mean, it's all semantics.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm surprised you know that word.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm learning new ones everyday.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well... What would you have me do?!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You've got two people here. That's enough for the first meeting. Let's start discussing 'Frankenstein'.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You're serious? You've actually `read` the book? Not some cheat sheet?
nodes.text_bbcode: You're serious? You've actually [color=#3b78e2][i]read[/i][/color] the book? Not some cheat sheet?

nodes.text: Nate folds his arms over his chest.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You don't believe me? Go ahead. Quiz me. There's nothing I don't know about this book.
You are now playing as Paige.
On the way to detention, Paige grabs Kimi, pulling her aside.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We have to talk! Now!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: What is it?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's about my New Year's resolution!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You said you wanted to keep it private... Are you about to tell me a secret? Because--
In the diner parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay, that's two down... That just leaves Keith. How are we supposed to get him to quit?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not sure actually.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What do we know about him?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He `really` cares about his hair, he's got a girlfriend in Canada, I think...
nodes.text_bbcode: He [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] cares about his hair, he's got a girlfriend in Canada, I think...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And ever since Hector graduated, he's the `only` male cheerleader.
nodes.text_bbcode: And ever since Hector graduated, he's the [color=#3b78e2][i]only[/i][/color] male cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, actually... Maybe there's something to that. Let's check out a practice tomorrow...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: See you there!
At cheerleading practice...
Paige and Kimi find seats in the bleachers.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, keep it quiet, Chen. We don't want them to know we're spying.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'll see what I can do.
Meanwhile, on the field...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Okay, everyone, listen up! When we do this dance here, really shake your hips, okay?! It'll look `so` cute!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, everyone, listen up! When we do this dance here, really shake your hips, okay?! It'll look [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] cute!

nodes.text: In the back, Keith raises his hand.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Maria? Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What, Keith?!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I'm not going to do that... So what should I do instead?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Ohmygosh, Keith! We go over this at, like, every practice! Whenever we do something cute or hot, just get out of our way!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And if you absolutely `have` to do something, just, I don't know, lift something, okay?
nodes.text_bbcode: And if you absolutely [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to do something, just, I don't know, lift something, okay?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Lift something?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Urg! Never mind! Let's just take a five minute break!
Back in the bleachers...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did you see that?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, Keith just got cheer served.
On the court, the cheerleaders stand in a circle, drinking from water bottles. Keith's blocked out of the circle...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So then I told her to tell him to tell me that `I` wanted a different kind of mascara!
nodes.text_bbcode: So then I told her to tell him to tell me that [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] wanted a different kind of mascara!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Harsh. It's like they're trying to exclude him...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I think I'm starting to see a pattern...
A few minutes later, practice ends...
All the girls head toward the girls' locker room, laughing and chatting, while Keith heads off alone toward the boys' locker room.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All right, I've seen enough. Come on!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Are we going to go into the guys locker room?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ew! No! We still have our dignity!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We are going to meet him outside... And not by ourselves.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Who are we bringing?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Someone who can light a fire under Keith better than anyone!
Keith steps out of the boys' locker room and finds Paige, Kimi, and `Taylor` waiting for him.
nodes.text_bbcode: Keith steps out of the boys' locker room and finds Paige, Kimi, and [b]Taylor[/b] waiting for him.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: What's up, girls?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not your self-esteem, that's for sure.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We saw your practice, Keith.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Aww, man. It's kind of sad, huh?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: From what they've told me, it's depressing, Keith!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Well, this is really fun... I love being cheered up.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, shut up! We're trying to help you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do you even like cheerleading anymore?!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Honestly, now that Hector's gone... It sucks.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So?!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: So... What?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So, do something about it! I didn't spend some of my best years as Head Cheerleader teaching you how to do things right, just so you could screw them up later!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: She's saying...

nodes.title: The Secret Life of Owen Harris
nodes.subtitle: What is Owen hiding from his best friends?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: `Rrraagh!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Rrraagh!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer flings the school doors open as he storms out, fuming!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why? Of all schools, why did we have to lose to `them?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Why? Of all schools, why did we have to lose to [color=#e23b3b][i]them?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer's basketball teammates come trailing behind him.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Come on, Spencer, we played a good game!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Yeah, shake it off, man!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We live to fight another day!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But we lost to `Wilson High!` I can handle losing, but not to `those` jerks!
nodes.text_bbcode: But we lost to [color=#e23b3b][i]Wilson High![/i][/color] I can handle losing, but not to [color=#e23b3b][i]those[/i][/color] jerks!

nodes.text: As Spencer continues to vent, Owen exits the building and joins them.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, Spence. I saw the game. Don't let it get to you man, you'll get 'em next time.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Easy for you to say, Owen. You're not on the basketball team anymore. We might have had a chance if you were still on the team!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah, Chris isn't the best replacement for your position.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: I'm standing right here, guys!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was sad to leave the team, Spence. But you know I'm trying to get a scholarship by any means necessary.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. You went bookworm and started studying like crazy.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah... Studying...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But you just don't understand how much I...
Later, Owen is crammed in the backseat of Chris's family minivan with Erik, Jacob, Andy, and Spencer. In the front seat, Paige fumes as Chris speeds across town towards Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No way someone stomps all over my boyfriend without having to deal with `me.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No way someone stomps all over my boyfriend without having to deal with [color=#3b78e2][i]me.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I wouldn't say 'stomped all over'.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I `saw` your bruises. You look like a ripe banana.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]saw[/i][/color] your bruises. You look like a ripe banana.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Oooh, she told you, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Owen's on our side, Jacob.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Right. Sorry. Gut reaction.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Look, this might not be the best idea.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And why's that?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This could definitely lead to...

nodes.title: Exposed
nodes.subtitle: When secrets are revealed, nothing will ever be the same...

nodes.text: You are now playing as Spencer.
The day after the Town Crier's announcement...
In detention, the Troublemakers are angrily crowded around Mr. Hart's desk...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What is this about us being watched?!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I can assure you--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And our words being recorded?!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: There's nothing to--

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Or our secrets not being safe?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I used the school site to write some of my most private thoughts. I thought I was doing so `in private!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I used the school site to write some of my most private thoughts. I thought I was doing so [color=#3b78e2][i]in private![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: You were! Please, everyone, if we could all just take some chill pills, I think you'll find there isn't anything to be worry-warts about!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Prove it!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Now, now... There's no way for me to prove the administration isn't spying on you.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ha! So you are!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: But I also can't prove that this room isn't... Full of ghosts!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ha! Ghosts!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: ...It's not, right? 'Cause ghosts aren't real... Right?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: The burden of proof is on this Town Crier.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: And guess what, he hasn't supplied any evidence... Because there is none! The system is secure, I assure you!
The Troublemakers ease back from Mr. Hart's desk.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So... It isn't true then?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: No, it isn't! This Town Crier is probably just some prankster, someone trying to rile all of you up against me, someone with major issues with privacy...
Everyone turns to Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Sounds a lot like you, Mr. Cooper.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You think `I'm` the Town Crier?! That's impossible!
nodes.text_bbcode: You think [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] the Town Crier?! That's impossible!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Is it? You and I haven't exactly seen eye-to-eye. And you were one of the only students to refuse a laptop.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Pfft. That's true, but...

options.label: I was here when the message was sent!
I'd never call myself the Town Crier!

nodes.text: On the other side of campus, Kimi rushes into the computer lab! Emily greets her!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Kimi! You got the message about us getting the files?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I came as soon as I could! How's it going?
Emily nods at a wall of computers, where Ben, Kevin, Dex, and Ashley are working furiously!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm getting all the check-ins from the app! The fact that the administration was keeping all of this is... Is `so` wrong!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm getting all the check-ins from the app! The fact that the administration was keeping all of this is... Is [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] wrong!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I just found recordings of everything people said to Branchi! This is unreal! How could they do this?!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Tell me about it. Dex, you want to help me with all these alphabetized files from the site?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I'll start with the A's, you start with the Z's?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Meet you in the middle!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Intense!
Kimi pulls Emily aside.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay, I need your help! Big time!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: A lot of my friends from detention have huge secrets! And if those secrets got out, it would be devastating!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I think everyone at the school is in that position...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Are they also the ex-girlfriend of one of the people collecting all the secrets?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: If Kevin gets his hands on any of these, he could really hurt me!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Do you think he'd do that?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: When we broke up, I told him that playing video games was lame.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Right. I'll totally help you.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And that's why we're friends!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What do you want me to do?
A loud shout comes from Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: These check-ins led me to the 'Personal Musings' section from the website. It's got everyone's private entries! Oooh! There's one here from `QueenOfTB` called 'How I destroyed that witch, Maria!'
nodes.text_bbcode: These check-ins led me to the 'Personal Musings' section from the website. It's got everyone's private entries! Oooh! There's one here from [color=#e23b3b][i]QueenOfTB[/i][/color] called 'How I destroyed that witch, Maria!'

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's Paige's!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Help me distract Ben right now!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't know! Just talk about...
That afternoon, Spencer leaves the school, grumbling to himself.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nate, that weasel! I bet this is all some trick. I wouldn't put it past him...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not gonna fall for it. No way.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But... If it's `not` a trick... And there `is` some secret being kept at Wilson...
nodes.text_bbcode: But... If it's [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] a trick... And there [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] some secret being kept at Wilson...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I guess I... I'd want to find out what it is.
Spencer heads down the road toward the bus stop. Any minute now, the bus to Wilson High will arrive...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine... I'll go over and check it out.
Before long, the bus arrives outside Wilson High, where Spencer gets off and approaches the school...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm sure it's just some trick...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: At least... I'm `pretty` sure...
nodes.text_bbcode: At least... I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]pretty[/i][/color] sure...

nodes.text: Spencer walks to the gym and pushes through the doors.
Inside, the bleachers have been pulled out, and a crowd watches as two teams prepare for a wrestling meet.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't get it. It's just a regular wrestling meet between Wilson and--
Just then, Spencer's eyes lock on a familiar face... A wrestler on the Wilson side...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's Owen...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...In a `Wilson wrestling uniform?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...In a [color=#e23b3b][i]Wilson wrestling uniform?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer strides across the wrestling mats toward Owen, fuming!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Owen!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Owen![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Spencer?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What the heck are you doing wearing Wilson colors?
Another Wilson wrestler steps forward, heading straight for Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Slow down there, chief. We're about to start a meet. Owen's one of us now.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Out of my way!
Just then, two more students hop down from the bleachers.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: You mess with one Wilson guy, you mess with us all.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: He's `not` one of you!
nodes.text_bbcode: He's [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] one of you!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Why don't you just turn around and keep on walking? Before we `make` you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Why don't you just turn around and keep on walking? Before we [color=#e23b3b][i]make[/i][/color] you.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not leaving til I settle the score with Owen... and any punk standing in my way!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: There's no way you're getting through us.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Let's get 'im!
The three Wilson guys rush toward Spencer, and he charges forward to meet them!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Gotta fight them off!
You are now playing as Kimi.
In the cafeteria, the students sedately assemble their lunches while BranchiCams, overhead cameras mounted on the ceiling, whir from side to side, tracking the students' movements.
Kimi sits down at a table with $ALLISON and Paige.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay! So, I know that Mr. Hart's regime of surveillance or whatever is really killing everyone's mood, but, come on! The Winter Dance is coming!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's not just Mr. Hart's surveillance, Perky Sue... It's who's working with him now...
Just then, Mr. Hart enters the cafeteria, Spencer beside him. The girls' voices drop down to whispers...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Spencer joining Mr. Hart significantly deflated everyone's spirits.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I still can't believe it. Spencer hates Mr. Hart!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Hated.` Until $ALLISON's big secret got out. Now `that` was news I couldn't believe!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Hated.[/i][/color] Until $ALLISON's big secret got out. Now [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] was news I couldn't believe!

nodes.text: Mr. Hart stands at the front of the cafeteria...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Quiet down now. Let's put on our shushing caps, everyone!
Paige turns to $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You really have feelings `for Nate?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You really have feelings [color=#3b78e2][i]for Nate?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That is a private matter!
You are now playing as Kimi.
At the table with $ALLISON, Kimi scans the crowd...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Look, $ALLISON, I know you're all hung up on this Spencer-Nate thing, but--
She pauses when she sees a cute guy, but then keeps scanning when the guy puts his arm around a nearby girl.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: --but come on!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I mean... you've got to get out of this funk somehow. Besides, I need someone focused to help me figure out who my secret admirer is!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And how, praytell, am I supposed to 'get out of this funk'?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I feel so much guilt, and yet I'm not certain I've done anything wrong!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Admittedly, I wish I didn't feel what I feel for Nate, but I can't help that!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And I didn't act on those feelings! I wrote about them, that's all. Am I at fault for expressing my feelings privately?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, not at all! But there are ways to feel better!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The best way to deal with guilt is to address it head on!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You mean, by going and conversing with Spencer right now?

options.label: Yes, you should talk to him now!

nodes.title: Heart to Hart
nodes.subtitle: Can the Troublemakers get rid of Mr. Hart?

nodes.text: You are now playing as $ALLISON...
$ALLISON, Paige, Owen, and Kimi burst into Principal McCormick's office!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What the--?! What makes you think you can just come in here uninvited?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Principal McCormick, I can explain!

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: You'd better.
You are now playing as Erik.
Meanwhile, Erik is sitting at a computer station inside a utility closet. In front of him is an impressive display of monitors, all simultaneously running bits of code.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sounds like Spencer's meeting with Mr. Hart wrapped up, `and` Spencer's got a new phone! Better buzz him!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sounds like Spencer's meeting with Mr. Hart wrapped up, [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] Spencer's got a new phone! Better buzz him!

nodes.text: Erik takes out a device and turns a knob until he hears a humming noise. A series of seven digits displays on the device.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hot dog! That's the number! I'll just send this untraceable message aaaaaaaaand...
He presses send.
A few seconds later, there's a pounding on the door!
`BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]BOOM! BOOM! BOOM![/b]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Big mistake telling me where you were, nerd! Now open the door and make this easy on yourself!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know he's going to be mad. I just need to tire him out so I can show him the `real` video of $ALLISON and Nate!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know he's going to be mad. I just need to tire him out so I can show him the [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] video of $ALLISON and Nate!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And I need my equipment to remain intact!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I know you're in there!
`SLAM!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]SLAM![/b]

nodes.text: Spencer's body slams into the door, causing it to warp in the middle!
Erik moves to the door, pushing his weight against it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm coming in!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've gotta hold it! Gotta make him tired!
`SLAM!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]SLAM![/b]

nodes.text: Spencer's next collision knocks the door off its hinges! With the door broken, Spencer pushes forward, and Erik's feet begin to slide!

nodes.title: Hart Attack
nodes.subtitle: Can the Troublemakers stop Mr. Hart's plan once and for all?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Kimi.
$Travis shoves Spencer and Erik down into seats in the Student Lounge as the other Troublemakers look on.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, easy $Travis!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Nothing personal, Spencer. Mr. Hart hired me as a Campus Security Guard and Detention Monitor. Even gave me this ID badge!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Anyway, I gotta make sure that none of you leave this room for the next two hours.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So you mean you're our `jailor.`
nodes.text_bbcode: So you mean you're our [color=#e23b3b][i]jailor.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hey that sounds even cooler! I'm a jailor!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Congrats.
$Travis plops down into the seat by the door, puts on headphones, and bobs his head to music as he buries his face in an issue of 'Fancy Cats Magazine'.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nice of you to join us, Spence.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Are you guys all right?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We're fine.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Erik, they found you too?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, they found me when I met up with Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So Spencer led them right to you. Of course.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It means you stabbed Erik in the back! Just like you stabbed all of us in the back when you joined Mr. Hart.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I wouldn't be talking if I were you, Wilson boy.
Owen gets out of his seat.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You really wanna start this again?
The two stride toward each other, glaring.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Guys, don't worry! Everything will turn out fine!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. Once we figure out a way to get out of detention and over to that meeting at City Hall. If we don't, Hart's gonna convince the mayor to make him our principal!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: My dad may be the mayor, but the final decision is up to the school board members. They'll be in attendance too. I've been to a hundred of these things.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You should try the sugar cookies they put out.
Spencer's eyes lock on Nate, wide with rage.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Do you think this is a joke? And who asked `you?` And what the heck are you `doing` here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you think this is a joke? And who asked [color=#e23b3b][i]you?[/i][/color] And what the heck are you [color=#e23b3b][i]doing[/i][/color] here?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Look, I was just with $ALLISON when Hart's security guards came to bring her in. They grabbed me too. Didn't even ask questions.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: This bickering isn't getting us anywhere! I think we all need to...
You are now playing as Erik.
The Troublemakers arrive outside of City Hall. As Owen throws Nate's car into park, the group pours out!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on! Let's hope we're not too late!
They run into the building...
Where the meeting is already well underway!
Up on stage, next to the mayor and members of the school board, Mr. Hart addresses the audience from behind a podium.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: So you see, good people of Centerscore, with my 'Branchi' system of information monitoring and security, I've created a safe, wholesome environment, ideal for education!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: If chosen to be the principal, I would continue to foster this ideal environment... And even assist other campuses in implementing the Branchi system!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh no... He's going to spread the Branchi system to other schools!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No...
Horror grips Erik... Desperate, he steps forward and shouts...

Spencer and Erik are sitting in their seats moments before the opera starts...
I can't believe I'm here. Without $ALLISON. With you.
Yeah, life can be kind of magical sometimes!
For going to talk to $ALLISON at the dance when I couldn't.
Hey, that's what buds are for!
It's funny. When I started high school, I'd `never` do something like this with someone like you.
Life is full of surprises, and every person is a jelly bean!
I wonder what'll be surprising about my life...
Who knows, right? Isn't that what makes it surprising?
I guess so! It's so exciting!
Yeah, we'll see what's in store for you, Erickson.
Shh! The show's starting, and I don't want to miss one minute of the next four hours!
And the next day in the girls' locker room...
Nicole sits down next to Paige.

No money, an old look... It must be sad for you.
Don't you have a pom-pom to choke on?
What does the future hold for $ALLISON and Spencer? And what is Paige up to?
Check out the next episode of Surviving High School to find out!

Later that day, as detention lets out...
Great, great, `great` job today, Do-Gooders! Maybe I should call you the Do-`Greaters!`
Thanks! Oh, yes, I just remembered... Could I talk to you for a moment, Erik?
The rest of the Troublemakers leave for the day...
Right. Of course. It's hard to trust anyone these days, don't you think?
Oh, well, I'm not sure I follow...
Never mind. I just want to say that I find your positive attitude a `true` delight!
It's uncommon these days. So many of the students I encounter are jaded and angry and... Problematic.
Well, we are under a lot of pressure.
Sure, sure. I feel like we're kindred spirits. I see a lot of myself in you.
And, because of that, I feel like I can trust you, Erik. Can I trust you?
Great! That's exactly what I wanted to hear!
Mr. Hart leans forward in his chair.
I'm looking for a new assistant. Someone who can file papers and help extract some of the information from the school website.
Will you do that for me? It'll look very good on your college application!
I get to help someone `and` improve my chances of getting a higher education?! Sounds too good to be true!
Outside on a bench, $ALLISON types on her laptop...
'What am I feeling? Do I have actual feelings for... Him?'
'Granted, he is attractive. But are his educational strides legitimate? Or are they merely means toward an end, the end being my affection?'
Hey, we all have a right to privacy, right?
I'm looking forward to our next date. I felt like our last one hit kind of a snag.
I'm... I'm looking forward to it as well, actually.
All right, Red. I'll leave you to your nerd machine.

You looked a little down when you left the Student Lounge. Everything all right?
I guess that anonymous message on the Twin Branches app had an... Unnerving effect on me.
But you shouldn't stress! It's only the people crazy enough to put their deep, dark secrets on this Twin Branches app who have something to worry about!
Right! No deep, dark secrets here!
Still... I imagine many people entrusted... 'Sensitive' information to this social network.
Hey. No matter what 'sensitive' information may come out, it won't change how awesome you are.
And what if... Hypothetically, you found out I wasn't as... 'Awesome' as you originally thought?
Well... I don't usually get cheesy or poetical like this, but...
A pink flush creeps to $ALLISON's cheeks as she tries to hide her smile.
Anyway, I've been thinking about our next date. I've got a lot of ideas and plans for it, but I don't wanna spoil the surprise, and...
Ugh, I sound like a dork right now, don't I?
Well, maybe a little. But I find it... Endearing.
Cool. Well, I just wanted to make sure nothing's changed, and you're still down for our next date.
Nothing has changed. I am most assuredly 'down'.
Awesome. I'll... Catch you later, then!

Hey, `'$ALLISON'`! It seems you haven't posted to the newsfeed in a while!

No, Branchi! Nothing has changed! Mind your own business, you rudimentary vocal interface!

Cheerleaders' table? But... You're the only one here.
A technicality. Now make your point, Craig.
Chris smoothes his hair and straightens his shirt...
Right! Well... Crazy times we're having, huh? I couldn't help but notice we were both on the same side of the debate at the assembly...
We kinda shared a moment, don't you think?

That night at Delilah's family farm, Erik waits near the house behind a bale of hay...
A moment later, Delilah sneaks out, her father's loud snores a comforting sign of her safe escape. When she meets Erik, she puts her arm through his, and the two meander off into the night...
So, what's this about? Are we catching fireflies? Looking for UFOs? Stargazing?
Normally, I'd say all three. And Orion `is` looking especially fearsome tonight... But he'll have to wait.
Remember how I said things haven't been going well at Twin Branches? Part of that was my fault.
I thought I was doing the right thing, but too many feelings got hurt.
And now everyone knows it was me! I'm an outlaw!
It might be better if you didn't know...
Erik, you know you can tell me anything...
It's just not safe for you to associate with me anymore. I'm going to have to lay low for a while.
Hard to say... Days? Months? Years?!
They reach the top of a hill overlooking the town below.
Do you hear that, Delilah? That's the sound of an exile taking his last look at home.
My whole life was in this town... The Troublemakers... my collection of brunch menus... and, most of all, you.
You'll all have to go on without me... I know it sounds impossible, and I'm scared too!
But maybe you'll see me again someday, in an open-air market or a laser tag arena... What would we even say to each other?
Don't be such a worrywart! I don't care what you did, I'll stick by you.
Erik takes Delilah's hand and looks into her eyes.

nodes.text: Luckily, it doesn't look like the equipment's been `too` damaged from our fracas!
nodes.text_bbcode: Luckily, it doesn't look like the equipment's been [color=#e23b3b][i]too[/i][/color] damaged from our fracas!

nodes.text: He takes a seat and begins searching through files, his fingers a blur on the keyboard.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So, dude. What are you doing in a closet? Being 'on the run' means actual running, you know?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I lived that life for a time. On the lam. Nothing to keep me company but the open road and a can of lukewarm beans.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's been a week, man.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A week? A month? A year? What is time?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Seriously, why are you here?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's the only place on campus where Mr. Hart's cameras don't reach.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Anyway, I figured I could strike back by--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa! Wait... `You've` been spying on `him,` haven't you?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! Wait... [color=#e23b3b][i]You've[/i][/color] been spying on [color=#e23b3b][i]him,[/i][/color] haven't you?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Just trying to find something, but he's squeaky clean!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait... Why'd you text me? You must have known I was after you, but you told me where to find you!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A risk I had to take. Let me just pull up the file... `Aaaaaaaaaand...` Here we go!
nodes.text_bbcode: A risk I had to take. Let me just pull up the file... [color=#e23b3b][i]Aaaaaaaaaand...[/i][/color] Here we go!

nodes.text: Once again, the feed from the book club meeting appears on-screen.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've already seen this!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, not this version. Mr. Hart edited it to look like $ALLISON was just flirting with Nate. But you didn't see some key parts!
Erik shows Spencer the full version...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, what do you think?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I think that this changes everything!
The door to the utility closet is flung open! Mr. Hart and a large, burly guy cast a shadow over Spencer and Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Yipe!` The jig is up!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yipe![/i][/color] The jig is up!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I've got you at last, Ericson. $Travis, bring him to the detention room.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Whatever you say, man.
As $Travis escorts Erik out of the utility closet, Spencer glares at Mr. Hart.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We need to talk.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Sure thing! Let's walk and talk!
You are now playing as Spencer.
A moment later, Spencer walks alongside Mr. Hart toward the detention room...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: You wanted to chat, buddy! Now's the time!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Especially since the outcome of our talk will have... Certain consequences.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Never mind! Not important!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Anyway, what's on your mind, Mr. Town Crier Catcher!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I saw the full footage. Of $ALLISON and Nate. You tricked me!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Yes, I had to give you a slice of the truth in order to remind you of your purpose!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But that's all your apps and files and cameras are! Slices of truth, but not actual truth.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Even the 'full video' Erik showed me could have been fake!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Only Erik's not a scumbag!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I'm not sure I'm following you...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Your forms of surveillance never tell the full story because they're not people!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: People tell full stories!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: People `lie.`
nodes.text_bbcode: People [color=#e23b3b][i]lie.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Or are you forgetting the anguish and pain Ericson caused with his duplicity?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's just it. He didn't cause anything. It was `your spying` that caused me pain and anguish and confusion!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's just it. He didn't cause anything. It was [color=#e23b3b][i]your spying[/i][/color] that caused me pain and anguish and confusion!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Spying? Is that how you see it now? After all the trust I put in you?
Spencer holds up the phone Mr. Hart gave to him.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Is that what you call it when you gave me a bugged phone?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Didn't think I'd figure it out, did you?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Heh. Maybe you're a bit smarter than I gave you credit for, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Try a lot smarter.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: We'll see...
They reach the door to the detention room.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: I know we're upset with each other, but I just can't stay mad at you!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: So I'm giving you a fun choice! Stick with me, and I'll make it up to you...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Or join your friends and their impossible mission to prevent me from becoming the new principal of this school.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?! Principal? What plan?!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Oh, they probably didn't tell you about it. Anyway...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: The decision's yours. Ally yourself with the upcoming principal as my right hand man...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hart
nodes.text: Or join Ericson and the others in detention.
Spencer glares at Mr. Hart.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This isn't even a choice...

lines.speaker: Mr. Hart
lines.text: I see. Well, this has been fun! Goodbye!

lines.speaker: Mr. Hart
lines.text: $Travis, don't let them out.

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Spencer
lines.text: What?! You can't do that!

lines.speaker: Travis
lines.text: Whatever you say, Mr. Hart, sir!
$Travis grabs both Spencer and Erik at the same time and shoves them into the detention room!
A second later, Mr. Hart slams the door behind them!

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: We're stuck!

lines.speaker: Spencer
lines.text: ...What have I done?

While Mr. Hart meets with Spencer, Erik is escorted to detention by $Travis.

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: I have to say, $Travis, as much as I regret being caught, it's good to see you getting the recognition you deserve!

lines.speaker: Travis
lines.text: What is that supposed to mean?

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: I've always sensed that you had a career in law enforcement, and I guess Mr. Hart thought so too!

lines.speaker: Travis
lines.text: Huh, I guess you might be right. My uncle's a cop!

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: See? It's in your blood! So... If it's alright with you, Officer, can I get my phone call?

lines.speaker: Travis
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: When you bring in a suspect, they're allowed one phone call. I need to call my girlfriend about our dinner plans for tonight.
$Travis glances down the hall to see Mr. Hart still talking to Spencer.

lines.speaker: Travis
lines.text: Hmm... You're lucky I'm in a good mood, punk. Just make it quick, alright?

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: You got it! Thanks, $Travis!
Erik dials a number on his phone.

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: Hello, my toffee eclair!

lines.speaker: Delilah
lines.text: Hello, sugar pine!

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: So, about dinner tonight... I'll be a little late. I've been detained!

lines.speaker: Delilah
lines.text: Aww, that's a shame! Does that mean what I think it does?

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: As a matter of fact, yes!

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: Commence Operation Hogwild!

lines.speaker: Delilah
lines.text: Five steps ahead of you, darlin'. See you at dinner!

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: Seeya!

lines.speaker: Travis
lines.text: Hogwild? Are you having pork chops tonight?

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: Something like that! All I can say is, what's about to happen...

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: ...Is going to be delicious!
...He has failed.

nodes.text: Or join Ericson and the others in detention.
Spencer glares at Mr. Hart.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This isn't even a choice...

lines.speaker: Mr. Hart
lines.text: I see. Well, this has been fun! Goodbye!

lines.speaker: Mr. Hart
lines.text: $Travis, don't let them out.

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Spencer
lines.text: What?! You can't do that!

lines.speaker: Travis
lines.text: Whatever you say, Mr. Hart, sir!
$Travis grabs both Spencer and Erik at the same time and shoves them into the detention room!
A second later, Mr. Hart slams the door behind them!

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: We're stuck!

lines.speaker: Spencer
lines.text: ...What have I done?
You have reached the end of `Season 3, Episode 7: Heart to Hart!`

lines.text: Want to catch up?! Check out `Troublemakers 1: Origins` and `Troublemakers 2: Holiday Hearts!` Both in More Episodes!
lines.text_bbcode: Want to catch up?! Check out [b]Troublemakers 1: Origins[/b] and [b]Troublemakers 2: Holiday Hearts![/b] Both in More Episodes!

lines.text: And remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam!
You have unlocked the Bonus Scene! Enjoy!
Achieving the rank of 'Honor Roll Scholar' or higher will unlock a special bonus scene!
While Mr. Hart meets with Spencer, Erik is escorted to detention by $Travis.

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: I have to say, $Travis, as much as I regret being caught, it's good to see you getting the recognition you deserve!

lines.speaker: Travis
lines.text: What is that supposed to mean?

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: I've always sensed that you had a career in law enforcement, and I guess Mr. Hart thought so too!

lines.speaker: Travis
lines.text: Huh, I guess you might be right. My uncle's a cop!

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: See? It's in your blood! So... If it's alright with you, Officer, can I get my phone call?

lines.speaker: Travis
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: When you bring in a suspect, they're allowed one phone call. I need to call my girlfriend about our dinner plans for tonight.
$Travis glances down the hall to see Mr. Hart still talking to Spencer.

lines.speaker: Travis
lines.text: Hmm... You're lucky I'm in a good mood, punk. Just make it quick, alright?

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: You got it! Thanks, $Travis!
Erik dials a number on his phone.

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: Hello, my toffee eclair!

lines.speaker: Delilah
lines.text: Hello, sugar pine!

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: So, about dinner tonight... I'll be a little late. I've been detained!

lines.speaker: Delilah
lines.text: Aww, that's a shame! Does that mean what I think it does?

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: As a matter of fact, yes!

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: Commence Operation Hogwild!

lines.speaker: Delilah
lines.text: Five steps ahead of you, darlin'. See you at dinner!

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: Seeya!

lines.speaker: Travis
lines.text: Hogwild? Are you having pork chops tonight?

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: Something like that! All I can say is, what's about to happen...

lines.speaker: Erik
lines.text: ...Is going to be delicious!
...He has failed.

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise. POV is propagated in execution order from `entry`; only main_characters can hold it.
